PASSIONCODE.AI / FABRIC · ENGINEERING BASELINE · 07.09.2026

Как устроена система.
Что именно строим дальше.

От проекта и полномочий до прогонов, памяти и ретро. Связи показывают данные, циклы — условия перехода, задания — конкретное решение и приёмку.

Целевая спецификация · на reviewКод: 5051defВизуальные сценарии ↗Живая карта продукта ↗

Это документация, а не текущая телеметрия. «Есть основа» означает наличие исходного объекта, а не готовность всех описанных контрактов.

УстройствоГраф данныхЦиклыЗаданияПорядок работыРешения и границы

Восемь областей, один путь работы

Выберите модуль: схема выделит его связи, справа появятся ответственность и связанные задания. Стрелка означает передачу данных; её точный payload раскрывается ниже.

Клавиатура: Tab к узлу, Enter для выбора. На узком экране схема прокручивается; текстовое представление доступно ниже.

Проект и доступ

Проект хранит цель, команду и границы. Identity определяет, кто может действовать.

S02 · S09
Полномочия и эффекты

Проверить область, потолок, основание; зарезервировать действие и сохранить результат.

S03 · S06 · M157 · M158 · M168
Работа и решения

Цели, версии плана, задачи и вопросы связаны доказуемыми причинными рёбрами.

M149 · M151 · M152 · M153 · M173 · M190
Исполнение и прогресс

Отделить проход графа, прогон задачи, шаг, попытку и сессию исполнителя.

S04 · S05 · M103 · M188 · M189
Агенты и управление

Выбираемые исполнители и manager, единые инструменты и наблюдатель вне агента.

M177 · M178 · M179 · M180 · M181 · M166 · M167 · M169 · M171 · M175 · M176 · M194 · M199
Память и обучение

Хранить наблюдения, утверждения, основания и версии контекста раздельно.

M154 · M155 · M182 · M183 · M184 · M191
Циклы и сохранность

Планировщик, durable delivery, восстановление и синхронизация со своим источником правды.

S12 · S14 · S15 · M198
Рабочая среда

Показывать sourced snapshots, адресовать действия человеку, сохранять ввод и доставлять проверенную сборку.

S01 · S07 · S08 · S10 · S11 · S13 · M97 · M98 · M102 · M105 · M109 · M185 · M186 · M187 · M195 · M196 · M197

Циклы и условия перехода

Выберите цикл и проследите путь до результата, ожидания или новой итерации. Это схема операций; точные DTO и статусы исполнителя находятся в связанных заданиях.

Все циклы — текстовая версия
Наблюдение → проверенный результат
id: observe-verify
name: Наблюдение → проверенный результат
module: work
trigger: Routine window or scoped external observation
dedup key: observation source + source event ID + scope
states:
  • id: observe
    name: Измерить
  • id: finding
    name: Сформулировать проблему
  • id: propose
    name: Предложить работу
  • id: check
    name: Проверить границы
  • id: execute
    name: Выполнить
  • id: verify
    name: Независимо проверить
  • id: learn
    name: Записать результат и урок
  • id: schedule
    name: Назначить следующую проверку
  • id: attention
    name: Запросить участие
transitions:
  • from: observe
    to: finding
    guard: source readable
    carries: observation with time and evidence
  • from: finding
    to: propose
    guard: action warranted
    carries: finding + target + acceptance
  • from: propose
    to: check
    guard: typed proposal
    carries: command hash + scope
  • from: check
    to: execute
    guard: allowed and admitted
    carries: task/workflow IDs + limits
  • from: check
    to: attention
    guard: requires person
    carries: question + reason + target
  • from: attention
    to: check
    guard: answer committed
    carries: decision receipt + current authority
  • from: execute
    to: verify
    guard: artifact/outcome available
    carries: artifact digest + task-run refs
  • from: verify
    to: learn
    guard: independent probe passed
    carries: verification receipt
  • from: verify
    to: finding
    guard: probe failed
    carries: failure evidence, not a success claim
  • from: learn
    to: schedule
    guard: result recorded
    carries: memory/decision refs
  • from: schedule
    to: observe
    guard: new due window
    carries: next invocation identity
rules:
  • Model confidence never substitutes for verifier evidence.
  • S08 fixture establishes portability, not production outcome.
tasks:
  • S08
  • S03
  • S04
  • M152
  • M176
output: verified outcome + next check, or addressed question
diagram scope: Business/data path; exact execution states and interruption semantics are specified by linked task contracts.
Запуск существующей задачи
id: launch
name: Запуск существующей задачи
module: execution
trigger: Operator/chain/routine requests launch
dedup key: estate_id + launch command_id
states:
  • id: request
    name: Запрос запуска
  • id: admit
    name: Атомарный допуск
  • id: denied
    name: Отказ без прогона
  • id: reserved
    name: TaskRun создан
  • id: spawn
    name: Запустить исполнитель
  • id: ack
    name: Подтвердить доставку
  • id: running
    name: Исполняется
  • id: unknown
    name: Уточнить исход
  • id: failed
    name: Прогон завершён с ошибкой
  • id: terminal
    name: Завершён
transitions:
  • from: request
    to: admit
    guard: scope/type valid
    carries: task ID + expected revision + command hash
  • from: admit
    to: denied
    guard: blocked/quota unknown/revision conflict
    carries: refusal receipt
  • from: admit
    to: reserved
    guard: transaction wins
    carries: task_run_id + fenced lease + pinned revisions
  • from: reserved
    to: spawn
    guard: same live epoch
    carries: spawn intent + target binding
  • from: spawn
    to: ack
    guard: process handle known
    carries: fabric_session_id
  • from: spawn
    to: unknown
    guard: dispatch result lost
    carries: operation ID for reconciliation
  • from: spawn
    to: failed
    guard: known spawn failure
    carries: failed-to-spawn receipt
  • from: ack
    to: running
    guard: adapter semantic acknowledgement
    carries: delivery ack
  • from: ack
    to: unknown
    guard: ack deadline elapsed
    carries: pending receipt, no blind resend
  • from: unknown
    to: running
    guard: invocation-scoped semantic acknowledgement proven
    carries: ack receipt matching delivery and task_run_id
  • from: unknown
    to: failed
    guard: absence proven and budget exhausted
    carries: failure evidence
  • from: running
    to: terminal
    guard: terminal evidence committed
    carries: exit/outcome + transcript state
  • from: unknown
    to: ack
    guard: spawn handle proven but semantic delivery not yet confirmed
    carries: fabric_session_id and pending delivery identity
rules:
  • Retry admission with same command ID returns same result.
  • No broad startup resume over all estates.
tasks:
  • S04
  • M103
  • M188
output: one TaskRun after admission, or one refusal receipt
diagram scope: Business/data path; exact execution states and interruption semantics are specified by linked task contracts.
interruptions:
  • event: cancel_or_revoke
    from:
    • reserved
    • spawn
    • ack
    • running
    • unknown
    to: unknown
    guard: invalidate write epoch, request stop, reconcile outstanding dispatch before terminal cancellation
    carries: cancellation request receipt + actual process/effect outcome; stop request alone is not proof
План задачи и полные итерации
id: iterations
name: План задачи и полные итерации
module: execution
trigger: Explicit evaluation loop or operator rerun
dedup key: task_id + iteration_request_id
states:
  • id: new
    name: Новый TaskRun
  • id: declare
    name: Зафиксировать версию плана
  • id: step
    name: Шаг активен
  • id: checkpoint
    name: Проверить чекпоинт
  • id: blocked
    name: Ждёт ответа
  • id: finish
    name: Итог прогона
  • id: decide
    name: Условие продолжения
  • id: stop
    name: Цикл завершён
transitions:
  • from: new
    to: declare
    guard: admitted
    carries: fresh run ID + step state namespace
  • from: declare
    to: step
    guard: dependency outputs ready
    carries: immutable plan revision
  • from: step
    to: checkpoint
    guard: claimed done / gate reached
    carries: claim + separate evidence refs
  • from: step
    to: blocked
    guard: question blocks progress
    carries: question block ID
  • from: blocked
    to: step
    guard: all applicable blockers resolved
    carries: answer ack + blocker-set revision
  • from: checkpoint
    to: step
    guard: remaining ready steps
    carries: verified prerequisite output
  • from: checkpoint
    to: finish
    guard: all required gates settled
    carries: per-step summary
  • from: finish
    to: decide
    guard: terminal receipt persisted
    carries: iteration outcome + budget consumed
  • from: decide
    to: new
    guard: explicit repeat condition true, limits permit
    carries: new iteration ID and reset plan statuses
  • from: decide
    to: stop
    guard: goal met or limit reached
    carries: final outcome / cap reason
rules:
  • Each explicit iteration is a whole run; unlimited display history via pagination, finite execution limits are mandatory.
  • Plan amendments create new revisions, preserve executed steps and invalidate affected gates; no retroactive denominator rewrite.
tasks:
  • M188
  • M189
  • S15
output: per-iteration complete plan/checkpoint history

Вопрос → решение → продолжение
id: answer
name: Вопрос → решение → продолжение
module: work
trigger: Addressed human/manager answer
dedup key: question_id + answer command_id
states:
  • id: read
    name: Прочитать вопрос
  • id: check
    name: Проверить версию и основание
  • id: conflict
    name: Показать конфликт
  • id: commit
    name: Атомарно записать
  • id: outbox
    name: Поставить доставку
  • id: deliver
    name: Передать адресату
  • id: ack
    name: Получить ack
  • id: ready
    name: Переоценить препятствия
transitions:
  • from: read
    to: check
    guard: answer submitted
    carries: answer + question revision
  • from: check
    to: conflict
    guard: stale or already settled differently
    carries: current state without overwrite
  • from: check
    to: commit
    guard: authorized under current basis
    carries: decision + resolution + resolved block IDs
  • from: commit
    to: outbox
    guard: same DB transaction
    carries: delivery intent referencing committed receipt
  • from: outbox
    to: deliver
    guard: same target run/binding eligible
    carries: delivery_id + typed content refs
  • from: deliver
    to: outbox
    guard: known transient failure, retry budget
    carries: same delivery id + next retry time
  • from: deliver
    to: ack
    guard: semantic acknowledgement
    carries: ack receipt
  • from: ack
    to: ready
    guard: delivery committed
    carries: all unresolved blocker IDs
  • from: ready
    to: read
    guard: other blocker still open
    carries: next addressed question, not auto-unblocked task
rules:
  • Read/unread is independent of resolution.
  • Physical delivery uncertainty is reconciled; do not replay arbitrary PTY text.
tasks:

  • M152
  • M103
output: durable answer/decision + acknowledged continuation or explicit blocked state

Жизненный цикл manager
id: manager
name: Жизненный цикл manager
module: agents
trigger: Relevant Board/worker-result/retro delta or due schedule
dedup key: role_slot_id + binding_revision + signal watermark window
states:
  • id: signal
    name: Получить сигнал
  • id: coalesce
    name: Собрать пакет изменений
  • id: lease
    name: Занять место / epoch
  • id: pack
    name: Собрать context pack
  • id: loop
    name: Judgement loop
  • id: tool
    name: Типизированное предложение
  • id: check
    name: Checker + authority
  • id: commit
    name: Записать результат
  • id: close
    name: Завершить invocation
  • id: pause
    name: Остановить / передать место
transitions:
  • from: signal
    to: coalesce
    guard: external causal delta; not own bookkeeping
    carries: bounded signal range
  • from: coalesce
    to: lease
    guard: eligible slot, budget available
    carries: watermark + requested binding revision
  • from: lease
    to: pack
    guard: unique live epoch
    carries: manager invocation ID
  • from: pack
    to: loop
    guard: required sources available
    carries: pinned context and remaining budget
  • from: loop
    to: tool
    guard: model proposes operation
    carries: typed arguments + evidence refs
  • from: tool
    to: check
    guard: syntax passes
    carries: proposal hash
  • from: check
    to: commit
    guard: current epoch/scope/basis valid
    carries: canonical command
  • from: check
    to: loop
    guard: refused with recoverable explanation, budget left
    carries: refusal receipt
  • from: commit
    to: loop
    guard: further bounded work remains
    carries: tool result + updated watermark facts
  • from: loop
    to: close
    guard: done/cap/no-model/unavailable
    carries: outcome + usage + remaining obligations
  • from: lease
    to: pause
    guard: rebind/revoke
    carries: incremented epoch
  • from: pause
    to: coalesce
    guard: new slot admitted
    carries: checkpoint + source cursor, no private vendor trajectory
rules:
  • Canonical roles are ceo / product-manager; manager is UI family label.
  • Old epoch cannot write after handoff. App off has no always-on promise.

interruptions:

    from:
    • signal
    • coalesce

    • pack
    • loop
    • tool
    • check
    • commit
    to: pause
    guard: revision/epoch invalidated under trusted serialization boundary
    carries: checkpointed obligations and operation receipts; committed effects are not undone
Наблюдение за агентом
id: health
name: Наблюдение за агентом
module: agents
trigger: Heartbeat, host observer tick or transport exit
dedup key: observer_id + session/run ref + observation sequence
states:
  • id: signal
    name: Положительный сигнал
  • id: fresh
    name: Свежие данные
  • id: stale
    name: Нет свежих данных
  • id: probe
    name: Проверка вне агента
  • id: unavailable
    name: Наблюдатель недоступен
  • id: failed
    name: Подтверждённый отказ
  • id: recover
    name: Решение о восстановлении
transitions:
  • from: signal
    to: fresh
    guard: identity and expected object match
    carries: heartbeat phase and timestamp
  • from: fresh
    to: stale
    guard: freshness deadline passed
    carries: last known signal, not inferred death
  • from: stale
    to: probe
    guard: host observer alive
    carries: PID/transport/lease query
  • from: probe
    to: fresh
    guard: positive observation
    carries: independent host evidence
  • from: probe
    to: unavailable
    guard: observer/source failed
    carries: unknown reason/source
  • from: probe
    to: failed
    guard: exit/crash proved
    carries: typed failure with causal refs
  • from: failed
    to: recover
    guard: operator or authorized recovery policy
    carries: bounded retry/cancel/handoff
  • from: recover
    to: signal
    guard: new admitted run alive
    carries: new task_run_id
rules:
  • Agent is not its own only monitor.
  • Every age uses observed time and declared TTL, not output volume.

Память и компиляция контекста
id: memory
name: Память и компиляция контекста
module: knowledge
trigger: Remember/observe/correct or context request
dedup key: command_id for writes; pack compilation request + input revisions
states:
  • id: capture
    name: Принять источник
  • id: redact
    name: Очистить и проверить scope
  • id: record
    name: Записать claim/observation
  • id: project
    name: Построить представление
  • id: retrieve
    name: Выбрать актуальные версии
  • id: compile
    name: Собрать pack
  • id: supply
    name: Передать исполнителю
  • id: correct
    name: Проверить новое основание
transitions:
  • from: capture
    to: redact
    guard: source attributed
    carries: bounded input + actor + trust
  • from: redact
    to: record
    guard: allowed payload
    carries: redacted event
  • from: record
    to: project
    guard: append committed
    carries: journal event sequence
  • from: project
    to: retrieve
    guard: query scoped
    carries: current facts with valid/recorded time
  • from: retrieve
    to: compile
    guard: source results known or explicit partial
    carries: selected refs + errors + omissions
  • from: compile
    to: supply
    guard: lockfile/hash saved
    carries: actual pack ID and content digest
  • from: supply
    to: correct
    guard: contradictory evidence/correction arrives
    carries: source_ref and expected version
  • from: correct
    to: record
    guard: authorized versioned supersession
    carries: new fact, never edit historical body
rules:
  • Pack tells what was supplied, not what the model internally retained.
  • Local/cloud routing and unavailable are visible; missing data is not an empty memory.

Сервисные инсайты и отправка
id: feedback
name: Сервисные инсайты и отправка
module: knowledge
trigger: Local service-category candidate
dedup key: stable feedback lineage ID for suppression; delivery attempt generation includes consent and schema revisions
states:
  • id: local
    name: Сохранить локально
  • id: minimize
    name: Сократить payload
  • id: review
    name: Проверить допустимость
  • id: pending
    name: Outbox pending
  • id: send
    name: Попытка отправки
  • id: ack
    name: Подтверждено сервером
  • id: suppress
    name: Отменено для отправки
  • id: unknown
    name: Исход неизвестен
transitions:
  • from: local
    to: minimize
    guard: category agents/harness/fabric only
    carries: candidate without raw identifiers
  • from: minimize
    to: review
    guard: closed allowlist schema
    carries: issue_code + coarse capability, no prose
  • from: review
    to: pending
    guard: export enabled and approved schema
    carries: consent-bound export record
  • from: pending
    to: send
    guard: consent still current at dispatch
    carries: idempotency key, minimized payload
  • from: send
    to: ack
    guard: durable server ack
    carries: remote receipt
  • from: send
    to: unknown
    guard: timeout after dispatch
    carries: attempt ID for reconciliation
  • from: pending
    to: suppress
    guard: opt-out/revoked consent
    carries: durable suppression tombstone
  • from: unknown
    to: ack
    guard: server confirms received
    carries: actual remote result, not fictional cancellation
  • from: unknown
    to: suppress
    guard: absence confirmed and consent off
    carries: suppression receipt
rules:
  • Local collection default on; outbound activation is a separately visible consent choice in proposed privacy ADR.
  • Re-enable does not backfill previously suppressed entries.
  • Free-text anonymous export is not promised safe; v1 default schema prohibits it.
  • Settings reset, schema upgrade and consent re-enable cannot recreate a suppressed lineage.

Зеркало и импорт конфигурации
id: sync
name: Зеркало и импорт конфигурации
module: continuity
trigger: Explicit export/check/import or drift signal
dedup key: manifest ID + source hash + import command ID
states:
  • id: read
    name: Прочитать источники
  • id: manifest
    name: Создать manifest покрытия
  • id: compare
    name: Сравнить hashes/revisions
  • id: conflict
    name: Показать конфликт
  • id: stage
    name: Проверить импорт целиком
  • id: commit
    name: Атомарно применить
  • id: receipt
    name: Показать результат
transitions:
  • from: read
    to: manifest
    guard: all declared sources accounted for
    carries: files + coverage + omissions
  • from: manifest
    to: compare
    guard: check requested
    carries: source/current/export digests
  • from: compare
    to: conflict
    guard: both sides diverged/foreign IDs
    carries: diff and blocked fields
  • from: compare
    to: stage
    guard: operator chooses import against expected revision
    carries: validated full batch
  • from: stage
    to: commit
    guard: scope/schema/revisions all match
    carries: single command batch or explicit staged protocol
  • from: commit

Задание, которое можно передать исполнителю

Крупные задачи содержат контракты, инварианты, отказы, миграцию и проверяемые случаи. Очевидные исправления сокращены до рецептов; уже поставленные механизмы отмечены «сохранить».

Новые архитектурные ADR остаются предложениями до предметного review. Текущий full CI baseline имеет открытый ACL gate P21. Спецификация не превращает эти ограничения в выполненную работу.

Выбранное решение

choice: Main derives Scope from registered webContents/window project selection or validated AgentSurface credential. A caller-provided estate/project is a requested object selector, never authority. Introduce scoped repository interfaces so schedulers cannot receive naked SupabaseClient. Keep local operator identity explicit; do not claim this completes authentication/team roles.
transactions:
  • For every command, re-read parent project/task/agent/session/repo membership under one scoped transaction; compare estate and project on all related IDs. Add composite identities UNIQUE(estate_id,id), UNIQUE(estate_id,project_id,id) where required and composite FK on v2 relationships. No UUID-shaped binding is admitted solely because it exists.
  • Local trusted main can supply system actor only from hardcoded scheduler capability, not renderer input. Task/result writers check execution lease+binding revision inside guarded RPC. Read queries always carry estate predicate, plus project predicate for project scope; no array of foreign IDs assembled by unscoped preliminary query.
filesystem: Per-window/per-project RootGrantSet, not global union. resolve(scope,root_ref,relative_path) resolves actual parent/target and enforces boundary at each operation. Native folder selection grants only that window/context; no widening other windows or agents. Existing realpath check protects static symlink escape but not an attacker replacing path components concurrently. Trusted-local profile may retain this stated limit; untrusted-repo profile requires dirfd/handle-relative no-follow opens or sandbox, and stays unadmitted until race fixture passes.
p21: CI run34070268253 at5051def, /tmp/fabric-priority-remote-full.log:2107 service_role SELECT pass; :2108 anon effective SELECT grants on estate_settings/proposals/question_blocks/questions/routines/task_handoffs fail. These six have RLS/member policies in migrations25/27/28/29. Therefore ACL mismatch is confirmed, row leakage is not. Migration26 grants desired roles but never explicitly revokes anon SELECT. Do not assert which bootstrap default caused CI difference. CI uses latest CLI and pulled postgres17.6.1.165 (log1415); pin measured CLI/image independently.

Инварианты

  • Test fixture estate never participates in another estate eligibility, counts, roots or journal writes.
  • Unauthorized object not found has same safe external result as absent object.
  • Scope credentials are not an OS sandbox; same-uid limitation CO090 remains explicit.

  • Window A requests task/project/binding from B → refusal before lookup details/side effect.
  • DB read fails → typed unavailable snapshot, never [] eligibility.
  • Root revoked while editor open → next operation refused; stale window does not retain authority.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Add an append-only ACL repair migration: explicitly REVOKE unwanted rights from anon/PUBLIC for app-owned tables, preserve named authenticated SELECT+member RLS and required service rights. Revoke future anon defaults for postgres and actual migration owner; inspect inherited PUBLIC grants. Do not strip required service DML until its writer migrates to typed RPC.
  • Split P21 wording/assertions into ACL capability vs RLS visibility. Add a migration-created temporary table fixture for each relevant owner/default set. Pin CLI/image or retain manifest recording exact versions; older migration comments remain historical evidence, not current causal explanation.
  • Backfill ownership from authoritative parent rows; report dangling/cross-scope legacy rows into deterministic projection_anomalies before constraint validation. v1 replay must remain readable and cannot abort on the newly enforced v2-only guard.

Выбранное решение

  • Move the estate/project predicate out of the call site: a table→scope map derived from the schema, and a client narrowed to one scope handed to every caller instead of the naked SupabaseClient. An unmapped table is refused rather than passed through.
  • Give the two projections that carried no owner one — goals and question_blocks — backfilled from the authoritative parent, with NOT NULL as the assertion rather than a silent drop.

Контракты и интерфейсы

  • shared/scope.ts: Scope, TABLE_SCOPE, scopeFilters(table,scope), scopeOwnership(table,scope), withinScope(scope,projectId).
  • main/scopedStore.ts: createScopedStore(db,scope) with select/insert/update/delete and no escape hatch; projectStore(db,parent,projectId) refuses a project outside the parent scope.

Инварианты

  • Every projection read in the main process is narrowed to one estate, and to one project where the scope names one.
  • A table absent from the map raises rather than returning an unnarrowed builder.
  • Scope columns are written on insert, but never the row's own primary key.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • Two-directional map/schema parity; predicate shape per scope kind; a planted question blocking a foreign task; a block row written for a task it cannot block.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Additive columns with parent backfill; the projector arm for goals is extracted to its own function rather than the monolith being rewritten.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Unknown table -> UnscopedTable naming the file to edit.
  • A read that lost its predicate -> the ratchet names file and line before merge.

Выбранное решение

  • Replace the single global root set with per-window/per-project grants, so a folder chosen in one context does not widen another window or an agent.
  • Keep the trusted-local profile's stated limit explicit: realpath defeats a static symlink, not an attacker swapping a path component concurrently.

Контракты и интерфейсы

  • main/files.ts: resolve(scope, rootRef, relativePath) enforcing the boundary at each operation rather than once at grant time.
  • root_grant projection {estate_id, project_id, window_context_id, root_ref, canonical_path, grant_revision, revoked_seq}.

Инварианты

  • A native folder selection grants that window only.
  • A revoked root refuses the next operation; an open editor does not retain authority.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • Two windows with a symlink from one root into the other; revoke while an editor is open; the component-swap race, which stays unadmitted until it passes.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Grants become rows rather than a process-lifetime set; dialog grants may remain local config and must not become estate authority by accident.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Root revoked mid-edit -> refusal, not a stale write.
  • Untrusted-repo profile -> refused as unsupported rather than silently weaker.

S02.acl · Отдельная поставка

Спецификация; реализация не выполнена этой итерацией

Экраны, сценарии и UX-контекст →

Зависит от: Независимое начало · Пакет: часть основной задачи

Выбранное решение

  • Revoke unintended anon/PUBLIC rights on app-owned tables explicitly, instead of relying on a default-privileges statement that only governs tables created afterwards.
  • Split the P21 assertion into ACL capability and RLS row visibility, because a passing grant check and an enforced policy are different claims and the log conflates them.

Контракты и интерфейсы

  • An append-only ACL repair migration; P21 reporting privilege and visibility separately, each with its own positive control.

Инварианты

  • service role reads every app table; anon holds no SELECT privilege; an authenticated member sees their estate and not another's.
  • Granting anon SELECT inside a rolled-back fixture still yields zero rows, which is what proves RLS separately.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • Role matrix over an isolated migrated database; a temporary table per relevant owner/default set.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Additive revocation; required service DML is not stripped before its writer moves to typed RPC.

Отказы и восстановление

  • A missing grant looks exactly like an empty table, which is the failure this repair exists to stop recurring.
  • CLI/image drift changes the inherited default; the manifest records the measured versions rather than asserting a cause.

Выбранное решение

split: S03.boundary supplies shared per-command scope/floor/revision/grant reservation. S03.effects adds actual adapter dispatch, attempts, observations and unknown reconciliation. S04/S06 require boundary, not a finished external connector.
states:
  • Grant: available → reserved(command_id) → consumed(at dispatch fence); available/reserved → revoked; expiry blocks new reservation/dispatch. Release reservation only with proof no dispatch occurred, by explicit command.
  • EffectIntent: proposed → reserved → dispatching → succeeded | failed_known | outcome_unknown. reserved → cancelled_before_dispatch. outcome_unknown is unresolved, not success; reconciliation creates new evidence and resolves it. Terminal result receipts immutable.
transactions:
  • issueGrant preallocates grant UUID and appends grant.issued@2 with full scope/action/target/revision/expiry; projection built in same transaction. reserveEffect locks grant and effect command, checks DB now<expiry, revoked_at=null, project/action/target exact match, precondition/current revisions, all ceilings minimum and absolute floor; unique reservation grants at most one command. Refusal carries safe reason, never executed.
  • beginEffectDispatch checks current principal fence, policy revision, grant not revoked/expired, budget and reservation; records attempt + dispatch_started and consumes grant before releasing transaction. External call occurs only after commit. A one-shot grant authorizes the logical effect; adapter retries use same effect idempotency key, not a second consumption.
  • observeEffect requires trusted adapter/reconciler capability, matching attempt/provider effect ref and structured evidence; agent prose is a claim. Commit observed outcome + receipt atomically. Crash after effect but before receipt → unknown; lookup provider by same key/ref, never new key retry.
  • Release and beginDispatch take the same grant/reservation lock. Release succeeds only while every recorded attempt proves not dispatched; absence of a final receipt is not proof. The old intent retains reservation/grant lineage. A subsequent command acquires a new reservation UUID; concurrent new commands have one winner under the partial unique index.
redaction: Replace free-text authority target with {resource_ref,operation,canonical_target_digest}; secret-bearing target input is refused, not normalized into a different permission. Human-readable why may be redacted with count receipt. Safe sink runs in Policy/command ingress, not only AgentSurface. Never persist raw OAuth/bearer/secret material in a trace.

Контракты и интерфейсы

new files:
  • apps/desktop/src/main/authorityCommands.ts:issueGrant,reserveEffect,beginEffectDispatch,observeEffect
  • apps/desktop/src/main/effectDispatcher.ts:dispatchReservedEffect,reconcileEffect
tables:
  • grants_v2 projection: id,estate_id,project_id,action_class,floor_class,target_ref,target_digest,issued_by,issued_seq,expires_at,grant_revision,revoked_seq,status,reserved_command_id; UNIQUE(estate_id,id)
  • effect_intents_v2: command_id PK,estate_id,project_id,action_class,target_ref,target_digest,policy_revision,grant_id,reservation_epoch,state,last_receipt_seq; reservation_id FK; grant_id lineage is not globally unique across released reservations
  • effect_attempts: attempt_id PK,command_id,attempt_no,adapter_revision,idempotency_key,dispatch_started_seq,provider_effect_ref,status,observation_ref; UNIQUE(command_id,attempt_no); same target idempotency key across retries
  • grant_reservations: reservation_id PK, estate_id, grant_id, command_id, state:'reserved'|'consumed'|'released'|'revoked', revision, release_proof_ref, acquired_seq, released_seq; immutable lineage, event-derived status. UNIQUE(grant_id) WHERE state IN ('reserved','consumed','revoked'); released reservations keep their rows. revoked grant remains unusable regardless of uniqueness.
commands:
  • GrantIssue({scopeSubject,actionClass,targetRef,expiresAt,preconditions}) → grant receipt
  • EffectReserve({actionClass,targetRef,expectedPolicyRevision}) → {effectCommandId,reservationRef} | refusal
  • EffectDispatch({effectCommandId,expectedEpoch}) → durable dispatch permit, no success claim
  • EffectObserve({effectCommandId,attemptId,providerReceipt,outcome}) → observed receipt
  • EffectReconcile({effectCommandId}) → succeeded|failed_known|still_unknown; EffectCancel → cancel_requested|cancelled_before_dispatch
  • ReleaseGrantReservation({reservation_id,expected_revision,no_dispatch_proof_ref}) → canonical CommandResult<GrantReservation>. Lock reservation + grant + intent; require cancelled_before_dispatch and no possibly-dispatched attempt; append released receipt atomically. If grant expired/revoked keep it unusable; otherwise restore available. Consumed/unknown cannot release.

Инварианты

  • The DB floor validates matching live grant, not merely nonnull FK.
  • A permission receipt cannot produce effect.executed.
  • Revocation after dispatch does not erase or mislabel an already completed external effect.
  • Cooperative MCP alone remains trusted-local tier, not mandatory CLI interception/sandbox.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Reservation expiry/revoke between reserve and begin → no dispatch.
  • Timeout after provider acted → retain reservation/unknown, reconcile before replay.
  • Two grant requests from distinct projects/actions with same target → only exact granted scope succeeds.

Миграция и совместимость

  • No historical journal rewrite. Existing grant.issued@1 lacks grant UUID and current direct row may be unjoinable: mark legacy_unverified, preserve records, do not automatically promote unspent legacy grants to v2 authority. Require explicit reissue with exact action/scope.
  • Existing effect.executed@1 produced by permission path is displayed as legacy claim/unverified unless independent evidence proves completion; add classification projection, not retroactive invented receipts.
  • Switch both operator and agent effect paths to shared v2 commands in same release; legacy generic writer rejects v2 guarded types; minimum compatible writer version prevents downgrade.

Выбранное решение

choice: Introduce startExistingTask; createTask and admitTaskLaunch are separate commands. Routine may create its own task once per unique cycle window, chain must launch the existing follower. Resolve actual runner through scoped binding before quota/admission. TaskRun is created after admission as an explicit logical invocation, never because a button was pressed or an unrelated predecessor completed.
states:
  • AdmissionReceipt: refused or admitted; refused has no TaskRun.
  • TaskRun: admitted → launching → active → ending → ended; admitted/launching → ended(failed_start/cancelled_before_launch); active → ending(cancel_requested) → ended only on invocation/process evidence. ended is immutable. Outcome unknown is retained as uncertainty, not inferred success.
  • Task Board status stays backlog/review until agent acceptance; attached/launching is an execution indicator. On ack, task enters running; structured completed result submits review, never auto-done. Legacy delivery-unconfirmed displays live process beside unchanged task state.
transactions:
  • admitTaskLaunch(scope, key, task, expected_task_rev, trigger): under estate lock validate scope, nonterminal task, allowed explicit transition, all open blockers, pinned graph links/needs, runner capability/profile, current role_slot_id/binding_revision/epoch, fresh provider/account quota snapshot, total budget reservation and no active TaskRun. Allocate task_run_id/run_ordinal, task lease/fence and launch outbox; append admitted and return same receipt on duplicates.
  • Join must group ALL incoming follows edges for follower; require each relevant predecessor terminal accepted result plus every named required output. Store chosen predecessor TaskRun/result/artifact refs in launch input lockfile. A failed/cancelled predecessor blocks with one durable eligibility-state reason, not one event every tick. Ambiguous duplicate names across parents must be explicit qualified input keys, not last-object-write wins.
  • linkTasks validates scope and DAG under SAME transaction lock as append; graph traversal excludes mere provenance spawned links from dependency cycle topology unless their contract declares execution dependence. Opposite edges racing serialize; unknown/RPC error refuses. Pin graph version/as-of input; later edits affect future WorkflowRuns or explicit replans, never an already pinned execution invisibly.
  • Local runner dispatch occurs after outbox receipt. Mark launch_attempt before invoking adapter. Crash between marker and physical launch leaves unknown; discover by stable task_run_id/supervisor receipt. Without authoritative lookup, do not automatically spawn again; explicit retry after reconciliation creates a new TaskRun/key linked to predecessor.
quota: QuotaSnapshot includes provider/account/binding revision, observedAt/expiresAt, completeness, validated numeric windows, source and limits. HTTP200 {} is unknown. Unattended admission requires a policy-approved complete source or an explicitly configured alternative capped budget profile; manual attendance relaxes advisory quota only with recorded override, never scope/floor/capability. Reserve Fabric budgets atomically; vendor account activity outside Fabric means quota is a sampled admission signal, not a guarantee of global spend.

Контракты и интерфейсы

  • apps/desktop/src/main/launchCommands.ts:createTask,admitTaskLaunch,cancelTaskRun
  • apps/desktop/src/main/launchDispatcher.ts:dispatchLaunch,reconcileLaunch
  • apps/desktop/src/main/runnerPort.ts:RunnerPort

  • apps/desktop/src/shared/launchAdmission.ts:evaluateAdmission
schema:
  • task_runs projection {task_run_id PK,estate_id,project_id,task_id,run_ordinal,workflow_run_id?,node_occurrence_id?,loop_iteration_ref?,fabric_session_id?,native_ref?,launch_command_id UNIQUE,predecessor_task_run_id?,state,outcome,role_slot_id,binding_revision,lease_epoch,config_ref,graph_ref,policy_ref,input_lockfile,budget_reservation,admitted_seq,ended_seq}; UNIQUE(task_id,run_ordinal); unique active task guard by transactional task lease
  • launch_outbox {task_run_id UNIQUE,command_id,dispatch_state,dispatch_attempt_id,owner_host_generation,lease_epoch,last_receipt_seq}; no authoritative process success in outbox state alone
commands:
  • admitTaskLaunch({taskId,expectedRevision,triggerRef,requestedRunnerRef,attendance}) → {taskRunId,launchState:admitted}
  • RunnerPort.launch({taskRunId,pinnedBinding,inputRef,deliveryId,fence}) → started|failed_start|outcome_unknown; callback observeReady/observeAccepted/observeEnded
  • linkTasks({fromTaskId,toTaskId,rel,needs,expectedGraphRevision}) → edge receipt | cycle path refusal

Инварианты

  • One logical launch key yields one TaskRun, one default active invocation per task.
  • A task run ordinal increments only after committed admission; retries of transport do not consume a number.
  • Native session reuse requires per-invocation mapping/ack/trace; CLI without this capability launches a fresh PTY.
  • No port declares durable profile merely because dispatch is persisted.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Process starts but journal response lost → discover same TaskRun; no createTask fallback.
  • Runner binding belongs another project, quota sampled for another account, stale config → no admission.
  • Dependency edited after pin → current TaskRun uses pinned inputs or explicit pause/replan, not silent mixed graph.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Add v2 task_runs/command/outbox projections and RPC first, migrate main IPC/research/routine/chain entrypoints to one port together, then disable direct guarded task launch events through generic append.
  • Retain @1 task.started/session.attached semantics and build legacy history separately. Preallocate new task_run_id before adapter call, keep old session_id unchanged. A structured adapter can attach multiple sequential TaskRuns to one native session; legacy mapper cannot infer unseen iterations.
  • Keep old Task.status enum; add execution indicators/DTO fields so launching does not pretend running. M103 supplies acceptance protocol; temporary legacy mode explicitly unconfirmed.

Выбранное решение

choice: Instrument transport + central tool dispatcher so read, mutation, schema refusal, thrown handler, retries and cancellation share one attempt identity. Business receipts remain their own events. Do not infer a tool-call count from domain events.
transactions:
  • At authenticated parsed tools/call ingress allocate trace_id and attempt_id before tool schema validation. Record safe start with tool/version/protocol/request correlation; finalizer records exactly one terminal transport outcome. MCP SDK validation occurs before some callbacks, so handler-only wrapper is insufficient: trace the request/response adapter boundary at AgentSurface.handle and pass attempt context into domain gateway.
  • Invocation outcome is separate from HTTP status: JSON-RPC error/isError/refused/committed/unknown/cancelled. Nested command ids link to domain receipt. Same logical command repeated creates new transport attempt trace but reuses original command receipt.
  • Mutation must commit domain receipt even if optional trace sink unavailable; return traceCoverage partial. Failed diagnostic sink appends a bounded local redacted gap marker and later recovered original observed times. Once buffer fills, increment lost_count with first/last interval; never claim full corpus. Reads may still answer with gap flag.
privacy: Persist allowlisted metadata, normalized error code, typed safe summary and content ref/hash only where approved. No raw args/results/transcripts by default; target/basis refs with scope checks. Unknown/bad token is unscoped authentication diagnostic without raw token. Rate-limit pre-auth diagnostics; event types/catalog cannot loop into their own tracing.

Контракты и интерфейсы

new files:
  • apps/desktop/src/main/toolTrace.ts:beginAttempt,finishAttempt
  • apps/desktop/src/main/diagnosticSpool.ts:recordGap,flushRecovered
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/toolOutcome.ts:ToolAttemptOutcome
schema:
  • tool_attempts projection {trace_id,attempt_id PK,estate_id?,project_id?,task_run_id?,fabric_session_id?,request_id,command_id?,tool_name,tool_schema_version,protocol_revision,binding_revision?,lease_epoch?,start_at,finish_at,outcome,domain_receipt_refs,duration_ms,redaction_counts,coverage}; UNIQUE(attempt_id,terminal_kind) via one lifecycle
  • trace_gap {gap_id,host_generation,source,first_observed,last_observed,unknown_or_count,reason,closed_at}; it reports missing observations, not fabricated calls
interface:
  • withToolAttempt(context, invoke): Promise<{result, traceRef, traceCoverage}>
  • TraceOutcome=returned|refused|schema_error|threw|cancel_requested|cancelled_observed|response_unknown; result_summary never raw payload

Инварианты

  • Every admitted Fabric request attempt is countable; unknown failed ingress is labeled separately.
  • One request may cause N domain events; those do not multiply tool count.
  • Trace incompleteness survives recovery and excludes affected intervals from claimed complete eval corpus.

Отказы и восстановление

  • MCP schema rejects before handler → terminal schema_error exists.
  • Caller disconnects after committed mutation → domain committed, response delivery unknown.
  • DB down → local gap; future reconnect not a retrospective invented complete trace.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Add trace event types + projection and safe versioned envelope without changing existing domain @1.
  • Update surfaceTools metadata and eval readers to actual trace coverage. No backfill of missing read tool invocations from historical journal.
  • Existing transcript redactor reused as defense; typed allowlist is primary minimization. Trace retention and local max bytes/time configurable and measured, not arbitrary forever.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

    expected: one attempt id each; actual outcome; command receipts deduped independently

    status: proposed_not_executed
  • name: trace-gap
    inputs: sink fails start or finish, then buffer overflow and recovery
    expected: coverage partial and gap interval/count, no invented terminal success
    harness: fault injected sink
    status: proposed_not_executed
  • name: safe-trace
    inputs: nested synthetic secret in why/error/result and unknown bearer
    expected: secret absent in persistent records/console; safe refs preserved
    harness: sink capture
    status: proposed_not_executed

Выбранное решение

choice: Question owns immutable revisioned subject/options; many-to-many blocking set is canonical. blocked_by remains only compatibility summary (earliest active blocker), never launch guard. Answer and decision fact are one typed command and transaction. Delivery uses committed continuation outbox; does not wait for full M188 steps.
states:
  • Question open(revision) → answered(resolution_id) | withdrawn(reason) | stale(reason). Terminal resolution cannot overwrite; ask a new question for a new subject or revised decision.
  • Block relation active while its question open; resolution removes only that relation from active-set query. Task status remains its rung.
  • Continuation pending → addressed → delivered_unconfirmed | accepted | expired/superseded/unknown; independent from answer committed.
transactions:
  • answerQuestion(scope,key,questionId,expectedRevision,answer,chosenOption,basis): lock question and sorted blocked tasks; validate scope, open status, about/subject revision, current option set, principal role and floor via S03.boundary. CEO/product-manager settlement checks current cite/trust/criticality in same command, never caller assertion.
  • Allocate decision_id/resolution_id once; append memory.project.recorded@2 and question.answered@2 plus block resolution and continuation-request events in one transaction. Use actual memory event vocabulary, not nonexistent memory.remembered. Commit receipt returns both references and remaining blockers per task. Crash rolls back all; duplicate key returns both same IDs.
  • Recompute active blockers by join questions.status=open; order asked_at then question id. Set blocked_by/blocked_since from earliest remaining, null only count=0. Wake/continuation outbox for newly unblocked task only after commit and only once per resolution/task; do not start task when another blocker exists.

Контракты и интерфейсы

new files:
  • apps/desktop/src/main/questionCommands.ts:askQuestion,answerQuestion,withdrawQuestion
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/questionResolution.ts:validateAnswer
  • apps/desktop/src/main/continuationQueue.ts:enqueueCommittedAnswer
schema:
  • questions add revision,subject_revision,resolution_id,updated_seq; question_resolutions {resolution_id PK,question_id UNIQUE,command_id UNIQUE,decision_id UNIQUE,question_revision,actor_ref,basis_refs,answered_seq}
  • question_blocks add estate_id,project_id; PK(question_id,task_id), composite FK to same estate/project task+question; blocking set query/index(question_id,status)/(task_id,question_id)
  • continuations {continuation_id PK,source_resolution_id,task_id,source_task_run_id?,recipient_task_run_id?,delivery_id?,state}; UNIQUE(source_resolution_id,task_id)
commands:
  • QuestionAsk({taskId?,text,whyBlocked,kind,about,subjectRevision,options,blocks[]}) → question id/revision
  • QuestionAnswer({questionId,expectedRevision,answer,chosenOption?,basisRefs?}) → {resolutionId,decisionId,remainingBlockers:[{taskId,count}],continuations[]}
  • QuestionWithdraw({questionId,expectedRevision,reason}) → resolution receipt; does not invent a decision fact

Инварианты

  • Answer→decision→unblock is one logical commit, delivery is a separate acknowledged effect.
  • No answer to stale subject/options/revision, no second answer overwrite.
  • No per-session question count cap; hygiene may group duplicate obligations but cannot delete them.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Two questions on task, answer first → still blocked by second.
  • Question resolved by colleague while operator edits → stale_revision with current state, no overwritten answer.
  • Recipient execution ended after commit → continuation remains addressed to task/new admitted TaskRun, not last open terminal.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Backfill blocker estate/project from both parents and quarantine invalid legacy links without rewriting journal. Replace apply_questions with deterministic recomputation compatible with @1; add v2 branch for explicit resolution id.
  • Keep legacy answered questions without decision_id as legacy_missing_decision, not fabricate an answer fact; UI indicates gap. New writes require atomic decision link.
  • Revoke direct table DML and raw guarded question answer events after all callers switch. M152.commit builds on this; M152.continue additionally consumes S04/M103.

    status: proposed_not_executed

    inputs: fault after fact append before resolution inside SQL transaction
    expected: 0 committed partial records; retry same key returns one complete pair
    harness: isolated SQL + fake ports
    status: proposed_not_executed
  • name: stale-answer
    inputs: expected rev1 but subject/options now rev2 or answered
    expected: refused stale_revision; old decision unchanged
    harness: isolated SQL + fake ports
    status: proposed_not_executed
  • name: mixed-blocks
    inputs: A question blocks B task or inaccessible task
    expected: refused before append, no foreign task id disclosed
    harness: isolated SQL + fake ports
    status: proposed_not_executed
  • name: continuation-target
    inputs: answer committed while session A exits and unrelated B active
    expected: no bytes to B; pending task-addressed continuation persists
    harness: isolated SQL + fake ports
    status: proposed_not_executed

Выбранное решение

  • Разделить подготовку release pipeline и разрешение распространения конкретной сборки. Build identity генерировать при сборке из checkout/lockfile/schema/contract pins; installed runtime читает встроенный manifest, а не git текущего каталога.
  • CI запускается в чистом checkout. Зафиксировать Supabase CLI и digest локального Postgres image в release toolchain.lock.json после получения версии из успешно прошедшего fresh+upgrade matrix. Текущий latest не является воспроизводимым pin; версия не выбирается по памяти.
  • Собирать macOS arm64 пакет на соответствующем runner. Smoke через тестовый profile + test estate + запрет scheduler auto-start; не наследовать userData/.env/default credentials. Проверить все типы окон и bridge внутри реально упакованного приложения.
  • До публикации: migration from-empty, upgrade previous supported schema, replay parity включая config_revision, восстановление backup в отдельный DB, проверка прав для anon/authenticated/service_role и cross-estate direct SQL/RPC. Fresh P21 на 5051def красный: это open release gate S02, не доказанная утечка строк.

Контракты и интерфейсы

  • BuildManifest@1 {build_id, commit_sha, source_dirty:false, built_at_utc, app_version, lockfile_sha256, schema_min, schema_max, journal_read_versions, adapter_contract_revision, toolchain_digest, files:[{relative_path,sha256,size_bytes}]}
  • meta.info(): {installed: BuildManifest, runtime_schema, compatibility: compatible|read_only|incompatible, reason_code}; manifest query never reads repository HEAD.
  • ReleaseEvidence {build_id, fresh_acl_probe, fresh_rls_probe, upgrade_probe, replay_probe, restore_probe, packaged_smoke, artifact_sha256}; every receipt names source SHA/environment and command exit.

Инварианты

  • Unknown schema/version does not migrate automatically; compatible read-only mode only if explicitly declared by manifest.
  • Backward rollback is application rollback within declared schema window; never silently down-migrate append-only journal.
  • Install, verify and pilot observed remain independent statuses.
  • Desktop renderer sandbox does not imply spawned CLI isolation.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Corrupt artifact byte -> checksum fail before install.
  • Offline update download -> retain current installed version, resumable retry, no version change.
  • Upgrade fails halfway -> transaction rollback; if migration crosses nontransactional external store, restore verified backup into new database and switch endpoint only after checksum/health checks.
  • Native app smoke without test profile/test estate must abort before invoking any scheduler.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Add manifest generation and About reader first; toolchain pin committed after measured matrix. Version migration is append-only. Maintain old appId/userData paths; display brand changes do not migrate data directories.
  • Signing/notarization credentials are delivery environment inputs, never repo values. Missing credentials blocks public distribution only; unsigned test artifact can be inspected as such.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • Run bash scripts/ci.sh fast and full on clean CI; expected direct exit0. Full currently fails P21 so artifact remains not releasable.
  • Build twice with same source/toolchain and compare identity inputs and file checksums excluding declared nondeterministic signing timestamps; report differences, do not claim reproducible build unless byte comparison passes.
  • Use one archived test fixture of previous supported DB; create task/decision/question/run, upgrade, restart, restore -> IDs, event order, bodies and receipt relations equal.

S08 · Один полный рабочий цикл и второй исполнитель Глубокая спецификация

Спецификация; реализация не выполнена этой итерацией

Экраны, сценарии и UX-контекст →

Зависит от: S04 · S05 · M152 · M188 · M176 · Пакет: F6

Выбранное решение

  • Контрольный продуктовый цикл — fixture HTTP service с заранее внесённым дефектом; observer измеряет ответ, записывает observation, manager предлагает repair task, checker разрешает узкое изменение, worker исправляет, независимый process повторяет HTTP+regression probe и сохраняет receipt, manager обновляет решение/память и ставит следующий check.
  • Один corpus, одинаковые policy/context pins и два адаптера исполнителей; начать с Claude Code и Codex только после версии/capabilities conformance каждого. Сравнение делается по результату и вмешательствам, без переноса private session state.
  • Фиксировать safety как обязательный набор pass/fail, quality как явно оценённые критерии; cost/latency наблюдения, а не основания ослабить запрет. Seeded negative controls проверяют и executor, и judge.

Контракты и интерфейсы

  • LoopFixture@1 {case_id,seed,service_fixture_hash,initial_observation,expected_change_scope,forbidden_effects,verification_command,expected_result,context_pack_hash,policy_revision}
  • LoopResult {case_id,runner_revision,workflow_run_id,task_run_ids,observation_refs,decision_refs,artifact_refs,verification_receipts,interventions,usage:{known,unknown},wall_time_ms,outcome:verified|failed|inconclusive}

Инварианты

  • Worker cannot be sole verifier of its own output.
  • A task done claim and exit0 do not mark project outcome verified.
  • Runner comparison excludes unavailable telemetry rather than filling it with zeros.
  • Unknown native checkpoint/resume ability is unsupported capability, not an emulated guarantee.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Observer unavailable -> inconclusive, no fabricated incident.
  • Worker edits outside fixture -> checker deny, trial failed even if HTTP repaired.
  • Verifier planted always-pass implementation must fail negative control.
  • Swap runner with missing continuation capability -> handoff via fresh TaskRun/context, explicit continuity boundary.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Add fixture and deterministic fake adapter before paid trials. External trials activate only with S03 effects, scoped credentials and approved test resource. Keep historical run bindings pinned; new candidate changes future runs.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • Plant HTTP500 and unrelated missing endpoint: repair case must pass, wrong-target case must fail.
  • Replay every candidate trace twice: scoring and causality unchanged.
  • Run same fixture across two admitted runner revisions; save distributions and counts, no universal model superiority claim from a small sample.

S09 · Командный доступ и первый полезный результат Глубокая спецификация

Спецификация; реализация не выполнена этой итерацией

Экраны, сценарии и UX-контекст →

Зависит от: S07 · S08 · M185 · Пакет: F6

Выбранное решение

  • Сохранить estate как tenant boundary и owner/member как начальную минимальную модель. Identity берётся из проверенной auth-сессии на server-side command boundary, actor_id из renderer не принимается. Owner управляет membership/agent binding/grants; member читает дозволенное и создаёт/ведёт проектные задачи, но не выдаёт себе полномочий.
  • В v1 membership даёт estate-wide project visibility. Project-only/private memberships не имитировать фильтром renderer: это отдельная будущая capability; текущий owner/member интерфейс явно показывает estate scope.
  • Onboarding минимален: создать/выбрать estate → подключить или создать project/repository → проверить readiness выбранного исполнителя → создать первую задачу → открыть результат и receipt. Полная организация/все настройки не обязательны. Return journey начинается с addressed Inbox и изменений после lastSeen.
  • Revocation увеличивает membership revision и делает новые команды недопустимыми. Действующая команда повторно проверяет authority перед внешним dispatch; активная executor lease отменяется/ограничивается при отзыве. Уже выполненный эффект не стирается.

Контракты и интерфейсы

  • ActorContext {person_id,estate_id,membership_role,membership_revision,session_expiry}; создан доверенным verifier, не IPC payload.
  • MembershipCommand {command_id,expected_revision,target_person_id,role:owner|member,action:invite|accept|revoke}; output {status:committed|conflict|refused,receipt_ref}. Invite: random single-use token hash only, expiry, intended identity, audited acceptance.
  • OnboardingState {estate_id?,project_id?,repo_status:absent|checking|ready|error,runner_status:unknown|checking|ready|unavailable,first_task_id?,last_completed_step}; settings persisted atomically per user.

Инварианты

  • Последнего owner нельзя отозвать; передача требует атомарного добавления нового owner.
  • Повтор invite accept с тем же command_id возвращает прежний receipt, не повторную membership.
  • Профиль человека не является источником authorization.
  • Funnel events являются локальными/estate operational observations, а не автоматической отправкой analytics наружу.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Revoke between read and write -> revision conflict; operation not executed.
  • Member accesses foreign estate through guessed task ID -> uniform scoped not_found/refused without object disclosure.
  • Two tabs accept invite -> one transaction wins, second idempotent result.
  • Failed runner setup keeps project/repo and entered instruction; retry readiness, not recreate project.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Existing local owner is migrated only through verified account-link confirmation; never match people by display_name. Keep service identity separate from person membership.
  • User-facing invite/send needs recipient and delivery choice in implementation run; do not send invitations as part of this documentation change.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • Two synthetic authenticated identities: owner allowed grant, member denied same; after revoke old token denied even with cached UI.
  • Last-owner concurrent revoke -> both cannot succeed.
  • Onboarding fixture from empty and returning project; duplicate create click yields one project; result deep-link restored after restart.

Нет элементов
S10 · Термины и доказательства с одним источником Глубокая спецификация

Спецификация; реализация не выполнена этой итерацией

Экраны, сценарии и UX-контекст →

Зависит от: Независимое начало · Пакет: F2

Выбранное решение

  • Две независимые правды: нормативное целевое устройство (this system-contract + domain dossiers + model JSON) и состояние реализации (code pins + probe receipts + backlog). Diagram генерируется из model JSON, а не редактируется отдельно. Per-card engineering catalog связывает каждую текущую карточку с контрактом/обоснованием/tests/files.
  • Уточнить термины WorkflowRun / TaskRun / Session / CycleInvocation / ExecutionAttempt / Iteration до реализации M188 и M194. Новые предлагаемые семантики записать в новых ADR; старые записи не править. Принятие новой ADR запускает propagation CONTEXT/architecture/schema examples/UX/contracts in one change.
  • Read statuses, execution statuses, decision claims и independent verification — разные типы. Запретить общий done как измерение проекта без источника. Exact event type IDs берутся из versioned registry, proposed IDs маркируются до регистрации.
  • Генератор карты и checker проверяют coverage, IDs, links, meaningful edge payloads, allowed lifecycle transitions, graph cycle exceptions, source fingerprints. Семантический review всё ещё обязателен: gate не понимает правильность бизнес-решения.

Контракты и интерфейсы

  • SystemModel@1 {modules,entities,relations,flows,cycles,decisions,sources}; Catalog@1 {input_plan,items,execution_nodes,dependency_edges,requirements}; generated HTML never owns a domain fact.
  • ImplementationEvidence {capability_id,design_status,implementation_status,verification_status,installation_status,observation_status,receipts[]}; no single averaged readiness score.

Инварианты

  • All57 source cards accounted for including shipped preserve rows; do not silently reimplement shipped foundations.
  • All proposed API/schema names labeled future; paths to create distinct from current evidence paths.
  • Rejected/pre-admission work is not a successful or failed runtime iteration.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Remove task from catalog -> coverage gate red.
  • Edit diagram without model -> generated-output parity red.
  • Unknown event claimed implemented -> source evidence check/review red.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Introduce target design as explicit recommended baseline; implementation retains existing wire until versioned migration. Historical audit snapshots keep dates/source commit and link forward to current target.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • Run node scripts/check-system-model.mjs and builder --check; negative fixtures remove card, reference absent node/source and stale output -> fail.
  • Review every proposed semantic reversal against ADR0030/0042/0043/0041/0018 before marking accepted; implementation agents execute specified migration not choose ontology.

S12 · Восстановление данных и честный sync contract Глубокая спецификация

Спецификация; реализация не выполнена этой итерацией

Экраны, сценарии и UX-контекст →

Зависит от: S02 · M198 · S14 · Пакет: F1

current state

observed_defects_plus_planned_backup

Предлагаемые API

  • apps/desktop/src/shared/storageContract.ts: StorageInventory, MirrorManifestV2, ImportPlan, OperationReceipt (new)
  • apps/desktop/src/main/workspace.ts: readEstate(scope), writeWorkspaceSnapshot, previewImport, commitImport
  • new SQL RPC import_declared_snapshot and operation/projectors; version/name reserve during implementation
  • apps/desktop/src/main/storageRecovery.ts: backupEstate, verifyArchive, rebuildProjection (new)

Контракты и интерфейсы

MirrorManifestV2: {format:'fabric-declared-mirror',schemaVersion:2,estateId,sourceCursor,projectionVersion,generatedAt,coverage:[{entityType,fields,mode:'complete'|'partial'|'excluded',reason?}],files:[{relativePath,sha256,bytes}],counts,contentDigest}
ImportPlan: {operationId,commandId,targetEstateId,inputDigest,formatVersion,expectedTargetRevision,mode:'empty-estate',idPolicy:'preserve',validation:{ok,errors[]},entityCounts,coverage,missingRelations[],pathRebindings:[{repoId,oldPath,newLocalPath|null}],expiresAt}
CommitImport: {commandId,planId,previewDigest,expectedTargetRevision}; result OperationReceipt{status:'committed'|'rejected'|'conflict'|'unknown',operationId,commitCursor,counts,sourceDigest}; parse JSON/XML? no: allow only versioned known YAML/manifest and schema
BackupArchive: {formatVersion,estateId,backupId,snapshotCursor,consistencyToken,journalSchemaVersions[],projectorVersion,createdAt,canonicalEventCount,identitySnapshot:{membershipRevision,actorRefs,roleAssignments,sha256,coverage},operationalSnapshot:{tableVersions,reservations,effectAttempts,deliveryDedup,outboxes,consent,suppressionTombstones,cursors,sha256,coverage},blobs:[{contentRef,sha256,bytes,classification}],coverage,archiveDigest,verification}. One consistent DB snapshot or proven shared consistency boundary; referenced blobs verified against immutable hashes. No credentials/session tokens. Restore only empty isolated target; no merge mode. Missing identity/operational coverage blocks full-restorable claim.
StorageRead: ReadEnvelope<{authority,endpointIdentitySafe,projectionVersion,mirror:{status:'not_configured'|'current'|'diverged'|'failed',sourceCursor,lastSuccessfulAt,coverage},backup:{status,lastVerifiedAt,coverage},operation:OperationReceipt|null}>
RecoveryActivation: Command<{recoveryOperationId,expected_revision,verifiedArchiveDigest,currentAuthorityReceipt,reconciledIntentRefs,newEnvironmentId}> → CommandResult<{recoveryGeneration:Revision,activeCapabilities,heldCapabilities}>. Current trusted identity/control plane issues a fresh generation independent of the restored archive and fences old writers. Without current authority proof, restoration remains read-only. Pending effects/deliveries/exports remain held unless individually reconciled and freshly admitted.

Алгоритм

  • Read scope from S02, obtain consistent snapshot and sourceCursor in one DB read transaction. Coverage explicitly lists assets/membership/goals/autonomy/agent bindings/human decisions+their relation pointers; unsupported entity is partial and blocks 'all declared restorable' claim.
  • Mirror writer renders deterministic allowlisted files to sibling temporary generation directory, fsync files, writes manifest LAST as generation commit marker, atomically replace manifest pointer; readers validate all hashes to avoid mixed generations. Existing user divergence preview before overwrite; no auto git commit/push.
  • Import v2 fully parse+schema validate+cross-ref validate+duplicate ID check+payload size bound before write. Server-side operation reserves scope+command key and rechecks target empty under estate lock. Execute bounded batch in ONE SQL transaction, append existing domain events needed to preserve status/settings/relations plus durable import receipt; crash beforecommit no partial estate. Larger archive returns IMPORT_TOO_LARGE with no writes, not silent chunk mode.
  • Legacy two-file import reads v1 with explicit partial coverage warning; uses same atomic command; cannot advertise restoration of absent goals/decisions. Path strings stay evidence; mappings checked local roots before executable use.
  • Restore journal, identity membership/role assignments, durable operational reservations/dedup/delivery/outbox/consent/suppression/cursors and required immutable blobs under a coherent snapshot. Restore is isolated, all dispatch/schedulers/export held. Old archive may predate rebind, opt-out or successful send: first obtain fresh recovery authority generation from the current trusted control plane and fence old environments; never trust restored grants or credential epochs as live authority. Reconcile possibly dispatched intents with provider receipts; unknown stays held. Reauthorize current membership, bindings and pending work through normal admission. Outbound consent resets off/quarantined; restored candidates/outbox never become sendable through activation alone; revalidate current suppression or retain quarantine. No current authority/suppression proof means read-only recovery, not success-by-default.
  • M198 scoped rebuild uses new projection generation/staging and parity check against live expected fixture, activation pointer last; other estates untouched. Failure leaves old generation readable and operation failed; rollback chooses previous generation, not undo journal history.

Инварианты

  • A target is empty for selected estate, not 'no projects anywhere'. Different estate rows neither block preview nor get exported.
  • Import status archived/done/settings/relations preserved through versioned semantics; never synthesize new IDs for matching existing entities.
  • No partial default fallback when manifest omitted/invalid; no imported filesystem path trusted as access grant.
  • Mirror sourceCursor advances only when committed manifest covering that snapshot exists; unrelated journal event seq is not mirror freshness.
  • Replay/projector never calls disk/network; operational receipts distinguish replay/rebuild from original live activation.
  • An older archive never revives permissions, a revoked binding, a consumed grant, acknowledged delivery or suppressed feedback. Recovery generation is issued outside restored state; reactivation is a separate guarded command, not a replay side effect.

Негативные случаи

  • input: 2 projects active+archived, goal autonomy, human decision, created binding, settings/server lists; export v2→import empty target
    expected: Same stable IDs/status/declared relations; coverage complete only for verified declared entities; no transcript copy in mirror
  • input: Fault after first domain append before import transaction commit
    expected: 0 committed imported entities; retry same command commits once; target remains readable
  • input: Two concurrent imports into same empty estate using distinct command IDs
    expected: One commits; other CONFLICT_TARGET_REVISION; no mixed files/entities
  • input: v1 agents reference absent project; duplicate project ID; absolute '../' mirror filename; unsupported schema
    expected: All refused before any append
  • input: Crash after staged YAML file2 but before new manifest
    expected: Last successful manifest still served; unfinished generation ignored/reported; sourceCursor unchanged
  • input: Manual divergent YAML + offline DB
    expected: Divergence/authority unavailable; no last-write-wins import and no overwriting from empty cache
  • input: Restore archive has missing blob/hash mismatch/new unknown event type
    expected: Verification fails before activation; current estate unchanged
  • input: Rebuild same estate twice including config revision counters and feedback suppression
    expected: Exact parity; counters unchanged; no outbound calls; other estate untouched

Миграция и совместимость

  • Add v2 manifest reader/writer while keeping v1 read preview; never rewrite old journal event payloads.
  • Implement bounded atomic import RPC under existing append authority; no new auth bypass. Import operation receipt is reconstructable technical state, not duplicate declared store.
  • New projectors/projection generation must pass M198 determinism before destructive recovery UI. Add snapshot version compatibility matrix and retained previous generation.
  • Legacy exports labelled partial; existing settings.git='yes' validate actual repo state on read instead of trusting old persisted value.
  • Define versioned identity and operational snapshot coverage before advertising complete backup. Legacy journal-only archives restore as partial/read-only. Add recovery generation to trusted command/dispatcher admission; old clients cannot activate a restored environment.

Что приходит от зависимостей

  • id: S02
    payload: Authenticated Scope and scoped transaction/read/realpath ports; relation validator and operation command key
  • id: S14
    payload: ReadEnvelope and atomic file primitive; independent pack source failures delivered before whole restore
  • id: M198
    payload: Deterministic rebuild registry/projectorVersion/parity receipt and activation/rollback protocol

Границы активации

  • D-DATA-01. Declared coverage follows ADR0002; narrowing it needs explicit new decision.
  • Portable archive retention/encryption policy is versioned input; no external backup destination implicitly configured.

Что увидит пользователь

Storage distinguishes source authority, mirror coverage/date, verified backup, current rebuild generation and failed operation. Import shows exact entities and excluded kinds before commit.

Общий контракт

system-contract.md §4–5 via common_protocol_binding; no duplicate generic envelopes

Выбранное решение

entry: Search/Attention/Feed/Board/Graph/source link/reuse task.
exit: Точный объект в правильном estate/project; Back возвращает query/filter/draft, а не просто home.
recipe: Один EntityRef resolver + discriminated AppRoute, separate overlay state, safe default for invalid/missing ref. Search result DTO содержит entity type/id/location/snapshot/coverage/cursor. Reuse creates draft owned by project/task and refuses overwrite silently. Registry names вместо ternary labels, pin cap helper; UI theme/grid/nested controls отдельными маленькими fixes.
preview: Title+kind+scope+source snippet; incomplete search store обозначен, more link/cursor.
states: exact hit,missing/denied,outdated source,partial search,stale result,new draft conflict; keyboard labels include object names.

Контракты и интерфейсы

route: AppRoute discriminated union + EntityRef resolver; hash routes proposed, not existing HTTP API
canonical id: entity type+estate/project+id+version/location where relevant; display label never key
query: search.query returns grouped ReadResult with per-store coverage and exact refs
interface: navigateTo(ref,{returnTo,focusTarget}); reusable draft restore keyed by project/task
read policy: Search order explicitly deterministic per store (exact ID/title first when supported; remaining backend order and stable ID), not fabricated relevance confidence. Filters by store/project and pagination. Hits name incomplete stores; source denied/missing stays local; query change generation rejects stale responses.
outer envelope: Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

Инварианты

  • Search/Attention never silently land at generic project when exact entity known.
  • No leftover showAgents overlay overrides route.
  • Names from shared agent descriptor; system/unknown not guessed labels.
  • Historical plan done/total computed from same membership snapshot as full graph.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Search A→B late response; transcript A/B race; corrected note→decision wrong target; stale ref; existing nonempty reuse draft.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Migrate existing callback props incrementally through resolver; old hash/source refs explicit redirects.
  • Keep current route-independent session/file windows metadata; do not parse untrusted source string as shell/file path.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • navigationAllEntryPointsSameEntity; searchPartialMore; reuseDoesNotOverwrite; transcriptLateResponse; agentLabelsCodex; themeContrast/grid regression.
