Выбранное решение

choice: DeliveryPort produces persisted delivery identity and explicit milestones: process_started, transport_ready, bytes_written, adapter_accepted, agent_accepted. Only correct invocation-scoped ack moves task to running; a prompt heuristic cannot substitute. Native session reuse is available only when adapter can bind each invocation to task_run_id and fence.
states:
  • queued → waiting_ready → written_unconfirmed → accepted; waiting_ready → failed_before_write; written_unconfirmed → outcome_unknown on timeout/disconnect, not automatically resent.
  • cancel_requested blocks future writes; written command requires receiver cancellation ack/observed invocation end before cancelled.
  • Task attached is a relation, not confirmation. agent_accepted is an agent claim received by Fabric, not proof of understanding or success.
transactions:
  • Create delivery_id and instruction_digest/inputRef atomically with TaskRun launch outbox. Structured adapter receives envelope with task_run_id,delivery_id,run fence,protocol_revision and input_ref. Ack must match all and come through that run-scoped credential; duplicate same ack returns original receipt, different digest/recipient refuses.
  • Reuse live native session only after previous TaskRun terminal and old credential fenced; new invocation gets new delivery_id/TaskRun/credential. Crash retry of queued delivery safe only before write proven; unknown write requires lookup/ack or operator inspection.
  • Legacy PTY preserves bracketed-paste encoding, but silence/deadline is only a readiness hint. After one write return unconfirmed and expose inspect/explicit resend new-intent action. Do not queue a second prompt automatically on timeout; pending deliveries cannot overwrite each other.
continuation: An answered question resolves a task-addressed continuation. If original TaskRun is active and adapter supports addressed resume, deliver within that invocation; if it ended, S04 admits a new TaskRun pinned to resolution input. Never deliver to selected/latest terminal.

Контракты и интерфейсы

new files:
  • apps/desktop/src/main/deliveryPort.ts:enqueueDelivery,observeReady,writeOnce,acceptDelivery
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/deliveryState.ts:DeliveryState,DeliveryAck
schema:
  • deliveries {delivery_id PK,estate_id,project_id,task_id,task_run_id,fabric_session_id?,binding_revision,lease_epoch,input_ref,input_digest,protocol_revision,state,queued_seq,written_seq?,ack_seq?,deadline_at}; UNIQUE(task_run_id,delivery_kind,source_command_id)
  • delivery_ack {delivery_id UNIQUE,task_run_id,recipient_ref,input_digest,accepted_seq,source:agent|adapter|operator}; adapter ack never promoted to agent ack
commands:
  • fabric_task_accept({deliveryId,inputDigest,protocolRevision}) → accepted receipt; task/run taken from scope
  • DeliveryPort.send({deliveryId,taskRunId}) → queued|written_unconfirmed|accepted|unknown|refused
  • DeliveryPort.lookup({deliveryId}) → versioned observed milestone snapshot

Инварианты

  • No bytes-written event without writer result; no agent-accepted event without matching acknowledgement.
  • Slow startup/timeout never silently changes target or doubles prompt.
  • Provider-native session id never authorizes delivery to another TaskRun.

Отказы и восстановление

  • No output until deadline → policy explicit legacy write once/unconfirmed or required structured mode waits, never accepted.
  • Malformed ack and old-session late ack → refusal, current task untouched.
  • Early process exit before write → failed_before_write; after write → unknown delivery with observed exit.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Keep asOnePaste and existing terminal methods for manual terminal use, route managed task delivery through DeliveryPort.
  • Add capability flags structured_ready/task_ack/invocation_reuse separately; default legacy adapters false.
  • Existing attached sessions read delivery=legacy_unconfirmed unless evidence exists. No retrospective acknowledgement from transcript or nonempty output.

Выбранное решение

choice: Preserve v1 displayed revision semantics (initial1 + number of legacy config-changing events), but derive absolute revision from journal prefix rather than mutable projection state. Future config reference adds event_seq+snapshot_hash to remove ambiguous historical labels.
algorithm:
  • For first project.created@1 assign revision1. For legacy config events at seq S assign 1+COUNT(effective project.updated@1/project.settings.updated@1 events for this estate/project from its first valid create through S), not current row+1. A duplicate legacy create also assigns the prefix-derived absolute value, not an accidental reset. Ordered replay over existing rows converges. Orphan pre-create updates are diagnosed and not counted as effective changes. Add scoped partial index for the legacy prefix query.
  • For new config commands, transaction validates expected revision and emits project.configuration.changed@2 with absolute next_revision, previous_ref and canonical snapshot_hash. Projector assigns the recorded number/snapshot, never recomputes from current mutable projection. Legacy-to-v2 cutoff per project is explicit; later legacy guarded config writes disabled.
  • ConfigRef={project_id,revision,event_seq,snapshot_hash}; run pins this immutable ref. A numerical legacy revision that drifted due rebuild is retained as legacy_display_revision only, not presumed an exact snapshot identity.

Контракты и интерфейсы

new files:
  • apps/desktop/src/main/configCommands.ts:updateProjectConfiguration
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/configRef.ts:ConfigRef
schema:
  • project_config_versions projection {estate_id,project_id,revision,event_seq,snapshot_hash,snapshot}; UNIQUE(project_id,revision), UNIQUE(estate_id,event_seq,project_id)
  • projects.config_revision remains positive integer; optional config_event_seq/config_snapshot_hash for new pinning
  • migration reconciliation receipt {project_id,legacy_observed_revision,canonical_revision,source_event_seq,mapping_quality:exact|unverifiable}
commands:
  • updateProjectConfiguration({projectId,expectedConfigRef,patch}) → newConfigRef | stale_revision
  • resolveConfigRef({projectId,legacyRevision,eventSeq?}) → exact snapshot | legacy_unverifiable
serialization: Public config_revision is opaque Revision string through common serializer. Internal prefix-derived numeric bigint remains SQL arithmetic; no client arithmetic or unsafe Number conversion.

Инварианты

  • Two rebuilds identical incl config_revision; no replay increments.
  • A revision pin cannot silently retarget to another snapshot.
  • S02 scope validates event project matches aggregate before new config writes.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Existing project revision inflated by previous rebuild → canonical correction plus retained legacy label; no invented historical mapping.
  • Two config updates same expected revision → onecommit, otherstale.
  • Late replay event cannot increment beyond prefix-derived revision; out-of-order projection application is refused by projection cursor, full replay ordered.

Миграция и совместимость

  • New append-only migration replaces only per-concern projector; keep M97 dispatcher shape. Backfill canonical revisions from journal and capture before/after mapping once.
  • Return config_revision to P24 snapshots; expand parity set to new config_versions when added. Validate historical persisted references before conversion; references without supporting seq/hash remain explicitly unverified.
  • Existing renderer uses revision for refresh and display; preserve positive integer and add structured refs without silently changing wire type.

M109 · Завершить IPC Returns sweep Глубокая спецификация

Спецификация; реализация не выполнена этой итерацией

Экраны, сценарии и UX-контекст →

Зависит от: Независимое начало · Пакет: F1

Выбранное решение

  • Единый typed register IPC handlers производит runtime validator + sender validator + типизированный result из FabricApi. Не второй реестр возвращаемых типов: handler satisfies Returns и Parameters того же method, validator names correspond to method keys.
  • При постепенном переносе каждый неперенесённый handler остаётся в явном inventory. Sweep считается законченным при равенстве зарегистрированных каналов и методов контракта; отрицательный type fixture ломает typecheck при return drift.
  • Чтения возвращают общий ReadEnvelope (S14); команды CommandResult. Наружу выходит error code + безопасные recovery details, не stack/path/token.

Контракты и интерфейсы

  • registerHandle<K extends keyof IpcContract>(key: K, input: RuntimeParser<IpcContract[K].args>, handler:(ctx:VerifiedIpcContext,...args:IpcContract[K].args)=>Promise<IpcContract[K].result>):void
  • All results use exactly CommandResult<T> and Ref in docs/architecture/system-contract.md §4; do not duplicate a local union. Uncertain effect outcome is status:unknown and requires reconciliation.

Инварианты

  • No type annotation substitutes for runtime validation of renderer-originated data.
  • Nested UUID/project scope checked by domain commands after syntax validation.
  • All privileged IPC validates sender frame/window/origin against local owned surfaces; renderer cannot supply ctx.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Malformed enum -> typed invalid_input and no DB call.
  • Correct syntax with mismatched project -> domain refusal.
  • shell.openPath nonempty error string -> unavailable/refused, never committed.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Introduce register helper alongside current handlers, migrate domain-by-domain, remove legacy direct registration only when inventory=0. No big-bang change to all renderer methods before compatible result readers ship.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • Negative tsc fixture returning string for declared number must fail; valid fixture passes.
  • Call helper with unknown iframe sender and structurally invalid payload -> handler invocation count0.
  • Generate inventory from AST or actual registration map, not count raw text containing ipcMain.handle.

Выбранное решение

  • Разделение в одном процессе, без новых сервисов/БД. Main/index только composition root/window lifecycle + register handlers; MCP AgentSurface только adapter. Ports WorkCommands, ExecutionCommands, Authority, KnowledgeQueries/Commands, ProjectFiles закрывают повторяющиеся scope/error/transaction обязанности.
  • Извлекать один вертикальный шов: scoped command → storage transaction → receipt → reader. Нельзя сначала вынести raw db в utility и считать границу созданной. Структура renderer разделяется по существующим пользовательским блокам, state orchestration остаётся в typed query hooks.
  • Операции одного SQL commit остаются одной command даже если задействуют несколько domain projections (например answer+decision+block set+outbox).

Контракты и интерфейсы

All consume VerifiedCommandContext and return CommandResult.
  • Storage ports are private to command modules; read ports return immutable DTO, never SupabaseClient or filesystem handle.

Инварианты

  • No raw service-role db in renderer/MCP handlers/scheduler after affected seam is migrated.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • Run current pure/SQL probes before and after each seam with identical fixture.
  • Dependency rule asserts renderer/preload/MCP adapters cannot import raw write client module.
  • P24 projection hash parity incl M198 config_revision remains required; extraction cannot accept new exclusions.

M102 · У каждого reader свои причины обновления Глубокая спецификация

Спецификация; реализация не выполнена этой итерацией

Экраны, сценарии и UX-контекст →

Зависит от: S14 · Пакет: F7

Выбранное решение

  • Один scoped event cursor подписывает query keys на семейства событий. Repo/config читает project.config_revision; memory — memory changes; transcripts — session outcome/transcript receipt; quota — собственный срок свежести и explicit refresh. Feed tick сам по себе не invalidates all.
  • Subscribe-before-snapshot: получить high-water H и snapshot at H; сохранить buffered deltas >H; применять по монотонному estate seq, dedup by seq. Если query storage не умеет snapshot atH, server transaction выдаёт согласованный revision/snapshot; renderer не присваивает произвольный feedMark снимку.
  • При reconnect replay(afterSeq) с пагинацией до current high-water. Retention gap -> invalidate affected scope and reread snapshot. Stale useful data остаётся видимым с as_of/reason; scope A→B abort/generation исключает late A.
  • Burst coalescing в один in-flight запрос на key и один trailing refresh если cursor сдвинулся; stale completion не закрывает trailing refresh.

Контракты и интерфейсы

  • QueryKey {estate_id,project_id,reader,filter_hash}; QuerySnapshot<T> = ReadEnvelope<T> & {at_seq:string,query_revision:string}; invalidation table keyed by event.type.
  • refresh(key,minimumSeq): Promise<ReadEnvelope<T>>; readers store applied_seq separately from requested_seq.

Инварианты

  • An event seq is order inside estate, not a timestamp and not globally comparable.
  • No refresh can turn unknown source into known zero.
  • Deactivation/unmount releases subscription; project state never shares cache without scope in key.

Отказы и восстановление

  • 100 unrelated PTY events -> memory query count0.
  • Snapshot arrives after a newer delta -> buffered delta applied after snapshot, never overwritten.
  • Error during refresh -> stale snapshot+error not blank state.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Introduce one query adapter and move ProjectHome readers independently; feed store unchanged until adapter cursor semantics covered. New graph readers use same adapter from first implementation.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • Same event fixture before/after: collect IPC calls by channel and payload bytes; report measured counts.
  • Simulate reconnect gap and duplicate/out-of-order deliveries -> current snapshot equal to reference fold.
  • Switch A→B while A query pending -> B not mutated.

M105 · Убрать стоимость полного scrollback на байт Глубокая спецификация

Спецификация; реализация не выполнена этой итерацией

Экраны, сценарии и UX-контекст →

Зависит от: Независимое начало · Пакет: F7

Выбранное решение

  • Разделить terminal display ring, incremental tail parser и durable transcript stream. onData делает O(chunk size) обработку; запрещены regex/split всего scrollback на каждый chunk. UI sessions.list возвращает summary без scrollback; terminal subscriber получает bounded snapshot once then sequence-numbered chunks.
  • Tail parser — streaming state machine text/ESC/CSI/OSC/OSC_ESC, сохраняет незавершённую escape sequence между chunks; CR обновляет текущую строку, LF завершает, ordinary [link] сохраняется. Raw transcript хранит исходные bytes отдельно; display text не source transcript.
  • Async persistence batching: queue byte counter, 64KiB flush threshold или 50ms, final flush awaited before transcript-complete receipt. Это проектные начальные limits, не измеренный оптимум. At 4MiB pending apply upstream PTY pause if supported; otherwise keep durable spool and mark overload, never silently drop data or block main with sync I/O.
  • Terminal capture error marks transcript incomplete with offset/error; independent execution status persists. UTF-8 decoder state does not split multibyte codepoints. Limit tail text to120 Unicode codepoints after ANSI decode, not bytes.

Контракты и интерфейсы

  • SessionSummary {session_id,status,tail,tail_seq,transcript_state:capturing|complete|incomplete,last_output_at}; no scrollback.
  • TerminalSnapshot {session_id,from_seq,to_seq,text,truncated}; TerminalChunk {session_id,seq,data}; TranscriptRange {session_id,offset_bytes,limit_bytes} -> {bytes,next_offset,complete,sha256?}.

Инварианты

  • No full transcript in periodic all-sessions query.
  • Exit observed and transcript persisted are separate receipts; flush failure cannot erase process exit.
  • Truncation of display ring does not truncate durable transcript without explicit incomplete state.

Отказы и восстановление

  • ESC sequence split at every byte boundary -> same visible text as unsplit fixture.
  • Queue write error/ENOSPC -> incomplete and actionable notification; output not reported fully saved.
  • Burst then immediate exit -> completion receipt emitted only after flush.
  • Remote runner with no pause/spool contract -> capability unavailable, bounded loss is explicit not hidden.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Add summary endpoint while keeping old terminal snapshot endpoint for one reader migration; remove scrollback from sessions.list once all consumers use explicit snapshot. Reuse existing raw transcript storage and redact at existing ingest boundary, not by replacing source bytes with tail.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • Fixture plain [link], Cyrillic/emoji, CR-progress, CSI/OSC split positions -> expected strings.
  • Compare event-loop delay and IPC bytes under same long-output fixture, record baseline and result; do not impose arbitrary speedup percentage.
  • Injected slow disk+exit demonstrates bounded queue path and exact raw byte checksum or explicit incomplete.

M177 · Агент знает время, правила и происхождение Глубокая спецификация

Спецификация; реализация не выполнена этой итерацией

Экраны, сценарии и UX-контекст →

Зависит от: S02.store · S10 · S14 · Пакет: F3

current state

partial_existing_implementation

Предлагаемые API

  • shared/protocolContract.ts: protocolManifest/version/hash (new)
  • main/contextPack.ts: compileFromSnapshot and ContextPackLock v2
  • AgentSurface: whoami v2 response + fabric_protocol_ack (proposed new tool, separate truthful evidence)
  • context pack revision/event projector + artifact reader (new versioned schema)

Контракты и интерфейсы

Whoami: {scope:TrustedScopeView,identity:{principalId,actorKind,bindingRevision,epoch},serverTimeUtc,timezone,clockSource:'host',rules:{protocolVersion,sha256,obligations[],taskStatuses,planStatuses,originKinds,questionKinds,insightCategories},contextPack:ReadEnvelope<ContextPackLock>,capabilities:ProtocolCapability[]}; IDs serverderived
ProtocolAck: {commandId,protocolVersion,sha256,packId,packRevision}; event records claimed_ack and authentic caller; no guarantee model read/understood. Existing session.oriented@1 remains historical tool-served receipt
Pack: shared_contracts.context_pack; state offered→materialized→delivered→agent_ack_claim; evidence timestamps separate

Алгоритм

  • Authoritative protocol built from runtime enums/schemas, not two prose copies; include accepted version/hash and safe obligation list. PREAMBLE remains pointer to whoami rather than reprinting all rules.
  • Capture actual server UTC/timezone at compile; record runtime config revisions and input snapshot. Compiler budget accounts for whole output incl mandatoryheader/footer, defensive encoding all inserted variable strings.
  • Archive exact content before append new revision lock; launch uses exact locked artifact; whoami returns same pack lock (no assertion today's project values equal historical pack). Live project summary separate ReadEnvelope.
  • On explicit resume/fork/rebind/observedcompaction materialize newer pack and protocol offer; previous ack stale until new hash ack. If runner cannot emit compaction signal, mark observation unsupported and permit whoami refresh; don't pretend every compaction captured.
  • ActorKind/source authority bound by S02, supplied kind/person ignored/rejected; keep agent facts in data-only block even when many agent reports agree.

Инварианты

  • Protocol versions distinct from MCP transport version, Fabric app release, sibling FAC version, compiler and policy revisions.
  • No context.read or memory.remembered names introduced as if current; exact existing events session.oriented@1/memory.project.recorded@1/context.compiled@1.
  • One source fact ID+revision immutable; old pack IDs cannot prove old task brief/project purpose, preserve exact assembled bytes going forward.
  • Unknown omitted count outside candidate query limit reported null; cannot say pack holds everything merely omittedFacts=0.
  • Task/plan/heartbeat status enums remain different axes; not merged status vocabulary.

Негативные случаи

  • input: huge purpose+repos+brief (20000chars), budget12000
    expected: total <=12000; deterministic selection/omission; mandatory data unablefit→BUDGET_TOO_SMALL
  • input: same snapshot+compiler+clock args twice
    expected: byte-identical hash and references; no randomordering
  • input: compile once, edit task brief/projectpurpose then view prior lock
    expected: old exact text/hash preserved, live values labelled separately
  • input: reassert protocol v2 after v1ack; delayed ackv1
    expected: stale_ack receipt, currentack missing; no green compliance
  • input: agent remember claim about policy with actorKind=person payload
    expected: actor remainsagent, human settlement authority absent
  • input: fact valid_from future; conflicting current fact
    expected: future omitted with validity reason; supported conflicts retained as separate claims
  • input: context file missing after bundle cleanup
    expected: archive still serves historical lock if retained; v1missing remainsunknown

Миграция и совместимость

  • Add versioned context.compiled event/lock revision; preserve v1 replay and one latest projection adapter.
  • Backfill v1 reproducibility unknown and sourceStatus unknown; don't regenerate historic text from current rows.
  • ProtocolAck capability optional during rollout; unsupported old agent remains OBSERVED/unknown, not falsely refused for advice. Manager activation can require ack under its profile.

Что приходит от зависимостей

  • id: S02
    payload: authenticated actor and scoped snapshot
  • id: S10
    payload: approved vocabulary/hash/Run grain mapping and event registry validation
  • id: S14
    payload: ReadEnvelope, source errors, typed packadmission and atomic materialization

Границы активации

  • D-RUN-01 naming adopted only via proposed new ADR/version.

Что увидит пользователь

Pack exact preview/version/time/input quality; orientation served vs acknowledged claim distinct; compaction observation unsupported honestly.

system-contract.md §4–5 via common_protocol_binding; no duplicate generic envelopes

observable effect: Следующий/resumed agent получает дату, текущие правила и exact pack; audit различает offered/delivered/claimed acknowledgement и не приписывает understanding.
falsifier: Compaction/rebind/resume invalidates old hash; unavailable source never called complete; forged actor cannot become human basis.
Алгоритм:
  • Authoritative protocol built from runtime enums/schemas, not two prose copies; include accepted version/hash and safe obligation list. PREAMBLE remains pointer to whoami rather than reprinting all rules.
  • Capture actual server UTC/timezone at compile; record runtime config revisions and input snapshot. Compiler budget accounts for whole output incl mandatoryheader/footer, defensive encoding all inserted variable strings.
  • Archive exact content before append new revision lock; launch uses exact locked artifact; whoami returns same pack lock (no assertion today's project values equal historical pack). Live project summary separate ReadEnvelope.
  • On explicit resume/fork/rebind/observedcompaction materialize newer pack and protocol offer; previous ack stale until new hash ack. If runner cannot emit compaction signal, mark observation unsupported and permit whoami refresh; don't pretend every compaction captured.
  • ActorKind/source authority bound by S02, supplied kind/person ignored/rejected; keep agent facts in data-only block even when many agent reports agree.
Что увидит пользователь: Pack exact preview/version/time/input quality; orientation served vs acknowledged claim distinct; compaction observation unsupported honestly.

Контракты и интерфейсы

Obligation: {id,revision,title,scope,mode:'REFUSED'|'OBSERVED'|'ADVICE',predicateCode,enforcementPoint?:{service,symbol,version},evidenceKinds[],freshnessPolicy,runnerRequirements[],severity,remediation}
Coverage: {runnerId,runnerVersion,profileHash,obligationId,status:'enforced'|'observed'|'unsupported'|'unknown',certificationReceiptId?,lastVerifiedAt}
Result: {obligationId,subjectRef,window,verdict:'satisfied'|'violated'|'unknown'|'not_applicable',evidenceRefs[],coverage,recordedRationale?}; ADVICE never blocks workflow

Алгоритм

  • Enumerate self-close/refused scope/effect grant/loop cap at exact command boundary. If a runner can perform filesystem/network externally, write-with-grant guarantee applies Fabric-mediated effect only; native capability separatelycertified.
  • Orientation served, reviewbriefpresent, leaseended are observable host facts; missing trace means unknown until complete observation window proves no event.
  • Review quality/insight quality are advice or checker-assessed claims, not prompt-basedhardgates. A manager may propose evidencequality finding but cannot grantit authority.
  • Generate tool/preamble descriptions and visiblecoverage fromsame manifest; onrunnerprofilechange certification invalidates and unknownuntilconformance.
  • S05fullattempttrace enhancesobservability but doesn'tdelay cheap M177 protocol/refusal tests; retention loss → unknownhistory, notno violations.

Инварианты

  • Intent text never counted as enforcement; trace captured doesn'tprove externalwriteinterception.
  • Provider selfreports may satisfy requested communication but stayclaims; observation mustnamehost/source.
  • Unsupported is known capabilityabsence, unknown is unmeasured/unavailable; not conflated.
  • A row labelledREFUSED requires executable server test; voluntary client cannot getenforcedlabel.

  • input: badlywrittenclaim

Миграция и совместимость

  • Version manifest and evidence adapters; preserve existingrules, no broad restrictiveprompt imposed asfake enforcement.
  • Runnercertification records pinnedprofile digest; changingbinary/configinvalidates coverage proof.

  • fabric · docs/adr/0040-a-heartbeat-is-a-positive-signal-and-silence-is-ambiguous.md:21 · positive signal/state taxonomyИсточник: git-blob · 03311c856b7771e5e4cfff967b138e89e292c67f · перенесено с 5051def (identical-bytes)An agent states `fabric_heartbeat({ phase, note?, waiting_on? })` on a cadence,

Выбранное решение

choice: Heartbeat is an authenticated, run-bound positive claim with server receipt time. Persist one monotonic agent sequence per task invocation/generation; old messages cannot revive old execution. Separate reported phase, observed transport/process activity and derived liveness.
states:
  • phase enum reading/working/waiting/verifying/blocked, independently receivedAt and process state. waiting_on only valid for waiting/blocked and only current scoped question/grant/continuation.
  • derived liveness working/waiting/quiet/stalled/gone plus observation coverage available/unsupported/unobserved. stalled means suspicion based on gap, never proven wedged cause.
  • duplicate beat returns prior receipt without refreshing last_received_at; lower beat_seq is stale; same seq with changed payload conflicts.
transactions:
  • heartbeat({beatSeq,phase,note?,waitingOn?}) takes task_run_id/fabric_session_id/role_slot_id/binding_revision/epoch from credential. Lock current run/heartbeat row, verify active invocation and current fence, validate waiting object scope/state, append agent.heartbeat@1 with receive timestamp from DB and projection update only if seq advances.
  • On newly resolved waiting object, liveness cannot remain permanently waiting on old self-report; state records wait target resolved, grace starts from resolution receipt, await next beat/work observation. Policy thresholds/cadence are resolved/pinned from estate settings + runner capability; validate stall_after>=quiet_after>=expected_interval and positive bounds.
time: DB/server receivedAt is authority for durable ordering; client sentAt optional diagnostic only. Local watchdog uses monotonic elapsed clock and host sleep intervals to avoid wall-clock jump errors. An unsupported beat capability is declared, not silently assigned a universal 60-second fault threshold.

Контракты и интерфейсы

new files:
  • apps/desktop/src/main/heartbeatCommands.ts:recordHeartbeat
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/liveness.ts:deriveLiveness
schema:
  • run_heartbeats projection {task_run_id PK,estate_id,project_id,beat_seq,last_received_at,phase,waiting_kind?,waiting_id?,note_safe,lease_epoch,receipt_seq}; UNIQUE(task_run_id,beat_seq) in event identity
  • estate health configuration {expected_interval_ms,quiet_after_ms,stall_after_ms,orientation_grace_ms,resume_grace_ms,policy_revision}; capability-specific defaults resolved once
commands:
  • fabric_heartbeat({beatSeq,phase,note?,waitingOn?:{kind:question|grant|continuation,id}}) → accepted/current receipt | stale/fenced/scope refusal
  • deriveLiveness({heartbeat,observedProcess,hostObservation,now,thresholds,capabilities}) → {state,reason,evidenceRefs,observedAt,coverage}

Инварианты

  • Heartbeat cannot update ended TaskRun or a successor run sharing native session.
  • waiting_on names a current object; absence does not imply no blocker.
  • A phase is a claim; heartbeat receipt is a fact; neither measures task correctness.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Late beat from old lease/taskrun → refused and safe trace.
  • Client clock+1year or out-of-order seq → no liveness extension from client timestamp.
  • DB unavailable → gap/unobserved, no invented durable heartbeat.

Миграция и совместимость

  • No current heartbeat producer; add event/projection/tool/protocol/catalog/locale in one slice. Keep SessionState legacy compatibility mapping but new consumers read separate observation state.
  • M177 must supply versioned protocol and capability declaration; session.oriented@1 existing receipt name retained.
  • Existing sessions without heartbeat support are legacy/unsupported, not automatically diagnosed failed.

    status: proposed_not_executed

    inputs: waiting_on other project or resolved question
    expected: scope/invalid_wait refusal; current liveness not falsely waiting
    harness: isolated SQL + fake ports
    status: proposed_not_executed
  • name: beat-generation
    inputs: run1 ended, same native session used byrun2, late beat1
    expected: no run2 update; run1 remains ended
    harness: isolated SQL + fake ports
    status: proposed_not_executed
  • name: beat-clock

    expected: server/monotonic clock used, resume grace or unsupported, no proven crash

  • fabric · docs/adr/0040-a-heartbeat-is-a-positive-signal-and-silence-is-ambiguous.md:38 · outside watchИсточник: git-blob · 03311c856b7771e5e4cfff967b138e89e292c67f · перенесено с 5051def (identical-bytes)A heartbeat is the agent's own account, and the thing most likely to be broken is

Выбранное решение

choice: Observer runs outside agent and independently of the PTY dispatch event queue. Use a dedicated worker event loop for main-loop responsiveness/monotonic host sampling; process identity includes PID+birth/start fingerprint+host_generation. Its bounded spool remains able to report DB/main-loop unavailability; no perpetual daemon is introduced.
detectors:
  • Orientation unconfirmed: no successful/recorded protocol delivery within grace. Existing session.oriented@1 is only request-side evidence; append may fail while rules are delivered and may precede response completion. Classify unconfirmed, not skill-failed.
  • Agent signal gap with host and transport known healthy → stalled_suspected; recent valid heartbeat plus long silence → quiet/working, not fault.
  • Observed invocation/process exit → runtime ended. Exit0 does not prove task result success. PID reuse must not resurrect task invocation.
  • Host suspend/resume/main-loop-unresponsive or DB outage → observation gap on host/source; suppress agent-specific blame until observer reacquires fresh evidence.
transactions:
  • Condition occurrence key {task_run_id,detector_kind,condition_generation}; transition healthy→suspected appends one finding. Repeated unchanged sample updates observation age without creating duplicate Board obligation. recovery appends resolution receipt to same occurrence.
  • On restart, reconcile only runs owned by this host generation and expired leases. Query provider/supervisor by task_run_id; positive alive matching fingerprint may reattach under explicit supported profile. No evidence → outcome_unknown/recovery_required; do not mark all running tasks cancelled merely because app restarted. Remote/other-host runs untouched.
limits: Worker shares app lifetime; if whole app is dead no online observer exists. Show last_observed_at on next launch. An independent hosted monitor would be a new placement/profile, not implied by this worker.

Контракты и интерфейсы

new files:
  • apps/desktop/src/main/runtimeObserver.ts:sampleRun,detectConditions,reconcileHostRuns
  • apps/desktop/src/main/hostWatchdog.ts:watchMainLoop,recordHostTransition
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/harnessBreak.ts:classifyObservationGap
schema:
  • host_observations {host_id,host_generation,started_at,last_observed_at,suspended_intervals,main_loop_state,source_health}; scoped diagnostics, no remote execution rights
  • runtime_conditions projection {occurrence_id,task_run_id,detector_kind,condition_generation,first_seen,last_seen,evidence_refs,confidence,status:open|resolved}; UNIQUE(task_run_id,detector_kind,condition_generation)
interface:
  • RuntimeObserver.sample({taskRunRef,processIdentity,heartbeat,hostState,sourceHealth}) → observations[]/conditions[]
  • reconcileHostRuns({hostId,previousGeneration}) → resumed|ended_observed|unknown|not_owned per run

Инварианты

  • Observer does not infer failure from absence if its own source is unavailable.
  • Condition dedupe key stable through restart; repeated polling does not spam Board.
  • Run terminal state never fabricated from output silence or startup.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Main eventloop stalled but worker responsive → host_loop_unresponsive, not agent_wedged.
  • DB outage while process alive → data_source_unavailable and gap, task still not classified success/failure.
  • Host dies, PID reused by another process → mismatched fingerprint, no reattach.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Replace bulk startup-abandon logic only for v2 runs, retain v1 historical meaning as legacy unknown view; startup feature gates prevent mixed owner assumptions.
  • Use canonical session.oriented event and introduce explicit protocol-delivered receipt if adapter can prove it. Do not rename old event bytes.
  • Health Board obligation reader shares runtime_conditions occurrence id, not a new independent notification record.

  • fabric · docs/architecture/agent-health-and-failure.md:84 · failure taxonomy and outside inferenceИсточник: git-blob · 03311c856b7771e5e4cfff967b138e89e292c67f · перенесено с 5051def (identical-bytes)| Watched | How | Fires |

Выбранное решение

choice: FailureRecord normalizes kind, origin, evidence, certainty, scope and safe recovery. Preserve runtime termination separately from task-domain result. A successful test of impossibility can be a task result with outcome no; it is not an agent crash.
kinds:
  • runner-missing
  • skill-failed-to-load
  • harness-unreachable
  • agent-crashed
  • agent-wedged
  • task-failed-honestly
  • advisory-model-failed
  • notifier-source-down
  • unknown
classification:
  • runner-missing requires failed executable resolution/spawn ENOENT evidence; skill-failed requires loader/protocol reported error, not merely missing orientation.
  • agent-crashed requires observed abnormal process/invocation termination; agent-wedged gap-only evidence carries certainty=suspected and presents suspicion. If source health unavailable, classify unknown/host observation condition.
  • task-failed-honestly requires typed agent result with claim/proof/notVerified and target invocation; submits review. Exit0 alone produces no successful task result; exit!=0 alone does not describe whether domain work failed honestly.
  • Retryability derives operation semantics and effect state: validation/policy/credentials terminal until changed input; transient infrastructure bounded; outcome_unknown reconcile_only. Recovery action is typed and server revalidates conditions on click.
transactions:
  • Record failure occurrence once by source observation id/attempt; append safe evidence ref and stage. Do not overwrite terminal receipt after new run. Later corrected diagnosis appends diagnosis.superseded linking previous record; old cause stays in history.
  • executeRecovery({failureId,expectedRevision,action}) validates currently allowed action, then uses existing launch/command/cancel ports with idempotency. UI cannot invoke hidden retry that bypasses quota/fence.

Контракты и интерфейсы

new files:
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/failure.ts:classifyFailure,availableRecovery
  • apps/desktop/src/main/failureCommands.ts:recordFailure,executeRecovery
schema:
  • failure_records {failure_id PK,estate_id,project_id?,task_run_id?,attempt_id?,source_observation_id UNIQUE,kind,origin,certainty,evidence_refs,safe_reason,retryability,remediation_codes,diagnostic_revision,supersedes_id?,occurred_seq}
  • RecoveryAction enum inspect_evidence/install_runner/recheck_source/request_authority/reconcile_effect/retry_new_task_run/continue_after_answer; execution still through typed domain command
result:
  • Failure={kind,origin:spawn|transport|provider|tool|domain|observer|notifier,certainty:observed|reported|suspected|unknown,evidenceRefs,retryability:never|after_condition|bounded|reconcile_only}

Инварианты

  • Every diagnosis names what observed it; unknown is an explicit valid result.
  • Failure recovery does not erase past run/result.
  • Business negative result and runtime crash have different receipts/actions.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Toolcall silence → no automatic harness-unreachable kind.
  • Provider timeout with possibly executed effect → reconcile_only, never retry_new_key.
  • User clicks stale recovery after issue already resolved → no mutation and current receipt.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Add versioned failure event and typed DTO; keep existing reason strings as legacy_unclassified source evidence. Never infer precise kind from arbitrary human prose alone.
  • Existing task.finished/abandoned retained historically; new runtime ended event no longer auto-equates to task done/cancelled.
  • Map taxonomy names consistently in protocol, schema, UI and docs; agent-wedged suspected wording changes presentation, not evidence.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • name: failure-classification
    inputs: one fixture per kind with positive evidence plus negative-control absence
    expected: only evidence-supported kinds; unknown or suspected otherwise
    harness: pure corpus
    status: proposed_not_executed
  • name: honest-negative
    inputs: typed result says cannot reproduce withproof vs SIGKILL
    expected: first task review/negative result; second runtime crash/no fabricatedresult
    harness: isolated SQL + fake ports
    status: proposed_not_executed
  • name: recovery-matrix
    inputs: grant expired, runner absent, provider transient, effect unknown
    expected: appropriate distinct actions; unknown effect reconcile_only
    harness: isolated SQL + fake ports
    status: proposed_not_executed
  • name: diagnosis-history
    inputs: new evidence disproves previous suspect after rerun
    expected: append superseding diagnosis; old run history unchanged
    harness: isolated SQL + fake ports
    status: proposed_not_executed

Выбранное решение

choice: CapabilityReport is versioned per admitted runner/binding revision, with required vs optional capabilities for workload. Degraded result is a tuple of completed claims, missing capabilities/checks and available evidence, never a green boolean.
states:
  • capability supported_verified|supported_unverified|unsupported|temporarily_unavailable with evidence/checked_at; admission requires supported_verified for required safety capabilities.
  • execution mode full|degraded_optional|blocked_required; model absent permits deterministic rank/hygiene, not fictitious judgement.
  • degradation occurrence open→recovered; one actionable Board item only when operator action needed, informational history otherwise.
transactions:
  • Admission pins capability report revision/digest; mid-run loss emits capability.lost observation with affected commands. Required channel loss stops future mutations/fences dispatch until recovered; optional loss may continue with explicit outcome note.
  • Result envelope lists done/proof/notVerified/omittedInputs and per-source freshness. Notifier partial aggregates actual successes N of configured M; unavailable source never becomes empty. Recovery does not retroactively make old incomplete result complete; append new verification/result receipt.

Контракты и интерфейсы

new files:
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/capabilityReport.ts:resolveExecutionMode
  • apps/desktop/src/main/capabilityProbe.ts:probeBinding
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/degradation.ts:deriveDegradation
schema:
  • capability_reports {report_id,binding_id,binding_revision,adapter_revision,checked_at,capabilities[{name,state,evidence_ref}],report_hash}
  • execution_degradations {occurrence_id,task_run_id?,cycle_invocation_id?,capability,required,opened_seq,resolved_seq?,effect_on_result}; stable occurrence key ties Board item
interface:
  • Capabilities include structured_ready,task_ack,invocation_reuse,heartbeat,tool_trace,native_resume,interrupt,effect_idempotency,effect_lookup,required_skills; each separately verified
  • ExecutionOutcome={claims,observations,evidenceRefs,notVerified[],omittedInputs[],degradations[],completionAssessment:complete|partial|unknown}

Инварианты

  • No unsupported capability presented as tested because runner name is recognized.
  • An optional missing skill cannot erase verified work; required safety channel cannot silently degrade to arbitrary CLI.
  • Same native session reuse is denied without task invocation identity/ack/fence capability.

Отказы и восстановление

  • AgentSurface down for external CEO workload → blocked_required, no mutation-capable launch.
  • Advisory model down → deterministic mode works; unperformed judgement marked unavailable.
  • Notifier one source down → partial with age or explicit skipped reason, not empty/full.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Additive runner passport fields default unknown, never true. Existing plain terminal launch remains possible as manual trusted-local capability with explicit limitations.
  • Shared domain result versioning keeps old result schema pinned; Fabric degradation annotation can live beside provider envelope if its schema forbids additional properties.
  • Do not turn M181 into new wallet/provider procurement; budget/source prerequisites stay their named cards.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

Выбранное решение

choice: Resolve contradictory ADR grain explicitly in a NEW proposed ADR: WorkflowRun preserves0030 graph walk and existing run_id wire; TaskRun is a new canonical task_run_id for one admitted explicit task invocation. fabric_session_id/native_session_ref are separate and may span sequential TaskRuns only through a verified adapter. This deliberately narrows0042 no-new-id assumption while preserving its fresh progress per iteration and journal-projection architecture.
entities:
  • WorkflowRun pins graph declaration version, config/binding/provider/policy/engine refs, budget and cancellation context. Rendered graphs are queries; immutable graph/plan definitions and event receipts are allowed, not a second mutable visualization graph.
  • Every explicit task evaluation loop pass creates fresh TaskRun after admission, with new plan/step state. A denied admission is no run. Transport retry/LLM hidden internal turn is Attempt/unknown-internal-work, not another TaskRun.
  • PlanRevision immutable within TaskRun: plan_revision_id, revision_no, supersedes_plan_revision_id, reason, total_known, step definitions. StepId stable across replans only for same semantic operation; changed operation new stepId with supersedes reference.
  • Step claims and verification observations independent. Plan can support parallel sibling steps/dependency DAG and nested parent steps; parent progress derived from child receipts and never a second mutable number.
states:
  • TaskRun runtime terminal once ended; result/verification evidence may arrive later as linked assessment, never rewrite terminal runtime receipt. WorkflowRun terminal state immutable; continuation new WorkflowRun with predecessor_ref.
  • StepClaim planned→active|skipped; active→blocked|done|failed|skipped; blocked→active|failed|skipped; terminal claim within that plan revision not reopened. Corrected work declares new revision/step or next TaskRun. done is agent claim; verification pass/fail/not_run/unknown has separate source.
  • Replan atomically activates new plan revision via expected_current_revision CAS. Old definitions and claims freeze for current-view purposes. Same-run carryover of completed step allowed only with explicit carryover_ref and unchanged inputs/operation; fresh TaskRun always resets all steps.
transactions:
  • declarePlan(scope,key,expectedPlanRevision,steps): require active admitted TaskRun/current lease, validate unique step ids, existing parent ids, no parent/dependency cycle, valid needs, bounded text/step count, all evidence/input refs scoped. Store complete immutable declaration and supersession event; no partially declared plan.
  • reportPlanStep requires task_run_id from credential, exact plan revision/step, expected step revision, valid transition and current lease. Late old-run/old-plan event refused with safe trace; cannot mark successor progress. Idempotency returns original event. Verification uses separate observer-authorized recordEvidence command.
  • saveExecutionSnapshot stores {execution_snapshot_id,task_run_id,plan_revision_id,step_claim_watermark,input_refs,artifact_refs,budget_counters,last_committed_seq,adapter_state_ref?}; finalize only after referenced command receipts exist. This is durable resume state, not Checkpoint gate verdict. No hidden model chain-of-thought stored. Resume reconstructs accepted plan/claims; new explicit evaluation uses new TaskRun with fresh statuses. A gate checkpoint may reference this snapshot; snapshot alone never authorizes continuation.

Контракты и интерфейсы

new files:
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/runIdentity.ts:WorkflowRunRef,TaskRunRef,LoopIterationRef,AttemptRef
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/plan.ts:validatePlan,mayReportStep
  • apps/desktop/src/main/planCommands.ts:declarePlan,reportStep,recordVerification,saveExecutionSnapshot
  • apps/desktop/src/main/runQueries.ts:readTaskRuns,readWorkflowRun
schema:
  • task_runs fromS04 canonical task_run_id UUID PK; UNIQUE(task_id,run_ordinal); fabric_session_id nullable and nonunique across sequential invocations; native_ref optional
  • workflow_runs projection {workflow_run_id PK,estate_id,project_id,graph_ref,config_ref,engine_kind?,engine_revision?,bindings,policy_ref,budget,state,predecessor_ref?,started_seq,terminal_seq}; old run_id maps here only
  • plan_revisions {plan_revision_id PK,task_run_id,revision_no,supersedes_id?,reason,total_known,declared_seq}; UNIQUE(task_run_id,revision_no)
  • plan_steps {task_run_id,plan_revision_id,step_id,parent_step_id?,needs[],operation_ref,input_hash,definition}; PK(plan_revision_id,step_id); step_claims and step_verifications separate event projections
  • execution_snapshots {execution_snapshot_id PK,task_run_id,plan_revision_id,last_committed_seq,step_watermark,input_hash,artifact_refs,budget_ref,adapter_state_ref?,created_seq}; UNIQUE(task_run_id,snapshot_ordinal)
commands:
  • fabric_plan_declare({expectedPlanRevision?,reason,steps[],totalKnown}) → {planRevisionId,revision,receipt}
  • fabric_plan_step({planRevisionId,stepId,expectedStepRevision,status,note?,evidenceRefs?}) → claim receipt; evidenceRefs alone do not self-verify
  • recordStepVerification({taskRunId,planRevisionId,stepId,checkId,result,proofRef}) → observation receipt
  • saveExecutionSnapshot({expectedEpoch,planRevisionId,lastCommittedSeq,artifactRefs,budgetStateRef}) → execution snapshot ref

Инварианты

  • Every explicit iteration has fresh TaskRun/steps, even reused native session; never infer internal loop counts.
  • No stored visualization graph or mutable plan history; graphs are queries over immutable declarations/receipts.
  • A step done does not mean verified or task done.
  • run_id is not silently reinterpreted; v2 names are explicit across schema/IPC/MCP/adapters.
  • Gate checkpoint verdict and durable execution snapshot are separate records: snapshot persistence is no permission to resume across an unresolved gate.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Late step done fromrun1 arrives whilerun2active → rejected, run2unchanged.
  • Concurrent replan from samebase → one active revision, other stale; old historical claims remain.
  • Partial input set or unknown total → no fabricated percentage denominator.
  • Adapter says native resume supported but lacks invocation mapping → no session reuse.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Propose new ADR, update CONTEXT, schemas/runSummary, external-contracts and scenario receipts before implementation. Do not edit0030/0042 history or claim operator acceptance yet.
  • Versioned new TaskRun identity intentionally differs from0042 pair. Backfill legacy TaskRun IDs deterministically from estate/task/session-attached event identity, mark origin legacy_observed and acceptance unknown; failed legacy task.started with no attach remains legacy launch attempt, not falsely an admitted v2 TaskRun.
  • Keep legacy journal envelope and @1 readers. New CorrelationV2 carries workflow_run_id/task_run_id explicitly. Compatibility Task Run view can display task+session for old UI; new graph rollup must refuse ambiguous old run_id instead of guessing.
  • Run as projection is allowed; no second independent mutable business store. Local control outbox/lease tables have durable receipts and clear orchestration ownership perADR0022.

    inputs: two replans samebase; late oldplan step event
    expected: one revision active, otherstale; no successor mutation

    status: proposed_not_executed
  • name: claim-vs-verification
    inputs: agent stepdone with no check; observer failedcheck; later checkpass
    expected: done claim stays distinct; verification timeline shows fail thennewpass receipt; task not auto-done
    harness: isolated SQL + fake ports
    status: proposed_not_executed

    harness: isolated SQL + fake ports
    status: proposed_not_executed

Выбранное решение

entry: Агент из выполняемой task вызывает ask; человек видит карточку через estate top5/project top10/full Board и из блокирующей task.
exit: Получен question_id+accepted_seq либо типизированный отказ; check возвращает состояние вопроса и delivery отдельно. Ответ проверяется по ID, не поиск похожего текста.
recipe: Общий QuestionService проверяет actor scope и каждую blocked task; нормализует about, topic и options, сохраняет один вопрос по command idempotency key. Add ask/check adapters в AgentSurface и preload, DTO в shared. Источник задаёт request, сервис формирует авторитетные estate/actor поля.
preview: Вопрос, автор, project/task, что остановлено, адресат и одно действие открыть; полные последствия вариантов в question detail.
states: open/answered/withdrawn/stale — business state. submitting/accepted/rejected/retryable — command transport. Вопрос без blocks допустим; task ladder не меняется на blocked.

Контракты и интерфейсы

route: #/e/:estate/p/:project/board?item=:boardItemId
canonical id: question UUID; board item key question:<id>; command_id отдельно
commands:
  • fabric_question_ask({command_id,task_id?,about?,topic?,text,why_blocked?,options:[{id,label,consequence}],blocks:task_id[],recipient_ref?})
  • fabric_question_check({question_id,after_seq?})
response: QuestionReceipt {question_id,accepted_seq,status,decision_ref?,delivery_ref?,problem?}; recipient actor/role только после проверки membership
query: questions.get(scope,id); blocks содержат canonical task refs; asOfSeq+coverage из общего ReadResult
read policy: Questions are authored commands, not a sortable collection. Their previews inherit Board rank/scope; check(id) returns current revision. Source timeout is retryable, never answered/empty. Reconnect repeats same command/check ID.
outer envelope: Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

Инварианты

  • Client не назначает себе priority, estate или author; server выводит их из authenticated actor.
  • Все options имеют уникальные стабильные IDs; chosen_option далее обязан принадлежать именно этой revision.
  • Один retry одного command не порождает новый вопрос; второй вопрос с похожим текстом не дедуплицируется без семантического решения.
  • Не раскрывать чужую question через check; отсутствие прав и отсутствие записи обрабатываются без leakage.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Cross-project blocks или recipient → rejection до append.
  • Потерян response после commit → повтор command возвращает прежний receipt.
  • Question уже answered/withdrawn → check не возвращает obsolete open.
  • Process передаётся topic=process при kind=decision; kind=process отвергается, priority использует существующий decision weight.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Additive event schema для recipient/correlation и idempotency; legacy null остаётся неопределённым адресатом, не назначается молча operator.
  • Согласовать M184 producer: kind=decision + topic=process; добавить topic как отдельное typed поле. Не расширять QuestionKind/priority weights только ради темы.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • questionAskCommandRoundTrip: duplicate command, 2 blocked tasks, zero blocks, invalid options.
  • questionScopeIsolation: own positive control и foreign estate/project/question.
  • questionCheckCurrentRevision: answer/withdrawal race.

Предлагаемые новые файлы

  • apps/desktop/src/main/questions/QuestionService.ts
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/questions.ts
  • apps/desktop/src/main/questions/QuestionService.test.ts

Как измерить эффект

Статически подтверждено: schema существует, tool producer отсутствует; продуктовый outcome новой ask UX ещё не измерен.

Что опровергнет решение

  • Вывод о missing producer изменится, если появится реальный registerTool ask/check и round-trip probe, а не только имя в docs.

Выбранное решение

entry: Home needs-you preview, project preview, attention command и прямой deep link.
exit: Question detail или конкретный task/grant/proposal; после решения остаётся receipt с переходом к resolved item, Back возвращает scope/filter/selection.

Контракты и интерфейсы

route: #/e/:estate/board или #/e/:estate/p/:project/board?item=:boardItemId&kind=:kind&status=open
canonical id: question:<uuid> | review:<task_id> | lease:<work_id> | proposal:<uuid> | refusal:<command/effect_ref>
query: board.query({scope,filters,sort:rank|age|project,cursor?,snapshot_seq?}) → ReadEnvelope<{items,total,countsByProject,rankRevision,nextCursor}>
dto: BoardItem {subjectRef,origin:authored|derived,kind,rank:{value,components},owner,waitingSince,blockerRefs,availableActions,sourceRefs}; availableActions объясняют blocked/denied reason
read policy: Default rank desc → age desc → canonical ID asc; optional age/project grouping, filters project/kind/open/history/owner. Cursor pins rank snapshot. Complete empty only when every required source read succeeds; partial/stale/reconnect follow ReadEnvelope.
outer envelope: Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

Инварианты

  • Task Kanban — состояния задач; ranked Board — обязательства оператора. Их нельзя назвать одним DTO/экраном.
  • Unresolved не dismiss/read; resolved исключается из open, но история доступна.
  • Сортировка стабильна для одного snapshot; pagination использует тот же rankRevision/asOfSeq.
  • Failure одного обязательного source не даёт zero badge/всё спокойно; stale mutations проверяют revision на server.

Отказы и восстановление

  • 11 project/6 estate obligations: hidden count+full link, ничего не исчезает.
  • Policy refuse после grant/закрытия перестаёт требовать действие согласно current command state.
  • Question исчезла при ответе другого человека: показывается resolved receipt, draft можно скопировать, повторный submit conflict.
  • Невалидный cursor или stale snapshot → refresh hint, выбранный объект не подменён.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Board остаётся query, не новая business truth table; projection unresolved obligations допустима только rebuildable и source-linked.
  • Сохранить adapter старого attention IPC до миграции всех consumers/counters; затем удалить duplicate ranking.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • boardQuerySameSnapshot: top5/top10/full/counters agree.
  • boardPartialReadNeverClear: один source упал, остальные доступны с coverage.
  • boardStablePagination: >500 mixed items и rank change между pages.
  • boardKeyboardResolveBack: focus/item remain during refresh.

  • apps/desktop/src/shared/board.ts

  • apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/BoardPreview.tsx

Pure rankBoard существует и тестируется; его использование реальным readAttention не найдено. Новые interaction outcomes не измерены.

Что опровергнет решение

  • Если текущий attention query будет реально заменён scoped ranked union с error envelope, вывод о wiring gap устареет.

Выбранное решение

entry: Из Board выбран реальный вопрос, блокирующий existing task.
exit: Ответ долговечен, decision виден, agent получил ровно свой ответ, оставшиеся blockers честны; следующий observable step связан с ответом.

Контракты и интерфейсы

route: Сквозной маршрут Board→Question→Decision→Task/Run→Board
canonical id: Связка question_id,answer_command_id,decision_id,delivery_id,task_id; история сохраняет каждый receipt
interface: Composition over M152.commit and M152.continue, no new truth DTO/store
read policy: Aggregate detail composes commit and continuation; never compresses partial outcome into one success/failed enum. Current receipt remains reachable if it leaves open Board.
outer envelope: Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

Инварианты

  • Commit может поставляться независимо от plan steps; full milestone требует continue.
  • M152 не переносит произвольное provider-native hidden context между агентами.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Commit succeeded/delivery failed — ответ не исчезает, task не объявляется resumed.
  • Partial rollout clients читают неизвестные delivery states безопасно.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Canonical milestone M152 остаётся; .commit/.continue — execution nodes, не новые M IDs.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • boardAnswerResumeVerticalFixture: two blockers, dead+live session branches, retried command, decision graph evidence.

Выбранное решение

entry: Question detail Board или approval/change detail; оператор выбирает option или вводит ответ, видит scope и затронутые задачи.
exit: Committed receipt с question revision, decision ref и остатком blockers; затем отдельный delivery status.
recipe: Одна server transaction проверяет open+expectedRevision+scope+policy, фиксирует answer и decision lineage и обновляет все blocker множества. Один command_id определяет retries. Не делать два независимых append без общей atomic boundary.
preview: До commit: зачем ответ, варианты/последствия, primary Submit. После: кто ответил, ответ, decision link, «продолжение готовится/не требуется».
states: editing/submitting/committed/conflict/rejected/retryable. Business answered не равно delivered и не значит task done.

Контракты и интерфейсы

route: Board route + item=question:<id>; после commit сохраняется detail answered item
canonical id: question_id + expected_question_seq; decision_id + answer_command_id
command: questions.answer({command_id,question_id,expected_seq,answer,chosen_option?,authority_ref?})
response: AnswerCommitReceipt {question_id,decision_ref,commit_seq,remainingBlockersByTask,continuationRequired,delivery_ref?}
read policy: Question detail fixed by ID; options keep declared order, consequences do not re-sort. Draft persists on error/conflict; current question seq required. Reconnect checks command status before resubmission.
outer envelope: Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

Инварианты

  • Нельзя получить answered без decision при decision-producing contract или decision без committed answer.
  • Human answer не требует выдуманных citations; agent settlement проходит M157/M168.
  • Два open question Q1/Q2: ответ Q1 снимает только Q1.
  • Нельзя выдать effect grant через текст ответа без существующего typed authority boundary.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Double click и ответ с другого клиента → одно winning commit, loser получает current receipt/conflict.
  • DB outage после client timeout → запрос command status/retry тем же ID; draft сохраняется.
  • Option ID исчез в новой question revision → reject stale, не сопоставлять по label.

Миграция и совместимость

  • S06 atomic command/ledger; backfill legacy answered without decision как incomplete, не выдумывать старое основание.
  • Projection blocked_by совместимость: authoritative blockers list, scalar только derived first-open convenience.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • answerCommitAtomic: failure injection между answer/decision/blockers.
  • answerCommitCompetingActors: один победитель; duplicate идемпотентен.
  • answerCommitMultiBlocker: Q2 остаётся.

  • apps/desktop/src/main/questions/AnswerService.ts
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/answer.ts

Текущий projector checked статически; новые transaction/command не существуют. Старый M148 probe покрывает один question→две tasks, не две questions→одна task.

Выбранное решение

entry: После commit оператор остаётся на question/task; agent check получает durable response.
exit: acked тем target task/session authority epoch либо visible needs-restart/rejected; task возвращается к работе только если нет других blockers и policy допускает.
recipe: ContinuationService пишет addressed delivery envelope; responder выбирает live session с lease/epoch. Одна доставка может повторяться, получатель дедуплицирует command и подтверждает его ID. При смерти session UI предлагает guarded resume существующей незавершённой task с новым session, актуальным pack и прежним decision receipt.
preview: «Ответ записан» и «доставка ожидает/получена/требуется перезапуск» — разные строки. Retry повторяет доставку, не ответ и не grant.
states: queued/delivering/acked/retryable/needs_restart/obsolete/rejected; delivered-by-transport допускается как промежуточное, не accepted-by-agent.

Контракты и интерфейсы

route: Task SCR32 или Board answered item; delivery=:command_id в detail
canonical id: answer_command_id + delivery_id + task_id + task_run_id + target fabric_session_id + authority_epoch:Seq. S04 creates TaskRun on admission; addressed/dispatched continuation requires that ID. Null only while pending before admission or reading an explicitly legacy receipt.
command: continuations.retry({delivery_id,expected_revision}) / tasks.resume({task_id,decision_ref,command_id})
dto: ContinuationReceipt {committedAnswerRef,targetRef,transportState,ackState,lastAttemptAt,nextRetryAt,problem,retryAllowed,restartAllowed}
read policy: Delivery attempts ordered recorded seq; current target and latest attempt primary. Filters old/superseded delivery in detail only. No delivery yet means queued/unsupported according to capability, not acked. Reconnect queries persisted delivery status.
outer envelope: Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

Инварианты

  • Text bytes sent не ack.
  • Answer commit никогда не повторяется при delivery retry.
  • Obsolete epoch не получает право работать; новый runner не наследует одноразовый grant автоматически.
  • Живой agent, polling question_check, также выдаёт explicit received ack, если transport contract это поддерживает. TaskState done/cancelled нельзя reopen: после terminal создаётся новая linked task с origin; existing unfinished task получает новый TaskRun.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Session died before send/after send/before ack; lost ack; duplicate delivery; renderer reload.
  • Decision superseded while envelope queued → old envelope obsolete; delivered old fact remains evidence.
  • Другой вопрос блокирует task → ответ доставлен, task remains waiting.
  • Unknown transport outcome reconciles delivery/request ID; no new answer/effect identity and no blind duplicate side effect.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Add durable command/delivery receipts from S04/M103. Require task_run_id for every new addressed delivery; M188 adds progress plans but is not the producer of initial TaskRun identity. Preserve legacy records as incomplete read-only observations; never dispatch from ambiguous old IDs.
  • Legacy no-ack runner помечается capability=unsupported, не автоматический success.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • continuationAckLostRetry: same command consumed once.
  • continuationDeadSessionResumeExistingTask: unfinished task ID retained; terminal task uses explicit new linked task, no copied spent grant.
  • continuationEpochFence: old session rejected.
  • input: Two TaskRuns reuse one capable native session; run1 ack arrives after run2 starts
    expected: Ack addresses delivery/run1 only; no run2 work accepted. Addressed delivery without task_run_id rejected, pending preadmission may omit it.
    status: proposed_not_executed

Предлагаемые новые файлы

  • apps/desktop/src/main/continuation/ContinuationService.ts
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/continuation.ts
  • apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/ContinuationStatus.tsx

Как измерить эффект

Heuristic PTY delivery подтверждена кодом; semantic continuation ack отсутствует.

Что опровергнет решение

  • Если runner предоставляет reliable addressed delivery+ack hook, transport adapter может быть тонким; screen states всё равно нужны.

Контракты и интерфейсы

Snapshot: {scope,cursor,now,questions:[{id,seq,status,kind,topic?,about,text,options,blocks[],originRef,askedAt}],tasks:[{id,revision,status}],projects:[{id,status}],policyRevision}
Action: {kind:'withdraw'|'merge_exact'|'escalate',questionId,expectedSeq,basisRefs,reasonCode,survivorId?,components?}
DedupKey: scope+kind+topic+about+normalized exact text+canonical option IDs/content+semantic origin identity; NOT about alone; whitespace normalization only, no model equivalence
Commit: {commandId,cycleRef?,action,expectedVersions}; atomic answer/withdraw+remaining blocker recompute from S06/M152.commit; merge retains alias/source authors and unions authorized blockers

Алгоритм

  • Read complete scoped question/task snapshot; unavailabletasksource yields unknown, no withdraw.
  • Withdraw only when a non-empty set of blocked tasks is entirely cancelled and no independent decision requirement remains. Empty blocks, mixed cancelled/open, done/review, archivedproject alone do not prove question stale. Archive shows projectarchived reason for review; no new hidden status by shortcut.
  • Merge exactly equivalent open question rows: survivor oldest askedAt then lexicalID. Keep duplicate alias and history, transfer block links atomically, withdrawn reason exact_duplicate_of:<id>. Different options, scope, origin or unresolved dependent meaning ⇒ no merge.
  • Age escalates priority components through existing deterministic score, neverexpires question. Write new priority event only if resulting components differ; sweep repeat no event spam.
  • All commands CAS on basisrevision, actor authentic system; retry same command returns original result. No management TaskRun invented.

Инварианты

  • Question open with surviving need remainsopen even if designated blocked_by taskcancelled.
  • A withdrawn/merged question no longer blocks, but otheropen questions keep task blocked and earliest active blocker derived.

  • No autoanswer from agent claim; settlement is M158/M168 validated citation command, separate fromhygiene.

Контракты и интерфейсы

RecordCommand: {commandId,claim,sourceRef,kind:'note'|'finding'|'decision'|'trap',category:'project'|'agents'|'harness'|'fabric'|'process'='project',about:AboutRef|null,evidenceRefs:EvidenceRef[],occurrenceRef?:{sourceKind,sourceId,episodeKey},supersedes?:{factId,expectedSeq},validFrom?}; host adds estate/project/actor/task_run_id/session bindings; client classification never escalates authority
AboutRef: {namespace:'project'|'provider'|'skill'|'fabric-component'|'process',key:string,applicabilityRevision?:string}; normalized stable key, max256; local source URI separate. basename not stable subject or privacy filter
OccurrenceRef: {occurrenceId:UUID,origin:{system:string,sourceId:string,episodeKey:string},firstObservedAt,lastObservedAt,evidenceRefs[],grouping:'host_observed'|'reviewed'|'agent_proposed',reviewerRef?}; UNIQUE estate+scope+originSystem+sourceId+episodeKey; run correlation not recurrence identity
RecordResult: {factId,seq,revisionRef,classification:'project-internal'|...,correction:{status:'not_requested'|'superseded'|'conflict_proposed'|'rejected',reason?,previousRef?},commitCursor}; never echo requested supersedes as if committed

Алгоритм

  • Keep category orthogonal to existing kind, trust/source kind, retention/classification, function/scope; agents may propose category but policy validates eligibility, category alone never permits sharing.
  • Default all old facts category=project; about=null, provenance=legacy_source_ref and occurrence=unknown. No historical source inference from basename or model.
  • New correction CAS references exact prior fact seq/current state; person may replace approved scope, agent→human correction stored as competing proposal with explicit correction outcome, never silent yes. Same command returns same fact id/seq.
  • Occurrence allocated from authenticated capture episode; multiple reporter facts can cite one occurrence. Agent-generated unique IDs alone are provisional and excluded from automatic N threshold until host evidence or independent review establishes distinctness.
  • Keep immutable revisions via existing fact IDs/new revision IDs and supersedes edges; stable family ID derived from accepted lineage not hash of changing claim. Conflicting siblings remain visible. No full conceptual MemoryKernel API shipped under FAC0.1.0.

Инварианты

  • category enum enforced in DB and DTO; unknown/new uppercase category rejects, missing defaultsproject.
  • about matching alone does not merge distinct claims or events; exact dedup canonical tuple includes scope/category/about/kind/normalizedclaim/applicability and separateoccurrence identity.
  • Agent memory remains untrusted even if category=fabric; trusted actor from credential, not tool arguments.
  • validFrom future invisible in current reader; supersession old actor provenance unchanged; deleted/suppressed feedback not revived by new grouping.

Негативные случаи

  • input: legacy journal replay old memory events
    expected: sameid/claim/source/actor; categoryproject, occurrenceunknown, no outbound eligibility
  • input: same incident referenced by3task-runs and3memorycommands
    expected: 1verifiedoccurrence, not3
  • input: 3different incident source IDs/evidence verified under sameabout
    expected: 3distinct occurrences; eligible for M184 threshold
  • input: unknowncategory/agents suppliesestate+actorperson
    expected: invalidcategory/scope error and diagnostic refusal; no authority elevation
  • input: two concurrent corrections expected seq20
    expected: one accepted lineage, otherconflict; oldhuman row never silentlyoverwritten
  • input: agent attempts supersedehuman
    expected: new competing claim explicitly returned conflict_proposed; originalcurrent preserved

Миграция и совместимость

  • Add columns with category defaultproject; backfill project_id and actor from existing journal only; do not guessmissing relationships.
  • Version event/DTO where required; retain existing memory.project.recorded@1 replay adapter. New repeated samefactid differentcontent must reject, not use old upsert as mutable rewrite.
  • Expose task/run/occurrence links only where actual matching source exists; historicalunknown permitted.

  • Keep category orthogonal to existing kind, trust/source kind, retention/classification, function/scope; agents may propose category but policy validates eligibility, category alone never permits sharing.
  • Default all old facts category=project; about=null, provenance=legacy_source_ref and occurrence=unknown. No historical source inference from basename or model.
  • New correction CAS references exact prior fact seq/current state; person may replace approved scope, agent→human correction stored as competing proposal with explicit correction outcome, never silent yes. Same command returns same fact id/seq.
  • Occurrence allocated from authenticated capture episode; multiple reporter facts can cite one occurrence. Agent-generated unique IDs alone are provisional and excluded from automatic N threshold until host evidence or independent review establishes distinctness.
  • Keep immutable revisions via existing fact IDs/new revision IDs and supersedes edges; stable family ID derived from accepted lineage not hash of changing claim. Conflicting siblings remain visible. No full conceptual MemoryKernel API shipped under FAC0.1.0.
Что увидит пользователь: Filters category/kind and explicit source/actor/conflict; correction receipt states what actually changed.

M183.local · Local default-on service intake и durable suppression

Спецификация; реализация не выполнена этой итерацией

Экраны, сценарии и UX-контекст →

Зависит от: M182 · S02.store · S14 · Пакет: часть основной задачи

current state

planned_absence

Предлагаемые API

  • shared/feedbackContract.ts: LocalFeedbackCandidate, FeedbackPolicy, Suppression (new)
  • main/feedbackIntake.ts: collectServiceInsights (new, S15 optional scheduler adapter later)
  • new feedback policy/intake/suppression operational events + projection; no HTTP

Контракты и интерфейсы

LocalCandidate: {candidateId:UUID,lineageId:UUID,source:{estateId,projectId,factRef,occurrenceRefs[]},category:'agents'|'harness'|'fabric',claimLocal:string,aboutLocal:AboutRef|null,applicabilityRevision?,classification,redactionSummary,createdAt,state:'local_only'|'quarantined'|'preview_ready'|'suppressed',outboundEligible:false|{schemaRef,contractRef}}
Policy: {scope:estateId,revision,localIntakeEnabled:boolean /* default true */,outboundMode:'unconfigured'|'off'|'structured'|'manual',epoch:Seq /* decimal string */,activatedFromCursor:Cursor,privacyContractRef:null|Ref,retentionPolicyRef:Ref}
Suppress: {commandId,candidateId,expectedRevision,reasonCode:'user_suppressed'|'policy_ineligible'|'privacy_rejected'}→ {lineageId,suppressedAt,policyEpoch,receipt}; source memory remains untouched
Read: ReadEnvelope<{policy,candidates,countsByState,lastIntakeCursor,retainedTombstones}>

Алгоритм

  • On committed newmemoryrevision consume category service only; classifier can suggest product issue but local candidate contains private source links and untrusted claim. No source content leaves by being classified.
  • Dedup lineage and occurrence group; lock unique lineage+candidate purpose; transaction creates candidate+intake checkpoint. Poll/replay exactly same receipt, notnewcandidate.
  • Suppress journals durable lineage tombstone and removes candidate payload from visible queue according to content-retention policy; rebuild restores suppression before considering eligible candidates. Never use local UI preference as only suppression storage.
  • Intake OFF separately stops future source consumption and tracks policycursor; existing local candidates retained unless explicit remove. Outbound OFF does not stop localservicelearning. Re-enable only newly observed cursor bydefault, explicit backfill preview required.
  • Existing rawmemorysource is not deleted by feedback suppression. Privacy UI must state private source remains in project, minimized feedback copy deletion retention separately; no hidden network endpoint magic.

Инварианты

  • Schema refuses candidatecategoryproject/process even ifcaller sets eligibletrue.
  • All candidate source IDs private; absence in external DTO not basis for claiminganonymous.
  • Suppression key independent of privacy schema version/claim revision; same incident after redaction update remains suppressed unless explicit restore command.
  • Local policy and suppression are business/operational estate decisions, not settings.json syncpreferences.
  • No automatic Board task from incomingfeedback; suggestion through same checker/authority as any untrustedinput.

Негативные случаи

  • input: project/process insight with service-looking claim
    expected: LOCAL_INELIGIBLE, no feedbackcandidate/outbox send
  • input: candidate suppressed then DB projectionrebuild + corrected claim +privacyVersion2
    expected: same lineage suppressed,queuehidden,HTTP0
  • input: three refreshes of onefact
    expected: onecandidate,intakecursor monotonic aftercommit
  • input: company/email/path/IP/basename in claim
    expected: private/quarantine; redaction detector notsafeapproval
  • input: outboundoff/intakeon
    expected: localcandidatecreated, no send attempt
  • input: intakeoff thenon after100facts
    expected: no silenthistoricalbackfill; newcursorstartingpointnamed

Миграция и совместимость

  • Add feature inactive upstream fromdayone. Oldfacts eligibleonly via explicit scoped localbackfill command, outputlocalonly.
  • Retentionpolicy requires minimal lineage tombstone durable beyond rebuild; do not drop on preference reset.
  • New events registered and replaydeterministic; localintake may run directdomainconsumer without fullweeklyretro dependency.

Что приходит от зависимостей

  • id: M182
    payload: category,lineage,occurrence,sourceclassification
  • id: S02
    payload: estate authority+commanddedup+atomic append boundary
  • id: S14
    payload: source availability/intake errors/visible queue status

Границы активации

  • D-PRIVACY-01 separates localdefaulton from upstreamactivation; no autonomoussend bythiscard.

Queue with private origin, local collection switch, suppression reason/time, local-only state and honest retained source distinction.
