M183.upstream · Versioned external feedback DTO, immutable preview и opt-out fencing

Спецификация; реализация не выполнена этой итерацией

Экраны, сценарии и UX-контекст →

Зависит от: M183.local · S03 · S10 · Пакет: часть основной задачи

current state

planned_absence_external_gate

Предлагаемые API

  • main/feedbackTransport.ts: preparePreview, enqueueApprovedPayload, dispatchOutbox, reconcileDelivery, requestRemoteDeletion (new)
  • shared/feedbackContract.ts: ExternalFeedbackV1, PrivacyContract, OutboxItem/DeliveryReceipt (new)
  • endpoint implementation ownedoutside repo, explicitly configure and version; no guessed productionURL

Контракты и интерфейсы

ExternalStructuredFeedback: {schemaVersion:'1',category:'agents'|'harness'|'fabric',componentCode:ClosedEnum,issueCode:ClosedEnum,appVersion:ReviewedReleaseEnum,providerFamily:ClosedEnum|'unspecified',countBucket:'1'|'2-4'|'5-9'|'10+',periodWeek:'YYYY-Www'}; additionalProperties:false. Closed enums generated from reviewed public taxonomy; no arbitrary names/claim/paths/source ids/source timestamps/model output/identifying stableinstallation id. Taxonomycombination may still reveal rarecase—allowlist privacy review required.
ManualPayload: Separate schema+mode with exact selected text after redaction preview; approval owns payloadDigest and receiverContractRef. Raw claim cannot inherit structureddefault-on policy. Project/process content export refused by category, manual path not bypass.
PrivacyContract: {id,revision,endpointOrigin,requestMethod,payloadSchemaHash,acceptedMetadata:{headers,ipAndAccessLogPolicy,proxyPolicy,requestIdLifetime},purposes,retention:{maxDuration,owner,deletionMechanism},authenticationMode,idempotency:{supported,scope,ttl},deletion:{supported,receiptSchema},errorReceiptSchema,reviewedAt,reviewer,revokedAt?}
Preview: {previewId,candidateLineageId,policyEpoch,policyRevision,receiverContractRef,payloadBytesBase64,payloadSha256,payloadSchemaHash,redactionSummary,metadataContract,expiresAt}; approve{commandId,previewId,payloadSha256,expectedEpoch}; any changedbytes/contract neednewpreview
Outbox: {deliveryId:UUID,lineageId,policyEpoch,approvedPayloadRef,digest,receiverContractRef,deliveryKey:OpaqueRandomPerDelivery,state:'queued'|'leased'|'dispatching'|'acknowledged'|'failed_retryable'|'failed_final'|'cancelled_before_dispatch'|'delivery_unknown',attemptCount,nextAttemptAt,leaseEpoch,dispatchStartedAt,ackAt,remoteReceipt?,lastErrorCode,retentionUntil}; deliveryKey stableperretry, notsourceidentifier
OptOut: {commandId,expectedPolicyRevision,outboundMode:'off'} transaction increments epoch and cancels queued/leased items not dispatched; result {cancelledCount,inflightIds,acknowledgedRetainedCount,deletionAvailable}; remote deletion separate request and confirmationstate
EpochWire: policyEpoch:Seq and leaseEpoch:Seq are decimal strings; no JSON Number roundtrip. Stale 9007199254740992 differs from current 9007199254740993 and cannot authorize dispatch.

Алгоритм

  • No endpoint/contract→no dispatcher. Privacy contract approval is externalactivationgate, not developmenttest success. Build fakeendpoint fixture and localpreview before actualendpoint.
  • Structuredprojection constructs new fixed DTO from validated categorical fields; never redact-and-send originalobject. Remove noIDs logic entirely; filenames/rarevalues/IP still governed. Manualtextperitem noteligibledefault-on.
  • Prepare immutable payload blob+digest, receivercontract+epoch; approved event and outbox projection commit atomically. Rebuild materializes state only, no POST.
  • Before dispatch reserveS03 bounded grant/permit and outboxlease with currentpolicyepoch under transaction; recheck epoch at last reversible point. Record dispatchstarted durably, then network. Responsevalidated+remoteid→acknowledged. Commit receipt failure→unknown until reconcile.
  • Optout increments epoch: queued/leased cancel; dispatching attempt best-effortabort but honest possible-send. PreviouslyACK retained remotely perreceiverpolicy; remote delete requested separately and onlyconfirmedafterremoteproof.
  • LostACK retry uses endpoint declaredidempotency TTL and same deliverykey/digest; outsideTTL or noidempotency→unknown/manualreconcile, notblindPOST. Re-enable startsnewpolicycursor; suppressedlineages remainblocked.
  • Receiver treats allfeedback as untrusted suggestions; no machine commandembeddedintext/taskautocreation/checkerruleupdate.

Инварианты

  • Endpoint credentials never in payload/projectmemory; perhopsecretrefs only. URLredirects outside acceptedorigin refused; safeerror strips requestbody/headers.
  • ExternalpayloadDigest immutable after approval; retries exactlysamebytes, metadatawithinacceptedcontract.
  • No inference ‘all sent removed’ fromlocaldelete/optout. Deliveryreceipt and remotecontentpurge have separate timeline.
  • No claimzeroanonymizationrisk; servicecategory can carrysensitivecontext so defaultstructuredfieldset is necessary but needsreview.
  • Unknowncost/remainingquota notfree; outboundexistingpolicy permission cannot grantagent autonomousprivacypolicychanges.

Негативные случаи

  • input: raw claim includes clientdomain/email/filename/rareincident
    expected: structuredbodycontainsnone; manual staysquarantined until explicitpreviewapproval
  • input: previewhashA, mutatepayloadB beforedispatch
    expected: DIGEST_MISMATCH, noHTTP
  • input: endpointabsent orprivacypolicyrevoked
    expected: HTTPcount0, queuednotconfigured/off reason
  • input: optout beforelease, afterleasebeforewrite, afterOSwritebeforeACK
    expected: firsttwo cancelled; last inflight/unknown unless validACK, neverunsentpromise
  • input: serveraccepted butACKlost, retry
    expected: sameidempotencykey/body returnsone remote item; withoutsupport unresolvedunknown
  • input: rebuild repeated10times with suppressed/outbox sent rows
    expected: suppressedstillhidden, noresend, HTTP0 duringrebuild
  • input: remoteDELETE timeout
    expected: deletion_pending/unknown; no deletedlabel
  • input: providerlogs retainIP14dayscontract, UIclaims 'безследов'
    expected: copyacceptancefails; actualmetadataretentiondisplayed

Миграция и совместимость

  • Featureupstream remainsunconfigured forallexistingestates; localON preserved. Introduce policyepochandversionedprivacycontract before anysend.
  • Outbox/suppression as durable operationaljournal/projection, not secondmemorytruth; payloadcontent can bepurged by acceptedretention withreceipt, lineage tombstone not erased implicitly.
  • External schema version separate FACmemorypromotion; cannot route publicservicefeedback through rawproject globalpromotion serializer.

Что приходит от зависимостей

  • id: M183.local
    payload: privatecandidate,lineage,suppression and policycursor
  • id: S03
    payload: grant reserve/dispatch/receipt/unknown reconciliation + expiry/revocation enforcement
  • id: S10
    payload: newprivacyADR, payloadtaxonomy/version and truthfulcopycontracts

Границы активации

  • D-PRIVACY-01; actual endpointOrigin/idempotency/privacy/retention/IP/accesslogs/deletion contract mandatory. Syntheticendpoint test does not removegate.

Exact payload+receiver, queued/sent/unknown, optout cancellation summary, honest retainedremotecopy/deletion status.

    Источник: git-blob · 03311c856b7771e5e4cfff967b138e89e292c67f · перенесено с 5051def (identical-bytes)**Пользователь видит.** Project preview current changes → отдельный decision graph SCR33 → решение → основание/контекст/связанные задачи. Не прячется в M190.

Выбранное решение

entry: Project Decisions preview, ответ Board, факт памяти, source-ref задачи/графа.
exit: SCR33 exact decision→superseded ancestors/cited fact/answer/past pack/task; Back восстанавливает selection/asOf.
recipe: DecisionService возвращает DAG lineage с multiple predecessors/cycle gaps, exact actor и typed evidence. Flat list и graph используют один snapshot. Legacy source strings parse только безопасным typed resolver.
preview: Последние изменения решений и кто их принял; current vs superseded явно; открыть историю.
states: no-decisions,one-unlinked decision (list),branching history,missing source,cycle diagnostic,partial,stale,source denied. Нельзя обещать скрытый reasoning: только rationale/citations автора, предоставленный pack и последующие retrieval receipts.

Контракты и интерфейсы

route: #/e/:estate/p/:project/decisions?decision=:factId&asOf=:seq; SCR-33
canonical id: memory fact UUID+valid revision/event seq; question/answer refs optional; actor identity distinct session
query: decisions.history({scope,root?,cursor?,asOfSeq?}) → ReadEnvelope<DecisionGraph>; source.resolve(typedRef)
dto: DecisionNode {factId,claim,author:{person|agent|system|unknown,id?},validFrom,validTo,supersessionRefs,rationale?,citations,suppliedPackRef?,retrievalRefs,affectedTaskRefs}
read policy: Current roots newest recorded seq desc with stable fact ID tie; lineage follows recorded supersession relations. Filters subject,author kind,current/superseded,evidence availability and as-of. Missing roots/sources are diagnostic rows; reconnect keeps pinned as-of until operator applies updates.
outer envelope: Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

Инварианты

  • Pack supplied != knowledge exhausted != basis actually used.
  • No guessing causal links from temporal adjacency.
  • Historical exact source version or explicit missing; current pack not substitute.
  • Human original never silently replaced; unknown author not agent.

Отказы и восстановление

  • >200 facts; >50 lineage depth; two replaced facts→one new; no root cycle; missing pack; denied scope; stale decision after opening.

Миграция и совместимость

  • DTO additive provenance fields; M191 historical artifacts dependency for byte-exact pack, earlier partial decision view allowed.
  • SCR33 split from legacy combined plan/decision spec; goal plan moves SCR40 SHOULD, old deep link redirects explicitly.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • decisionHistoryBranchesAndGaps; decisionActorKinds; decisionExactPackBeforeDecision; no fabricated basis.
  • decisionRoundTripNavigation from Board/task/project; source missing preserves node.

Предлагаемые новые файлы

  • apps/desktop/src/main/decisions/DecisionReadService.ts
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/decisionGraph.ts
  • apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/DecisionHistoryPage.tsx

Как измерить эффект

Текущий decisions reader статически не соответствует rich graph; ранее audit artifacts содержат его точные ограничения. Никакой production graph не проверялся.

Что опровергнет решение

  • Полное M152.continue не является предпосылкой read-only M173. Исторический foundation snapshot требовал M152 целиком; текущие execution_nodes и dependency_adjudications явно уточняют вход до M152.commit.

Выбранное решение

entry: Manager вызывает settle по open question; человек видит resolved-by-manager в Board history и decision detail.
exit: Committed settlement с exact basis refs, либо typed refusal→question остаётся Board. Override открывает конкретное заменяемое решение и создаёт supersession через human answer path.
recipe: Validate typed subject+scope+version, current basis и применимость; затем общий M168+M158 gate и M152.commit. Не считать одинаковый about достаточным при разных environment/config revisions.
preview: Кто решил, цитата/факт, применимость, когда, action оспорить; подробная арифметика/trace раскрывается.
states: proposed/checked/settled/refused/overridden; basis-stale,scope-mismatch,trust-revoked показывают причину и путь operator answer.

Контракты и интерфейсы

route: Board?status=answered&answeredByRole=ceo,product-manager&item=question:<id>; decision SCR33?decision=:id
canonical id: question+expected seq, basis fact/prior-answer ID+revision, subject key, scope, settlement command
command: settlement.propose({question_id,expected_seq,basis_refs,answer,subject_ref,policy_revision})
response: CheckedSettlement or Rejection {reasonCode,sourceRefs,remedy}
read policy: Settled history default settlement seq desc with stable ID tie, filters project/subject/actor role/current/overridden. No settlements is an honest empty list; unavailable basis store is partial and prevents new auto settlement.
outer envelope: Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

Инварианты

  • Human decision reversal запрещён независимо от criticality score.
  • Override supersedes decision, не редактирует старую запись; уже исполненный внешний эффект не отменяется магически.
  • No-basis всегда refuse, model confidence не authority.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Basis exists but superseded/different environment; same about чужого project; trust revoked между check и commit.
  • Оператор override после resumed work — показать затронутые pending/running tasks, не утверждать rollback effects.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Structured subject/basis refs additive; legacy plain source_ref не считается подтверждённым basis.
  • Enable settlement only after M158/M168 activation gate; default trust settings не обходят gate.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • settlementCitationValidity: current/superseded/cross-project/config-changed refs.
  • settlementHumanFloorAtLowScore: hard refusal even score below threshold.
  • settlementOverrideLineage: original retained, continuation handles new decision revision.

Предлагаемые новые файлы

  • apps/desktop/src/shared/settlement.ts
  • apps/desktop/src/main/decisions/SettlementService.ts
  • apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/SettlementList.tsx

Как измерить эффект

Accepted ADR и trust helper подтверждены; writer+activation enforcement не найдены в текущем source.

Что опровергнет решение

  • Если authority/subject revision уже обеспечены общим command boundary, service должен переиспользовать его, не вводить вторую policy engine.

Выбранное решение

entry: Предложено заменить decision или manager пытается settlement.
exit: Разрешённый checked change либо approval question с original/replacement/impact; current memory не меняется до принятия.
recipe: Pure criticality module считает компоненты по authoritative current snapshot; separate hard-floor predicate; commit повторно проверяет dependency/policy revisions.
preview: Original→replacement, причина изменения, влияние и действие человека. Score details раскрыты, но причина запроса видна.
states: no-change,eligible,requires-human,stale-assessment,declined,approved; trust is context not green permission badge.

Контракты и интерфейсы

route: Board item=question:<approval_id> ↔ decision SCR33 original/replacement
canonical id: change_proposal_id + base_decision_id/revision + assessment snapshot seq/policy revision
dto: DecisionChangeAssessment {original,replacement,componentValues,score,threshold,hardFloors,affectedRefs,permissionVerdict,evidenceRefs}
command: decisionChanges.assess is pure/read-only and returns assessment with pinned inputs. Applying a proposal is owned by M157 and its M168 checker + S06 atomic commit, with current revision/authority revalidation. M158 itself has no commitApproved writer.
read policy: Assessment detail ordered original → proposed replacement → impact → hard-floor reason → score components. No data/unknown dependency count is incomplete, not zero criticality. Refresh keeps draft and invalidates stale assessment.
outer envelope: Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

Инварианты

  • Score never overrides person/auth floor.
  • Released status/dependent count unknown → incomplete assessment, cannot auto-settle.
  • Threshold comparison explicitly above per ADR; test equality separately, not accidental >= assumption.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Dependencies change between render/approve; project weight changes; person provenance null/unknown; grant expires.
  • Approved proposal targets old superseded decision → conflict, refresh before resubmit.

Миграция и совместимость

  • No global new opinion score stored as truth; assessment receipt carries source revision for audit.
  • Provenance unknown treated conservatively, not guessed agent.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • criticalityBoundaries: threshold-1/equal/+1, dependency cap, negative inputs rejected.
  • criticalityChangedSnapshot: stale approval conflict.
  • criticalityHumanFloorIndependentOfScore.

Предлагаемые новые файлы

  • apps/desktop/src/shared/criticality.ts
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/criticality.test.ts
  • apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/DecisionChangeDetail.tsx

Как измерить эффект

Формула и floor приняты документом; pure criticality implementation не найден.

Что опровергнет решение

  • Оценка не требует новой модельной эвристики; всё, что модель добавляет, должно оставаться proposal/evidence.

Выбранное решение

entry: Estate home inbox preview, project event strip, attention toolbar.
exit: Needs-you→exact Board item; Happened→source subject/receipt; Back restores lane/filter/cursor.
recipe: Use BoardService for needs-you and safe NotableEvent query for happened. Add operator-specific acknowledged seq/cursor/preferences only; do not clone business obligations. Dedup source command/obligation, distinguish occurrence and resolution events.
preview: Needs-you count/actions and a few happened items; each has project/source age/severity. Full Inbox supports filters.
states: loading,verified empty,partial producers,stale,reconnect,read/unread,source unavailable; no read watermark advance from new event arrival or error.

Контракты и интерфейсы

route: #/e/:estate/inbox?lane=needs-you|happened&project=:projectId&item=:canonicalRef
canonical id: Needs-you BoardItem ID; Happened journal estate+seq or canonical source-event ID
query: inbox.query({operator,scope,lane,filters,cursor,asOfSeq}); returned DTO sanitized before renderer
command: inbox.markRead({operator,visibleThroughSeq,expectedCursor}) only happened
dto: NotableEvent {id,kind,title,occurredAt,recordedSeq,actorRef,subjectRef,severity,sourceRefs,readState,detailSafe}
read policy: Needs-you inherits Board rank; Happened recorded seq desc, filters project,event kind,time,read state. Per-operator read cursor never advanced by passive delivery/error. Complete empty distinct from uninstrumented producer.
outer envelope: Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

Инварианты

  • Opening/marking read never resolves obligation.
  • Per-operator state cannot mark another operator read.
  • Exact source inspection never exposes unredacted raw payload by default.
  • No notification source implies source coverage unknown, not zero events.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Old event replays/duplicates; two clients updating cursor; new event arrives before read request; source removed or permissions changed.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Settings/read-cursor schema additive and local/per-operator. Migrated history remains unread/unknown according to explicit initial policy; no arbitrary latest seq auto-read.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • inboxReadCursorRace; inboxNeedsYouNotDismissable; inboxSubjectDeepLinks; inboxSafePayload.

Предлагаемые новые файлы

Feed и attention существуют отдельно; unified Inbox/read state не найден.

Что опровергнет решение

  • Если production event taxonomy уже supplies source refs, reuse them; нельзя повторно выводить user-visible факты по типу события без payload validation.

Выбранное решение

entry: Home cycles summary, project automations, Inbox failure, full system map cycle node.
exit: Cycle detail→tick receipt→started task/run/blocked input/config; manual wake через тот же guarded command, Back retains cycle scope.
recipe: CycleReadService joins actual config and S15 tick receipts, per-source capability inventory. Three columns config enabled/cadence, observation health/age, last outcome. For planned CEO/retro/letter/review sources show planned/uninstrumented. Never infer success from cron expectation.
preview: Нужно вмешательство N + работающих N + unobserved N; последняя проверка. Full table primary columns kind/project/cadence/nextDue/lastOutcome/health/action.
states: disabled/planned/running/waiting plus measured five-state liveness only when detector exists; no telemetry→unknown, app-off→monitor absent; not due/empty workload→skipped reason, not failure.

Контракты и интерфейсы

route: #/e/:estate/cycles?cycle=:cycleKey&project=:projectId; detail tick=:tickRef
canonical id: Cycle definition canonical ID + typed kind/scope; cycle_invocation_id for one admitted window with stable window key. Legacy routine/follower IDs require typed conversion, never one untyped ID.
query: cycles.query({scope,kind,configState,health,cursor}); cycles.history(cycleRef,asOfSeq,cursor)
command: cycles.wake({cycle_ref,command_id,expected_config_revision}) → admitted/refused/coalesced receipt
dto: CycleView {config:{enabled,cadence,timezone,placement,revision},observation:{state,source,age,coverage},lastOutcome:{kind,receipt},nextDue:{at,policy}|unknown}
read policy: Exceptions needing action first, then nextDue asc, then canonical CycleRef; filters project,kind,enabled state,placement,observation health. Unknown nextDue grouped explicitly. Source partial/reconnect never fabricates last success.
outer envelope: Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

Инварианты

  • A started task is not cycle success.
  • Disabled does not mean no inflight work; show both.
  • Sort exceptions first, then nextDue asc and stable CycleRef; unknowns separately labelled, filters reveal hidden counts.
  • Pause reason requires source; app-off no outside detector cannot assert stalled.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Sleep/wake, DST ambiguous/missing wall times, DB down, tick overlap, missed ticks, disabled during run, partial producer coverage.
  • Chain paused event mistaken for routine: typed source required during legacy conversion.

Миграция и совместимость

  • S15 adds tick start/finish/skip/failure receipts before reader truth; legacy ran maps to started, not succeeded.
  • S14 source coverage shared; M180 only unlocks matching detector classifications, not whole screen.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • cycleHistoryKindsAndLegacyChainId; cycleUnknownWithoutDetector; cycleWakeSameAdmissionGuard; DST/sleep fixtures.

  • apps/desktop/src/main/cycles/CycleReadService.ts
  • apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/CyclesPage.tsx

Current routine/chain instrumentation visibly incomplete for all-cycle view; no live unattended runs performed.

Что опровергнет решение

  • Installed independent monitor could supply app-off receipts; this must be discovered by capability, not assumed from docs.

Выбранное решение

entry: Agent tile, project task card, Task SCR32.
exit: Expand current plan, select attempt/revision, open full run history in SCR40 project DID task scope; blocker→Board question, checkpoint→evidence.
recipe: RunStatusReader consumes M188 snapshot and M178 observations; same DTO everywhere. Count done/declared steps in selected plan revision; skipped/failed counts separate. Support parallel active steps. Live updates preserve user selected old run/revision until explicitly switch to latest.
preview: Task title, Run N (no invented total), claimed done/total, current active path(s), blocker, age of contact, independent result if exists.
states: no-plan,declared,working/waiting/quiet/stalled/gone with evidence,partial,replanning,disconnected,reconnecting,old-revision,admission-denied without Run; admitted spawn-failure inside TaskRun,unverified result.

Контракты и интерфейсы

route: Inline preview; #/e/:estate/p/:project/graphs/project-history?task=:taskId&run=:taskRunId&revision=:planRevision
canonical id: Stable task_run_id and plan revision from target M188/S10; no UI-derived iteration from output

read policy: Steps declared order with dependency outline; run history ordinal/recorded seq, revision history declaration seq. Selected historical revision remains pinned. Empty plan is no declaration; stale observation and connection state separate from step status.
outer envelope: Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

Инварианты

  • done claim != verified outcome; no average of confidence/progress.
  • Full denominator tied to declared revision, not tasks remaining.

  • Each admitted execution iteration has its own complete plan with fresh step statuses. Plan revisions within a run preserve history; no inherited done status from previous TaskRun.

  • Slow read A arrives after runB; two active paths; heartbeat fresh+tool hung; no adapter capability; retired plan steps; late old session reports.

Миграция и совместимость

Выбранное решение

entry: Project history/plan previews, agent history, Task run link, Board source, system map module node.
exit: Selected node inspector→exact task/question/run/decision/artifact; Back restores kind/scope/asOf/filters/zoom/selection.
recipe: GraphQuery kind agent_history|project_history|target_plan; route family separate destinations. Journal nodes/edges retain observed/reported/declared origin and accepted/rejected outcome; causal relations explicit. SHOULD query picks plan revision and retains completed membership. Shared renderer infra includes graph/list/outline, not one toggle changes DID into SHOULD.
preview: Project DID последние N observed transitions; agent DID exact binding/session scope; SHOULD remaining obligations/progress of declared revision. Always link to corresponding full scope.
states: empty graph/list with reason,unlinked nodes,partial/truncated,legacy provenance missing,loading,stale,reconnect,pinned-asOf,invalid edge/cycle diagnostic; not silently remove nodes.

Контракты и интерфейсы

route: #/e/:estate/p/:project/graphs/agent-history?agent=:bindingId OR session=:id; /graphs/project-history?task=:id; /graphs/target-plan?revision=:planRev
canonical id: SCR-40 family; kind is route segment; EntityRef union and graph-specific stable edge IDs
query: graphs.query(GraphQuery) → GraphSnapshot (общий контракт далее); graph.getNode(entityRef,scope,asOfSeq)
dto: Four semantic graph types shared infrastructure; decision_history routed separately SCR33, not fourth tab hidden in M190
read policy: DID default recorded seq order with occurred time separately; SHOULD dependency topology plus declared task position, tie stable ID; no time-based invented schedule. Filters entity/actor/state/relation/goal/as-of; graph/list share same query. Pagination and reconnect preserve snapshot.
outer envelope: Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

Инварианты

  • Agent identity must distinguish definition/binding/session; assignments not proof of work.
  • DID source history may contain cycles/returns; only normative dependency subgraph subject to DAG rules.
  • task_links spawned/follows/blocks directions normalized per meaning; membership != causal edge.
  • Pagination snapshot stable, exact scope; current no-data is not full empty graph if coverage partial.

Отказы и восстановление

  • 500+ completed tasks; missing parent; denied target; repeated handoff value; same-session multitask; plan revision while user reads older graph.
  • Historical query interrupted; known edge target not loaded yet shows stub, never dangling silent disappearance.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Keep M173 SCR33; migrate existing SCR33 goal-plan route to SCR40 SHOULD explicitly.
  • S10 clarifying ADR before routing ships; no silent modification of accepted ADR.
  • Add missing IDs/correlation/handoff consumption/needs writers in source-owning cards before promising full graph.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • graphFourSemanticsSharedFixture; graphStableCursor; graphTypedEdgeMeaning; graphNodeBacklinks; graphListAccessibleEquivalent; graphPlanRevisionHistory.

Выбранное решение

entry: Project Memory SCR34, task/run pack receipt, decision supplied context ref, system map knowledge source.
exit: Next-context dry preview→why included/omitted→exact source; Past pack→recorded artifact/version; source back keeps selected mode.
recipe: load snapshot with per-store errors; pure compile(snapshot,budget,compilerRev); launch persists artifact+lockfile separately. Dry preview never append/context event or spawn. Distinct next vs actual past modes. Retain immutable artifact or complete input revisions+compiler/budget for historical reconstruction.
preview: Selected source backend, measured chars/budget, count included/omitted, coverage/freshness. Past pack hash+compiled time+session, no estimate passed as exact.
states: no-history,no-facts,complete,partial-source,over-budget,unsupported-cloud,legacy-incomplete,mirror-behind,mirror-error,preview-outdated; current-vs-past labels always visible.

Контракты и интерфейсы

route: #/e/:estate/p/:project/memory?view=next-context&task=:id; ?view=pack&pack=:eventRef; ?view=lineage&fact=:id; ?view=sync
canonical id: PackRef = immutable artifact id or context.compiled estate+seq; session alone insufficient for historical snapshot
query: memory.preview({scope,task_ref?,snapshot_seq?,budget_spec,compiler_revision}); memory.pack(PackRef); memory.lineage(FactRef); memory.sync(scope)
dto: PackView {mode,sourceSnapshots,budget:{unit:chars|tokens,value,tokenizer?},used,contentHash,artifactRef?,included:[versionedRefs],omitted:[ref,reason],coverage,compilerRevision}; SyncView has own covered/exported seq
read policy: Selector order is same pure versioned compiler path; facts operator group then reported group, newest with stable tie-break in selected snapshot; past packs seq desc. Filters store/kind/author/current/superseded. No history distinct from missing artifact; reconnect refreshes next preview only after marking outdated.
outer envelope: Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

Инварианты

  • No inference that supplied context equals complete knowledge.
  • Char budget is not relabelled token count.
  • Dry no writes/no sessions; same snapshot+compiler+budget deterministic hash.
  • Mirror lag only over declared covered event family, not whole journal seq difference.

Отказы и восстановление

  • One source fails; header alone exceeds budget; rename project/brief changes later; missing compiler input versions; cloud selected but not available; mirror ahead/behind/conflict.

Миграция и совместимость

  • S14 read envelope first; immutable pack persistence additive; legacy pack visible as incomplete when exact original cannot be reconstructed.
  • Full workspace import/backup restore is S12, not prerequisite for read-only preview.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

observed_defects

Предлагаемые API

  • apps/desktop/src/shared/readEnvelope.ts: ReadEnvelope, SourceReceipt, applyScopedRead (new)
  • apps/desktop/src/main/localStore.ts: readResult/writeAtomic/updateWithRevision
  • apps/desktop/src/main/contextPack.ts: collectContextInputs, compileFromSnapshot
  • renderer MemoryOverviewSection per-source state and generation token; App per-consumer cursor

Контракты и интерфейсы

Read: shared_contracts.reads; caller query {scope request resolved server-side, generation, filter, minimumCursor?, pageCursor?}; generation client correlation, not authorization
LocalRead: {value:T,revision:Revision /* opaque */,status:'ready'|'recovered'|'default_missing'|'unreadable',lastGoodAt:string|null,error?:SafeError}
LocalWrite: Command<{patch}> with expected_revision:Revision → canonical CommandResult<{value:T,revision:Revision}>. Committed receipt_ref addresses a durable local operation receipt; conflicts expose current revision. Renderer preserves unsavedPatch independently on every non-committed result; private local persistence is not a journal domain event.
PackAdmission: {purpose:'manual_terminal'|'task_unattended'|'manager',mandatorySources:string[]}; compile result complete/partial/failed; no successful complete if any mandatory read failed

Алгоритм

  • Query through scoped reader returns source receipts and highwater; loader key=(scope,filter,generation). Stale A response ignored after B switch, even if A finishes later.
  • Overview and misses fetch independently, each source success/error published; optional combined headline only when compatible source snapshots. lastSuccessAt remains previous successful timestamp, not overwritten by failed retry.
  • Local JSON writes serialize per file in main: validate→merge at expected revision→write temp same dir0600→fsync→atomic rename→fsyncdir→reply saved. Keep validated last-good separate, invalid original moved to quarantined filename; parsefailure never silently persists defaults over lost file.
  • Settings nested patch per schema, not shallow unknown-property spread. Pin/digest/tabs all use same typed result primitive; coalesce save safely but don't acknowledge revisions skipped. Local preferences never journal as estate state.
  • Manual terminal may start in explicitly labelled degraded context when identity/rules intact; unattended agent/manager authority inputs unavailable→admission deferred. Current catch-and-log in bundle replaced typed readiness; this is local behaviour fix before full S12 restore.

Инварианты

  • No data crosses scope through cache; authorization loss immediately invalidates old scoped value.
  • source unavailable ≠ no rows; mixed counts cannot produce known miss rate.
  • minimumCursor unavailable returns pending/unavailable reason instead of stale exact decision. Eventual search can show lag with exact reader fallback.
  • Seen cursor advances only for payload successfully displayed/acknowledged by that feature; no globalcursor bulkack of failed memory misses.
  • In-memory optimistic preference and persisted preference kept separate; restart returns last committed file.

Негативные случаи

  • input: overview succeeds(count=5), misses throws
    expected: 5 shown with overview source stamp; misses error+retry; no empty misses claim
  • input: project A delayed response arrives after B successful response
    expected: B unchanged, no A IDs/rows visible
  • input: facts SELECT error but project/repo reads succeed
    expected: partial/failed pack with facts unavailable; never 'everything remembered' caveat
  • input: fs write denied while adding favourite
    expected: unsaved state and retry; persisted previous pins preserved; caller gets failed
  • input: process interruption after tempwrite before rename
    expected: old valid file wins; temp can be cleaned; no empty default saved
  • input: malformed settings.json and valid lastgood
    expected: recovered label+diagnostic; preserved settings not overwritten with defaults
  • input: cursor50 received, source consumer apply fails; new request cursor51
    expected: consumer cursor remains prior committed; catch-up includes unread event50

Миграция и совместимость

  • Wrap existing result types via adapters first; independent MemoryOverview counts already rows:null, do not regress.
  • No preference copy into SQL. Introduce versioned JSON envelope and tolerant read of legacy plain JSON; first successful save upgrades atomic format.
  • Context collector separates source IO from pure rendering; old caller compile still adaptable while result propagation across bundle+IPC+whoami delivered same change.

Что приходит от зависимостей

  • id: S02
    payload: server scope + relation/read authorization; bound source errors

Выбранное решение

choice: One CyclePort for routine, chain, hygiene, retro, letters and manual wake; each producer declares policy and receipts. A cycle invocation is orchestration, not automatically a TaskRun or fabricated task. Before UI M186 the producers already expose truthful health/outcomes.
states:
  • CycleDefinition enabled/paused/retired plus host availability observed/unobserved; independent of execution.
  • Window pending → leased → running → completed|skipped_no_delta|partial|failed_known|outcome_unknown; pending/leased → cancelled_before_dispatch. completed/skipped advance watermark; partial advances only explicitly committed subwindows, unknown never advances uncertain work.
  • Active invocation can waiting/backoff without burning a worker; persisted next_eligible_at and bounded attempt budget; manual wake coalesces with eligible current window.
transactions:
  • requestCycle locks cycle slot; deterministic window key dedupes manual/cadence/Board signals, merges unconsumed event range to pending. acquireCycle assigns epoch and owner host_generation under DB clock; role cycles additionally pin role_slot_id/binding_revision and current role epoch.
  • Before work persist through_seq, input ids/hash, policy and definition revision. Producer command keys derive window+logical operation, not transient attempt number. After accepted command results and checkpoint persist atomically, completeWindow advances completed watermark. Late completion by previous fence refused.
  • Wake-worthy event class registry ignores heartbeat/tool trace/checkpoint and self-only maintenance; consume each eligible source event once. A worker result sharing causal root is eligible; no blanket suppression of all descendants. Bound chain hop/iteration and total model/time/cost budget independently.
time policy: Interval routines use UTC interval origin and coalesce_missed_once. Calendar letters use timezone + calendar day key with preserved one-per-day windows; catchup each bounded by max starts per poll. Persist DST policy: nonexistent local trigger→next valid time; ambiguous→first occurrence, one logical window. Record calculated UTC bounds and tzdb/runtime version. If policy changes, new definition revision; never reinterpret old window keys.
app off: A disabled/offline host cannot produce new health receipts. Last observer timestamp and reason remain visible. No always-on claim; next launch processes explicit catch-up. Unknown crash gap cannot be labeled confirmed app closed. Diagnostic source-down overlay is separate from business success.

Контракты и интерфейсы

new files:
  • apps/desktop/src/main/cycleCoordinator.ts:requestCycle,acquireCycle,checkpointCycle,completeCycle
  • apps/desktop/src/shared/cycleWindow.ts:windowFor,catchupWindows
  • apps/desktop/src/main/cycleRegistry.ts:producerDefinitions
schema:
  • cycle_definitions {cycle_id,revision,estate_id,project_id?,kind,placement,role_slot_id?,cadence,timezone,catchup_policy,eligible_event_types,limits,enabled}; PK(cycle_id,revision)
  • cycle_windows {window_id,cycle_id,definition_revision,window_key,from_seq,through_seq,completed_through_seq,state,input_hash,checkpoint_ref}; UNIQUE(cycle_id,definition_revision,window_key)
  • cycle_invocations {invocation_id,window_id,attempt_no,owner_host_generation,lease_epoch,role_epoch?,started_seq,finished_seq,outcome,error_ref,next_eligible_at,budget_ref}; UNIQUE(window_id,attempt_no) and one active leased owner per cycle policy
commands:
  • requestCycle({cycleId,triggerRef,eventThroughSeq?}) → window id/coalesced
  • acquireCycle({windowId,expectedDefinitionRevision}) → lease epoch/input window
  • checkpointCycle({invocationId,expectedEpoch,checkpointRef,committedCommandRefs,throughSeq}) → checkpoint receipt
  • completeCycle({invocationId,expectedEpoch,outcome,completedThroughSeq}) → summary receipt

Инварианты

  • Watermark advances only past durably accounted input.
  • Manual/cadence/Board triggers use same admission and budgets.
  • Last run started is not last successful outcome.
  • Replay reconstructs receipts/epoch values, never dispatches external work.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Two hosts acquire same window → one owner.
  • Crash after command commit before checkpoint → lookup same command key and resume, no duplicate effect.
  • Outdated role binding completes cycle → fence reject; successor can reconcile prior receipts but not inherit live authority blindly.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Adapt current routine.ran/paused@1 to legacy started/paused observations; never invent completed receipts from those rows.
  • Add explicit definitions for existing routine/chain/notifier first; future producer absent reads not_configured, not healthy.
  • S04 launch port reused; small CyclePort module need not wait for M186 or a model. Reference durable engine binding remains ADR0022; local profile truthful.

Выбранное решение

entry: Любой человек/agent/model proposal проходит один предметный service, до authoritative write.
exit: Typed checked command либо rejection receipt, который UI связывает с сохранённым draft/proposal.
recipe: Schemas для proposal variants, validators ссылок/версий/authority/eligibility; transactional revalidation на commit. Checker не оценивает скрытые мысли и не доказывает истинность смысла свободного текста.
preview: Reason, affected object, remedy; diagnostic source refs за раскрытием.
states: validating/accepted/rejected/retryable/stale; rejected != unavailable checker.

Контракты и интерфейсы

route: Остаётся исходная Board/task/decision view; receipt открывается в source inspector
canonical id: proposal/command id + validator_version + input_snapshot_seq
dto: CheckResult = {ok:true,checkedCommand,inputRevisions} | {ok:false,reasonCode,fieldPath?,evidenceRefs,remedy,retryable}
command: checkAndCommit(command,actorContext), no renderer direct DB writer
read policy: No independent primary screen; rejection receipts ordered newest recorded seq in source detail/Inbox. Filter reason/command/actor optional diagnostics. Checker timeout is retryable refusal to commit, never valid.
outer envelope: Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

Инварианты

  • Нельзя bypass checker через вторую IPC/MCP entry.
  • Model output проверяется до употребления, а не after-the-fact badge.
  • Error/timeout checker fail closed, draft не теряется.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Well-typed malicious refs, different project, superseded basis, invalid reorder band, concurrent invalidation.
  • Reject payload содержит secret → safe redacted receipt, не raw prompt в Inbox.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Versioned reason enum и adapters; no new user workflow just for validation.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • checkerPlantedInvalidProposalEachVariant; positive control for every rejection.
  • checkerAllEntrypointsSharedBoundary; concurrent source revision changes.

Предлагаемые новые файлы

  • apps/desktop/src/shared/proposals.ts
  • apps/desktop/src/main/commands/Checker.ts
  • apps/desktop/src/main/commands/Checker.test.ts

Как измерить эффект

Контракты и интерфейсы

RouterPolicy: {revision,orderedProviders:[{providerRef,modelRef,modelRevision,accountPoolRef,capabilityHash}],maxAttemptsTotal,perAttemptTimeoutMs,totalDeadlineMs,allowedFallbackReasons[],probe:{cadenceMs,timeoutMs,maxAttempts,budgetRef},cooldown:{minimumMs,maximumMs,jitterSeedPolicy},budgetProfileRef}
Budget: {invocationId,policyRevision,deadlineAt,attemptsReserved,attemptsFinished,maxAttemptsTotal,costReservedMicrounits,costKnownMicrounits,costUnknown:boolean,maxCostMicrounits}; host authoritative, survives process crash; providerreset cannotreset
Switch: {invocationId,turnId,fromProviderRef,toProviderRef,reason,previousAttemptReceipt,checkpointRef,poolRevision,approvedAt}; durable before newdispatch
Health: {providerRef,checkedAt,expiresAt,status:'healthy'|'cooldown'|'auth_required'|'unknown',reason,nextProbeAt}; last success snapshot is not timelesshealthy

Алгоритм

  • Resolve eligible approved provider profiles and account pool at invocation admission; reserve totalattempt/time/budget once for wholeinvocation.
  • Before each attempt atomically reserve remaining attempt and budget; deadline/cancel/epoch checked. Differentprovider doesnot reset counters. Transportretry counts asattempt whenrequestmaybesent, not onlysuccessful response.
  • On auth invalid/revoked suspendaccount; fallback only alreadyapprovedeligible account/pool/reason, never ambienthomecredentials. Health cooldown suppressesliveattempts; scheduled separatebounded probes permitrecovery without requiring userfailure.
  • Switch at normalized turn checkpoint after all previous tool effects reconciled and no pending opaquevendorcontinuation. If response partiallyexecuted nativeagent cannot seamlesslymove; close/unknown invocation, explicitnewinvocation fromFabricpack anddurablereceipts.
  • Rebuild router context fromdurable attemptreceipts; unknownattempt cost reservesconservative budgetandrequiresreconcile; failuretodispatch knownbeforewrite releases reservation asdefined S04/S03. Wholewakebudget persists acrossretries.
  • No percallbillingclaim fromstalepriceconfig. Unsupportedmodelwindow/pricingrequiredforhardcostcap→unavailable admission or explicitlytoken/timeboundedprofile approved, notassumedfree.

Инварианты

  • Retryablefailure iterationrefund mayrestoreproductiveiteration only, nevertotalattempt/walltime/spend.
  • No replay/healthprobe sends realwork; theirpurpose,budget and receipts separate.
  • No silentcrossvendor transfer ofopaque reasoning/session objects; explicitrationale/toolreceipt/textcheckpoint is portable, nothiddenstate.
  • Unknownquota blocks unattended admission perS04; manager highfrequencyticknotexempt.
  • NativeCLI ownfallback/subagentbudget must be disabled orcertified insidehosttotalbudget profile; otherwise managercapabilitynotadmitted.

Негативные случаи

  • input: providersA/B/C alwaysfail; maxAttemptsTotal=3
    expected: 3dispatches total, not9; terminalbudgetexhaustedreceipt
  • input: A unhealthy, B succeeds repeatedly, scheduledclockreachesprobe
    expected: boundedAprobe occurs independentofuserfailure; recoveredAeligibleafterreceipt
  • input: cancel afterA timeout beforeB dispatch
    expected: noBcall; Apossiblysent remainsunknown
  • input: tool committed onA thenopaquecontinuation mustresume
    expected: no sendAopaque toB; replayof toolcommand returnssame receipt, notnew effect
  • input: processrestart afterattemptreservation
    expected: sameinvocationbudget remaining; noresettozero
  • input: SDK /clear or externalnative newturn
    expected: hosttotalattempt/deadline/spendunchanged

Миграция и совместимость

  • Newrouterprofiles requirepositivefinite limits and pinned model/capabilityrevision. No hardcodedcurrentvendorlist.
  • Persist attemptadmission/finish with commanddedup; separatehealthprobe counters. Existingroutine quotas retained butnolongertreatedasfullrouterguard.

Контракты и интерфейсы

UsageObservation: {observationId,attemptId,invocationId,providerRequestId?,vendorMessageId?,nativeConversationId?,usageScope:'step'|'turn'|'query_call'|'call_segment'|'invocation',segmentId,provider/model/adapterRevision,measurement:'provider_reported'|'host_estimated'|'billing_reconciled'|'unknown',aggregation:'delta'|'cumulative',coverage:'main_agent'|'whole_tree'|'unknown',tokens:{input:number|null,output:number|null,cacheRead:number|null,cacheWrite:number|null},cost:{microunits:number|null,currency:'USD'|null,basis:'client_estimate'|'price_config'|'invoice'|'unknown',priceRef:Ref|null},capturedAt,sourceRef}
ModelCalled: {attemptId,invocationId,turnId,providerRef,modelRevision,dispatchStatus,startedAt,endedAt,outcome,usageObservationRefs[],effectiveUsageRef|null,priceConfigRevision|null,redactionReceipt}; exact event version reserved atimplementation
Rollup: {scopeRef,knownTokens,unknownAttemptCount,estimatedCostMicrounits,billedCostMicrounits|null,coverage,asOfCursor,priceVersions[]}; don't sumstep and call cumulative intoone total

Алгоритм

  • One host attempt ID perdispatch, one provider message ID dedup withinattempt. Diagnosticattempttrace S05 allcalls; model.called terminaloutcome joinsusage, notreplacementtrace.
  • Adapter marks scope and cumulative/reset semantics explicitly. Reducer prefers latest cumulative for a segment, fallsback summedunique steps whenaggregateabsent, neverboth. For providerreset closes previoussegment withlastcumulative andstartsnewsegment; hostinvocationbudgetunchanged.
  • Costestimate distinct observedtokenusage andauthoritativebilling. Currentpriceconfigvalidityknown atcall; historical estimatespinned, laterbilling reconciliation newreceipt notrewriteoriginal.
  • NativeCLI subscription/OAuth may showtokens/quota andclientestimate, no perprojectchargedprice invented. Lack of finalusage createsunknown attempt even ifexitedwith0.
  • Per-turn orsubagent usage markedmainonly/whole_tree; main usage cannotlabeltotalestateusage; adaptercapabilityverdict reflectsavailablecoverage.

Инварианты

  • No floatarithmetic forpersistedmoney: integermicrounitswithcurrencyandroundingpolicy. Nullunknown separatefrom0measured.
  • Duplicate terminal/usageevents idempotent; sum by normalizedreceiptownership.
  • Usageprose fromagenttool untrusted andcannotadjustbudgetbalance.
  • Redaction beforepersist; no rawprompts/secret headers inusage event.

Негативные случаи

  • input: same assistantmessageID in4toolblocks usage100input/20output
    expected: 100/20once, not400/80
  • input: stepvalues cost2,3 andcallcumulative5
    expected: cost5, not10
  • input: stream results cumulative2,5 thenreset andcumulative1,3
    expected: total8 acrossclosedsegments; hostbudgetconsumed8
  • input: mainloop10tokens+subagent20; mainusage10, modelUsage30
    expected: whole_tree30, don'tsum40
  • input: crash finalzero afterknown successfulchargedstep
    expected: previousknownusage retained, coveragepartial/unknown notfree
  • input: usage unavailable onrefused/retriedcall
    expected: attemptrecorded unknown rather than dropped
  • input: price changed afterhistoricalcall
    expected: historicalestimatepinned oldprice; reestimate separate receipt

Миграция и совместимость

  • Register plannedmodel.called event only after schemaexists; no inventedhistoricusage fromtranscriptlength.
  • Legacy runs showunknowncost; providerinvoice reconciliationoptional futureadapter, notclaimalreadyintegrated.

Что приходит от зависимостей

    payload: provider/attempt metadata and typed usageevents
  • id: S05

Предлагаемые API

  • tests/manager-conformance/: versioned fixture corpus and trace reducer (new)

Контракты и интерфейсы

Fixture: {id,version,scenario,initialSnapshot,policyRef,budgetProfileRef,runnerProfile,availableSources,scriptedProviderEvents,interleavings,expected:{allowedCommands,forbiddenCommands,state,receipts,scope,maximumAttempts,requiredEvidence,expectedUnknowns},seededViolations:ViolationSeed[]}
Trace: {invocationId,runnerProfileHash,protocolHash,packHash,modelRevision,policyRevision,checkerRevision,attempts[],commands[],effectReceipts[],sourceReceipts[],usageObservations[],complete:boolean,gaps[]}
Verdict: {fixtureId,corpusVersion,subjectProfileHash,outcome:'pass'|'fail'|'inconclusive',hardViolations[],expectedUnknownsMatched,metrics:{citationPrecision,staleCitations,unnecessaryWakeCount,interventionCount,tokenUsage,costEstimate,costUnknownCount},evidenceRefs}; score not permission

Алгоритм

  • Version controlled syntheticcorpus first. Expectedstate/assertions written from sourcepolicy/contract, not sameimplementationfunction under test.
  • Replay scripted provider/native events through samemanager toolboundary+checker. Inject concurrent rebind/cancellation/stalesource/readerror/malformedtoolcalls/providerfailovers andcrashpositions.
  • Hardgate: 0scope/authority/epoch/duplicateeffect/falseverified leaks; exactexpected unknowns; no privilegedbusinessmutation outsidecommandboundary. Incomplete capture→inconclusive notpass.
  • Compare baseline/candidate samefixture/scopeddata/budget/capabilities; costandinterventions observationalmetrics with denominators, not singleheadlinequalityrating.
  • Externalnative conformance: deterministic fake plus certified CLI version fixture fromrecorded safeprotocol evidence; actualtwo-runnerpilot separateS08/CO074 gate. Do not claimfake provesinstalledbinarybehavior.
  • Real pilottrace opt-in exactscope+redactionretention later; references commitments/humaninterventions not hiddenreasoning. Recorded rationale quality canbeevaluated asevidencecited output, never assumedchainofthought.

Инварианты

  • Evaluator identity separate fromproducer/checkerproposalapproval; manager cannot changecorpus/passitself.
  • Safetyhardfailure cannot offset goodaveragequalitymetric.
  • Missingexpectedrecords notwrong emptyquery result; tracecomplete flag mustbeindependentlyderived.
  • Fixture seeds cover previous implementationdefects, not testsassertingconstants.

    expected: evalFAIL stale_authority evenifanswercorrect

    expected: FAIL invalid_basis_authority

    expected: FAIL recurrence_inflation
  • input: seed unknownHTTP/outbound markedunsent
    expected: FAIL false_effect_state
  • input: cap3 over3providers with5attempts
    expected: FAIL retry_budget_exceeded
  • input: completepolicytracemissingonecommandoutcome
    expected: INCONCLUSIVE trace_gap notpass
  • input: nativeprose sayssettled,no toolreceipt
    expected: noBusinessMutation and no acceptedsettlementcredit

Миграция и совместимость

  • No backfill inventedtraces; historicaljournal trajectories marked partial untilS05 capture active.
  • Versioncorpus andrunnercertification metadata; revokeactiveprofile eligibility whencritical hardgate regresses.

    payload: attempt/read/write/refusal/error/cancel trace schema andredactedcorrelation

  • new canonical released FAC role-slot/estate-binding/context extension + adapter conformance; no pretendcurrent0.1.0validity

Контракты и интерфейсы

RoleSlot: {role_slot_id,estate_id,scope_kind:'estate'|'project',project_id:null|string,role:'ceo'|'product-manager',configured_binding_revision:Revision,epoch:Seq,runtime_state:'idle'|'admitting'|'running'|'transitioning'|'suspended'|'unknown'}; unique semantic scope+role
Binding: {binding_id,revision:Revision,role_slot_id,principal_ref,provider_ref,runner_profile_ref,execution_context_ref,account_pool_ref,tool_contract_ref,checker_policy_ref,trust_revision,budget_profile_ref,status}; immutable revisions; old profile stays readable
BindCommand: Command<{role_slot_ref,provider_ref,runner_profile_ref,execution_context_ref,tool_contract_ref,budget_profile_ref,expected_slot_revision}>; VerifiedContext injected; caller cannot choose epoch. New provider admission+scope/policy checked beforeactivation
WakeBatch: {cycle_invocation_id,role_slot_ref,epoch,trigger:'manual'|'board_delta'|'cadence'|'addressed_mail',trigger_refs[],signal_start_seq:Seq,signal_end_seq:Seq,window_key,causation_id,excluded_self_event_kinds[],source_readiness}; inclusivebatch semantics documented; consumed seq committed onlyafterdurableoutcomes
Invocation: {manager_invocation_id,role_slot_ref,binding_revision,epoch,cycle_invocation_id,input_watermark:Seq,pack_ref,budget_ref,state,attempt_refs[],fabric_session_id:null|string,provider_native_session_ref:null|{provider_ref,runner_version,conversation_id,resume_mode,history_location_ref},outcome_ref?,next_due_at?}; task_run_id absent unless separatelinkedtaskwork is created
ManagerToolPort: read_board/query_memory/get_question/settle_by_citation/propose_merge/propose_reorder/propose_retro/ask_question/create_task; all identical schemas/handler service forbuiltin+external; mutating payload refs+expected revisions+recorded_rationale, authenticated manager scope+epoch outsideinput
Readiness: {configured:{binding_ref,scope,placement},host:{status:'online'|'offline'|'unknown'|'not_supported',last_observed_at,source_ref},authority:{status:'active'|'suspended'|'transitioning',epoch},runner:{status:'certified'|'uncertified'|'unavailable',profile_hash,capability_gaps},invocation:{state,id,last_outcome_ref}|null}; wrapscommon ReadEnvelope

Алгоритм

  • Adopt D-MGR-01/02 with new ADR + sibling version. Canonical roles are ceo/product-manager; arbitrary created-agent displayname/role not auto migrated. One configured governance assignment persists during safe handoff, runtime lease may be absent; never two admitted writers.
  • Bind preview validates provider/admission/runner profile, account pool, placement, exact tool schemas, budget and source scope. Available CLI binary alone isn't certified. Existing Codex terminal row cannot be offered as workingmanager without new adapter proof.
  • S15 wake service coalesces Board delta/manual/cadence/addressedmail into fixed authorized signal batch. Ignore own bookkeeping by explicitcausation/type allowlist; business effects that produce genuinely new externalobligation stayeligible. Samewindow+watermark replay returns samecycle/invocation, no paidstorm.
  • Admission transaction checks current slotbindingrevision, trust, budget, host lease and readiness; creates manager_invocation+operational lease/fencing token+spawn intent atomically. Invocation withouttask nevercreatesfakeprojecttask/TaskRun. Afterspawnfailure record failed invocation andknownunusedbudgetrefund; afterunknownlaunch reconcile first.
  • Manager pack includes only authorized Board slice/openquestions, currenthumanbasis, projectweights/trust/components, prior durable decisions and addressed mailbox; exactpacklock+contenthash beforedispatch. Empty source unavailable doesnotbecome emptyBoard. No agent's narrative remembered as independentdecision.
  • Built-in runner callsM175 viaModelPort. NativeClaude runner executes one bounded headless invocation using explicit profile and dedicated ephemeral directory; streamadapter maps nativeconversation/toolresult/usage. Capture vendorconversationref separately fromFabricSession andManagerInvocation.
  • Manager native profile selected recommendation: built-in tools disabled through supported --tools configuration, only FabricmanagerMCP definitions configured; permissionmode dontAsk and exactnamedMCP autoapprove policy; plugins/projectconfig/ambienthooks unavailable by isolated config, environment allowlist, filesystem/network restrictions. Certification tests inventory and refusals on pinnedCLI build. --strict-mcp-config alone insufficient; no blanket canUseTool interceptionpromise.
  • Initialmanager wakes start fresh nativeconversation. Optional explicitresume requiressamebinding/epoch-compatible authorization, profile, accessiblehistory and adapterinvocation-scoped cancellation/ack. Never continue-latest-cwd. Missingnativehistory→fresh fromFabricpack with resume_unavailable receipt; not pretendresumed.
  • Every manager mutation revalidates slotepoch+binding+policy+currentbasis underDBtransaction. Revokedoldtoken can'tcommit evenif MCPtransport stillalive. Agent cannot choose a humanactor, approve ownprivacypromotion or bypasschecker throughprose.
  • Handoff follows system-contract order: stopadmissions→boundedcheckpoint/drain→invalidateoldepoch→newbindingadmission→newcontext/epoch→acknowledgedcontinuation. Ifoldprocessunresponsive checkpoint unknown and fence stillrevoked; preservependingeffects forreconcile. Newmanagerreceives durablemailbox/pendingquestionrefs, notopaquevendorstate. Configuredassignment and runtimeavailability distinguished.
  • Afterprocessrestart cyclehost reconciles admitted/dispatchinginvocations before newadmission; stalehostlease doesn'tprove nativechild stopped. Localappclosed cannotrun; futurehosted runtime needsactualhostheartbeat/executorcontract, notproviderlabel.

Инварианты

  • One authoritative manager command surface; directSQL/API credentials neverprovided toexternalagent.
  • All outstandingnativeconversation/toolcall/usage refs carry ownerbinding and epoch; wrongscope/nativehistory reuse rejected.
  • Host activeepoch fence checked after any awaited work beforecommit; delayedchecker/modeloutput cannotretainexpiredright.
  • PM sees only project; CEO crossproject coordination sees authorized summaries but rawprojectcontent requires policy/classification; no unlimitedestateSQL.
  • Native transcript is evidence of agentclaim, not businessoutput; explicit tool commandreceipt is what changedwork.
  • Configuredactive CEO required by siblinggovernance; runtime absent/suspended duringhandoff allowed, notnoconfiguredCEO.
  • Conformance matrix states missingreadiness/trace/cancel/permissioncapability; unverified externalprofile notenabled asautonomousmanager.
  • Recorded rationale field stores cited explanation, neverclaims hiddenchainofthought. Opaque signedproviderstate cannot transfer tootherfamily.

Зачем

Подключить несколько собственных аккаунтов и автоматически продолжать разрешённую работу при приближении лимита без потери подтверждённой истории.

proposed

Выбранное решение

Алгоритм:
  • Прочитать M199.probe; далее выбрать готовый дочерний узел по входящим контрактам.
  • Закрывать каждую часть отдельно; M199 — агрегат принятой поставки, а не ещё один исполнитель тех же задач.
Что увидит пользователь: Optional login, explicit pinning and opt-in automatic account rotation with verified native continuation.

Зачем

До реализации узнать, какие гарантии реально поддерживают Claude Code и Codex на macOS. Переменная окружения сама по себе не доказывает изоляцию Keychain или сохранение разговора.

Выбранное решение

entry: Current backlog; prerequisites below provide typed input contracts.
Алгоритм:
  • Сверить установленный CLI build и официальный login/identity/resume интерфейс. Зафиксировать матрицу provider × runtime × capability с supported/unsupported/unverified и источником.
  • На искусственных homes проверить precedence окружения, Keychain backend и refresh ownership; реальные test accounts нужны только для отдельно допущенной сертификации.
  • Определить формат identity, checkpoint/native-ref, fencing и resume ack для общего adapter port. Не выставлять supported по чтению чужого README.
exit: Определить формат identity, checkpoint/native-ref, fencing и resume ack для общего adapter port. Не выставлять supported по чтению чужого README.

Контракты и интерфейсы

output: ProviderCapabilityReceipt {provider,cliBuild,runtime,capability,status,evidenceRef,checkedAt}; opaque auth/native references, no secrets
consumer: M199.accounts/auth/binding получают согласованные identifiers и список неподдерживаемых операций

Инварианты

  • Credentials remain local and outside shared event payloads.
  • No account change expands Fabric authority, replays effects or resets enclosing budgets.
  • Unsupported or unverified capability is never reported as successful continuation.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Подставить одинаковый email при разных provider subjects: identities различаются.
  • Подмена config env при общих Keychain credentials не даёт supported isolation.
  • Отсутствующий native ack оставляет resume unverified, даже если rollout существует.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • Подставить одинаковый email при разных provider subjects: identities различаются.
  • Подмена config env при общих Keychain credentials не даёт supported isolation.
  • Отсутствующий native ack оставляет resume unverified, даже если rollout существует.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Additive versioned records; preserve existing system login and saved conversations.
  • Feature stays unavailable/off until its own acceptance and required capabilities pass; do not backfill fake identities or resume receipts.

Зачем

Дать человеку несколько отдельных входов на конкретном устройстве, сохранив обычный CLI login и не распространяя credentials через Fabric.

Выбранное решение

entry: Current backlog; prerequisites below provide typed input contracts.
Алгоритм:
  • Создать local account store с principal/device/runtime/provider/subject/org/revision и отдельным secret reference; установить trusted owner seam в main, не принимать actor из renderer.
  • Реализовать begin/complete/cancel login через официальный CLI staging context; duplicate subject возвращает существующий профиль, unknown identity не завершает вход.
  • Сделать versioned default для будущих admissions и local removal с проверкой активных bindings/default. Историю и provider-side sign-out не удалять вместе с локальным profile.
exit: Сделать versioned default для будущих admissions и local removal с проверкой активных bindings/default. Историю и provider-side sign-out не удалять вместе с локальным profile.

Контракты и интерфейсы

commands: beginLogin, completeLogin, cancelLogin, listAccounts, setDefault(expectedRevision), removeLocal(expectedRevision)
output: Redacted AccountView + LoginAttempt/CommandReceipt; accountId is opaque; provider subject/org verified; authoritative principal and membership revision rechecked

Инварианты

  • Credentials remain local and outside shared event payloads.
  • No account change expands Fabric authority, replays effects or resets enclosing budgets.
  • Unsupported or unverified capability is never reported as successful continuation.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Cancel/crash/expiry staging не меняет другой login.
  • Повторный completeLogin создаёт одну запись.
  • Удаление используемого или default account отклоняется до разрешения зависимостей.
  • Отозванный principal и credential leak в IPC/journal/transcript дают отказ проверки.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • Cancel/crash/expiry staging не меняет другой login.
  • Повторный completeLogin создаёт одну запись.
  • Удаление используемого или default account отклоняется до разрешения зависимостей.
  • Отозванный principal и credential leak в IPC/journal/transcript дают отказ проверки.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Additive versioned records; preserve existing system login and saved conversations.
  • Feature stays unavailable/off until its own acceptance and required capabilities pass; do not backfill fake identities or resume receipts.

Экраны, сценарии и UX-контекст →

Зависит от: M199.accounts · Пакет: F5A

Зачем

Не дать одному аккаунту подменить другой через inherited env, общий Keychain или гонку обновления токенов.

Выбранное решение

entry: Current backlog; prerequisites below provide typed input contracts.
Алгоритм:
  • Реализовать provider-specific resolver, очищающий конфликтующие env overrides; official auth backend выбирается по capability receipt.
  • Один refresh lineage имеет одного согласованного writer. Сессии одного аккаунта используют совместимые CLI locks; нельзя размножать rotating refresh tokens по session dirs.
  • Получать и проверять subject/org при каждом новом auth revision; refresh/cancel/readback не записывает credential в неверный slot. Несовместимый внешний writer блокирует managed operation.
exit: Получать и проверять subject/org при каждом новом auth revision; refresh/cancel/readback не записывает credential в неверный slot. Несовместимый внешний writer блокирует managed operation.

Контракты и интерфейсы

port: resolveAuthContext(accountRef,runtime,expectedAuthRevision) -> opaque contextRef; verifyIdentity(contextRef); coordinatedRefresh(contextRef)
output: Child environment and credential backend agree on one verified identity; account views never expose bearer/cookie/refresh values

Инварианты

  • Credentials remain local and outside shared event payloads.
  • No account change expands Fabric authority, replays effects or resets enclosing budgets.
  • Unsupported or unverified capability is never reported as successful continuation.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Две конкурентные refresh-попытки не создают два живых токена и не портят store.
  • Старый токен не перезаписывает более новую auth revision.
  • Наследуемый API key не обходит выбранный subscription account.
  • Чужой runtime и shared-Keychain конфликт оставляют operation blocked, не делают global swap.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • Две конкурентные refresh-попытки не создают два живых токена и не портят store.
  • Старый токен не перезаписывает более новую auth revision.
  • Наследуемый API key не обходит выбранный subscription account.
  • Чужой runtime и shared-Keychain конфликт оставляют operation blocked, не делают global swap.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Additive versioned records; preserve existing system login and saved conversations.
  • Feature stays unavailable/off until its own acceptance and required capabilities pass; do not backfill fake identities or resume receipts.

entry: Current backlog; prerequisites below provide typed input contracts.
Алгоритм:
  • Разрешать explicit run choice → project binding → default → system default один раз при admission с CAS account/config revision.
  • Записать ConversationBinding, provider-native ref, workspace fingerprint, current Session generation и неизменяемый account snapshot TaskRun.
  • Ввести один writer на conversation и reject поздних callbacks от прежней generation. Для externally mutable system login показывать drift и не обещать строгую pinning без подтверждения.

Зависит от: M199.binding · S03.effects · Пакет: F5A

Зачем

Менять исполнение, сохраняя подтверждённую историю, без повторного запуска уже выполненных инструментов и без ложного сообщения об успехе.

Выбранное решение

entry: Current backlog; prerequisites below provide typed input contracts.
Алгоритм:
  • Persist SwitchOperation и target feasibility до остановки: identity/org/data scope, native compatibility, checkpoint manifest, pending input, unresolved effects.
  • Дождаться адаптерной safe boundary; подтвердить stop/fencing. Старый TaskRun заканчивается cancelled либо outcome_unknown; новый linked TaskRun допускается только после подтверждённого результата.
  • Записать spawn intent, возобновить exact native ref и проверить account+conversation ack перед отправкой input. CAS binding commit; сбой ведёт к recovery той же операции.
  • Реализовать crash reconciliation на каждой фазе; сохранить prior checkpoint для возврата; manifest защищён от symlink/path traversal. Не копировать целиком provider home или live SQLite.
exit: Реализовать crash reconciliation на каждой фазе; сохранить prior checkpoint для возврата; manifest защищён от symlink/path traversal. Не копировать целиком provider home или live SQLite.

Контракты и интерфейсы

operation: {switchId,idempotencyKey,conversationId,from,to,expectedBinding,policyRevision?,phase,checkpointRef,oldGeneration,newGeneration,receipt}
phases: preparing / waiting_boundary / stopping / resuming / committed / recovering / restored / needs_reconciliation
budget: New Session/TaskRun does not reset enclosing work/invocation attempt, time or spend budget

Инварианты

  • Credentials remain local and outside shared event payloads.
  • No account change expands Fabric authority, replays effects or resets enclosing budgets.
  • Unsupported or unverified capability is never reported as successful continuation.

Отказы и восстановление

  • Crash после stop или spawn не запускает второй процесс при retry.
  • Tool effect уже выполнен: восстановление не повторяет его.
  • Wrong identity или native-ref ack не коммитит успех.
  • Отозванное право, unknown stop и отсутствующий старый login оставляют честный hold.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • Crash после stop или spawn не запускает второй процесс при retry.
  • Tool effect уже выполнен: восстановление не повторяет его.
  • Wrong identity или native-ref ack не коммитит успех.
  • Отозванное право, unknown stop и отсутствующий старый login оставляют честный hold.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Additive versioned records; preserve existing system login and saved conversations.
  • Feature stays unavailable/off until its own acceptance and required capabilities pass; do not backfill fake identities or resume receipts.

  • apps/desktop/src/main/providerAccounts/switchCoordinator.ts (new)

  • apps/desktop/src/main/pty.ts

Зачем

Убрать найденное расхождение profile и quota lookup; дать автосмене достоверные, правильно атрибутированные наблюдения.

Выбранное решение

entry: Current backlog; prerequisites below provide typed input contracts.
Алгоритм:
  • Перевести quota reader на resolved AuthContext, используемый запуском; исключить самостоятельное чтение system-default credentials при выбранном managed profile.
  • Разнести cache, backoff и in-flight refresh по provider/subject/org/account/runtime/authRevision; timestamps и window IDs сохраняются в observation.
  • Различать exhausted, rate-limit 429, auth-required, network/source failure, stale и unknown; selected model window участвует только при подтверждённом наличии.
  • Ограничить число запросов на tick; resetAt не заменяет повторное чтение. Удаление/смена auth revision инвалидирует только нужные ключи.
exit: Ограничить число запросов на tick; resetAt не заменяет повторное чтение. Удаление/смена auth revision инвалидирует только нужные ключи.

Экраны, сценарии и UX-контекст →

Зависит от: M199.resume · M199.usage · Пакет: F5A

Зачем

Продолжать разрешённую работу без ручного выбора при приближении лимита, как cswap, сохраняя границы разговора и бюджета.

Выбранное решение

entry: Current backlog; prerequisites below provide typed input contracts.
Алгоритм:
  • Хранить versioned opt-in policy с account allowlist, provider/runtime/project scope, conversation enrollment/pin, threshold, best/consume-first, model windows, hysteresis, cooldown и hard switch cap. Включение разрешает последующие смены без второго confirmation.
  • Вынести pure decision engine: свежая типизированная usage → eligible candidates → deterministic stay/switch/hold decision с причиной. best выбирает headroom, consume-first — ближайший weekly reset у пригодных аккаунтов. consume-first может переключить до порога на аккаунт с более ранним подтверждённым weekly reset и достаточным запасом; best в этом случае остаётся.
  • Перед остановкой повторно проверить identity, quota, policy/membership/binding revisions. Dedup tick/intent на conversation и observation; использовать M199.resume, не отдельный global credential switch.
  • Сохранить cooldown/quarantine/exclusions/pending operation и backoff через рестарт. Один tick lease на scope; bounded adaptive polling, Retry-After и exhausted reset scheduling. App-off останавливает loop.
  • Pause/disable до stop снимает queued intent; после stop только recovery. Manual pin исключает conversation. Unknown usage не разрешает blind fallback, invalid refresh quarantines account, billed/API-key account требует отдельного явного допуска.
  • Не сбрасывать бюджет, дедлайн и суммарное число попыток при новом account/TaskRun; hard cap действует и при 100% quota. Preview/dry-run проходит тот же selector без credential/PTY mutation.
exit: Не сбрасывать бюджет, дедлайн и суммарное число попыток при новом account/TaskRun; hard cap действует и при 100% quota. Preview/dry-run проходит тот же selector без credential/PTY mutation.

Контракты и интерфейсы

policy: {policyId,revision,enabled,scope,accountAllowlist,strategy,thresholdPct,modelWindows,cooldownSeconds,hysteresisPct,maxSwitchesPerHour,enclosingBudgetRef}
decision: {kind:stay|queue_switch|hold,reason,from,to?,observationRefs,policyRevision,nextCheckAt,eligible,excluded}; never contains secrets
defaults: Proposed: best, 90% used, poll 60s, cooldown 300s, hysteresis 10pp; hard cap 12/hour = 3600/300. Editable, explicit and finite; evidence for cswap defaults is in the source comparison.

Инварианты

  • Credentials remain local and outside shared event payloads.
  • No account change expands Fabric authority, replays effects or resets enclosing budgets.
  • Unsupported or unverified capability is never reported as successful continuation.

Отказы и восстановление

  • 95% A, fresh 20% B, enabled/enrolled: auto commits through coordinator with no second user confirmation.
  • Disabled B, stale B, foreign org, unknown quota or unverified resume never becomes a candidate.
  • 89/91% alternating readings cannot ping-pong; repeated events and concurrent tick holders create one operation.
  • All exhausted pauses dispatch; clock reaching reset triggers a probe, not assumed free quota.
  • Crash, manual override, policy exclusion or revocation while waiting prevent stale auto commit.
  • Twelve allowed switches exhaust the hourly cap; restart/100% usage cannot reset it; enclosing spend budget stays unchanged.
  • Отсутствующий/stale reset timestamp не разрешает proactive consume-first.

Приёмка — будущие проверки

  • 95% A, fresh 20% B, enabled/enrolled: auto commits through coordinator with no second user confirmation.
  • Disabled B, stale B, foreign org, unknown quota or unverified resume never becomes a candidate.
  • 89/91% alternating readings cannot ping-pong; repeated events and concurrent tick holders create one operation.
  • All exhausted pauses dispatch; clock reaching reset triggers a probe, not assumed free quota.
  • Crash, manual override, policy exclusion or revocation while waiting prevent stale auto commit.
  • Twelve allowed switches exhaust the hourly cap; restart/100% usage cannot reset it; enclosing spend budget stays unchanged.
  • Ни один аккаунт не достиг порога, B сбросится раньше: consume-first выбирает B при достаточном запасе, best остаётся на A.

Миграция и совместимость

  • Additive versioned records; preserve existing system login and saved conversations.
  • Feature stays unavailable/off until its own acceptance and required capabilities pass; do not backfill fake identities or resume receipts.

Зачем

Сделать режим понятным: какой аккаунт работает, кто может заменить его, почему произошла смена и как её остановить.

Выбранное решение

entry: Current backlog; prerequisites below provide typed input contracts.
Алгоритм:
  • Перенести SCR-62/63 из fixture в production IPC read models: optional system default, login, default, identity, attributed usage, safe removal и explicit manual resume.
  • Добавить enable/pause, pool inclusion, best/consume-first, thresholds/advanced settings и enrollment текущего разговора. До включения показать affected conversations и eligible accounts.
  • Отображать off/monitoring/waiting-boundary/switching/cooling-down/exhausted/held/paused, причину, прошлый receipt и следующий probe/reset. Не просить confirmation на каждый auto switch.
  • Подключить RU/EN registry, keyboard/focus/error recovery и narrow layout; native unsupported → явное ограничение. Изменения policy recheck CAS и права.
exit: Подключить RU/EN registry, keyboard/focus/error recovery и narrow layout; native unsupported → явное ограничение. Изменения policy recheck CAS и права.
